plugins.description: Cross-session artifact center for DeepSeek Harness: agent tools register deliverable files (PDF/Excel/PPT/code/JSON) into one shared folder, plus a sidebar panel that filters them by category, extension or keyword.
plugins.readme_text:
# 产物中心 · Artifact Center

> DeepSeek Harness（DSH / Cordis）插件：**agent 每次产出重要文件都会登记进一个跨会话的产物中心**，
> 左侧边栏提供面板，按分类 / 后缀 / 关键词即时筛选。

每个对话都在产出文件——报告 PDF、Excel 数据表、PPT、脚本、JSON——但它们散落在各会话的工作目录里，换个对话就找不到了。
本插件把「值得留下的产物」集中到一处：

- **agent 侧**：4 个工具。产出文件时调用 `artifact_save` 登记，默认**复制一份**到统一目录，原目录被清理也不丢。
- **用户侧**：左侧边栏「产物中心」面板。分类 chip + 后缀 chip + 关键词搜索，可复制路径、在文件夹中显示、删除。
- **跨会话**：索引与副本都在 `~/.dsh/artifact-center/`，所有对话共用同一份。

```
┌ 左侧边栏 ────────┐
│ 对话             │
│ 自动化任务       │
│ 产物中心   ← 面板行 │──┐
│ 插件管理         │  │
└──────────────────┘  │
                      ▼
┌ 产物中心 ───────────────────────────────────────┐
│ 分类  [全部] [pdf 3] [excel 2] [code 5] …     刷新│
│ 后缀  [.pdf 3] [.xlsx 2] [.py 4] [.json 1]      │
│ 搜索标题 / 文件名 / 路径 / 备注 / 标签            │
│ ─────────────────────────────────────────────── │
│ 季度报告.pdf      PDF  2.0 MB  复制路径 显示 删除 │
│ train.py          代码 4.1 KB  …                │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## 安装

```sh
# 从 GitHub 安装（推荐）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:lishuo4096/artifact-center

# 本地开发：link 到源码目录
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:/path/to/artifact-center
```

也可以在插件市场（dshmarket）里搜索 `artifact-center` 一键安装。

装完**重启 DSH**（宿主的插件模块走 ESM 缓存，改完源码或新装插件都需要重启才加载新代码）；
重启后左侧边栏出现「产物中心」，对 agent 说话时 `artifact_save` 等工具即可用。

## agent 工具

| 工具 | 参数 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `artifact_save` | `path`（必填）、`title`、`note`、`tags[]`、`mode`（`copy` 默认 / `link`） | 登记一个产物。`copy` 会把文件复制进统一目录；`link` 只记路径不动文件 |
| `artifact_list` | `ext`、`category`、`keyword` | 列出/筛选产物，三个过滤条件可组合 |
| `artifact_stats` | — | 按分类、按后缀的计数 |
| `artifact_remove` | `id`（必填） | 删除条目。`copy` 产物连副本一起删；`link` 产物只删条目，**永不碰原文件** |

工具的返回值是结构化 JSON；`artifact_save` 的 `path` 不存在或不是文件时返回 `{ok:false,message}`，不会抛异常打断对话。

## 面板

左侧边栏「产物中心」，与工具读写同一份索引：

- **分类 chip**：`pdf` / `excel` / `ppt` / `word` / `image` / `code` / `data` / `archive` / `other`，带计数，计数为 0 且未选中的不显示。
- **后缀 chip**：按真实后缀分组（`.pdf`、`.py`、`.json`…），按数量降序。
- **搜索框**：服务端匹配标题、文件名、路径、备注、标签（输入 220ms 防抖）。
- **每行操作**：复制路径 · 在文件夹中显示（Windows `explorer /select`、macOS `open`、Linux `xdg-open`）· 删除（二次确认）。

## 数据与配置

```
~/.dsh/artifact-center/
├── index.json   # 索引：id / 原标题 / 原路径 / 存储路径 / mode / 分类 / 后缀 / 大小 / 备注 / 标签 / 所属会话 / 时间
└── files/       # copy 模式的副本
```

索引写入是串行队列（不会两个 tool 调用互相覆盖）。默认根目录是 `~/.dsh/artifact-center`，
可用插件配置 `rootDir` 覆盖：

```yaml
# cordis.patch.yml（用户覆盖层）
- id: artifact-center
  config:
    rootDir: D:/artifacts
```

## HTTP 路由（面板的数据通道）

面板通过宿主 `webServer` 的同源路由取数据，不需要额外服务：

| 路由 | 方法 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/artifact-center/api/state` | GET | `?ext=&category=&keyword=` → `{ok, items, stats, rootDir, categories}` |
| `/artifact-center/api/remove` | POST | `{id}` → 删除条目 |
| `/artifact-center/api/reveal` | POST | `{id}` → 在文件管理器里定位；只接受索引里的 id，路径由服务端解析 |

三条路由都带**同源栅栏**：带跨站 `Origin` 的请求直接 403；写操作必须 `content-type: application/json`
（跨站表单这类「简单请求」不触发预检，声明 JSON 则会预检，而预检打到本路由必然 405/415）；
非浏览器调用（curl / node，没有 Origin）照常可用。`reveal` 不接受任意路径参数，所以无法被用来打开任意文件。

没有 `webServer` 的形态（纯 CLI）下，面板这段不激活，4 个工具照常工作。

## 目录结构

```
artifact-center/
├── package.json          # dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client（web）
├── cordis.patch.yml      # 注册进 profile 的 patch 行
├── index.js              # 宿主半边：4 个工具 + 3 条同源路由
├── client.js             # 浏览器半边：侧边栏面板行 + 面板页（window.__ModuleLoader__ 形态）
├── lib/
│   ├── defineTool.js     # 作者侧工具 DSL → 宿主 JSON Schema（零依赖，必须带）
│   └── store.js          # 索引与副本的存储层（串行写、分类规则）
└── test/
    └── local-smoke.mjs   # 离线自检：81 项断言，不需要 DSH 就能跑
```

`lib/defineTool.js` 不是可选的装饰：宿主真正加载的是 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 的 `defineTool`，
但在 profile 里以 `link:` 安装的插件**不能 import 任何 `@deepseek-ai/*`**（它们只在 app.asar 内，Node 解析不到），
所以插件必须自带一份等价实现。作者的 `parameters` 用 `required: true` 这种 DSL 写法，`output.schema: {type:'json'}` 表示无约束 JSON。

## 开发与自检

```sh
node test/local-smoke.mjs
```

零依赖，不需要启动 DSH：伪造 `ctx` / `req` / `res` 后覆盖工具行为（复制落盘、link 不复制、删除 link 不动原文件、
筛选与统计）、三条路由（含同源/方法/content-type 栅栏）、`client.js` 的装载与渲染（用 stub React 渲染空态、
有数据、筛选无命中、错误态），以及**工具 schema 必须通过宿主 `assertSupportedJsonSchema`** 这条回归护栏
（作者侧 `type:'json'` 若被原样透传，宿主 `register()` 会同步抛错，进而中断整个 `apply()`——本插件踩过这个坑）。

## 兼容性

- 面板需要 Web GUI（宿主 `webServer` 同源路由 + `sidebar.panellist` / `main` 插槽）。
- 纯 CLI 形态下工具可用，面板不显示。
- 已在本机 DSH 桌面版（Electron，Web GUI `http://127.0.0.1:19387`）上实测：面板渲染、筛选、删除、
  在文件夹中显示，以及 4 个工具均正常。

## License

MIT

---

# Artifact Center (English)

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH / Cordis) plugin that gives every conversation a **shared artifact center**.

Agents produce files all the time — reports, spreadsheets, slides, scripts, JSON — and they end up scattered across
per-session working directories, effectively lost the moment the conversation changes. This plugin registers the
artifacts worth keeping, in one place:

- **Agent tools** — `artifact_save` (copies the file into a shared directory by default, or just records the path with
  `mode:"link"`), `artifact_list` (filter by `ext` / `category` / `keyword`), `artifact_stats`, `artifact_remove`.
- **Sidebar panel** — category chips with counts, extension chips with counts, keyword search, copy path,
  reveal in file manager, delete with confirmation.
- **Cross-session** — index and copies live in `~/.dsh/artifact-center/`, shared by every conversation.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:lishuo4096/artifact-center
```

Restart DSH afterwards. The panel talks to the host over three same-origin routes under `/artifact-center/api/`
(`state`, `remove`, `reveal`); cross-origin requests are rejected, writes require `application/json`, and `reveal`
resolves paths server-side from the index so it cannot be used to open arbitrary files.

Run `node test/local-smoke.mjs` for the dependency-free self-check (81 assertions covering the tools, the routes,
the browser bundle and the tool-schema contract).

MIT licensed.

plugins.description: Lightweight reverse-proxy bridge for DSH web GUI - fixes WS 403 through nginx
plugins.readme_text:
# @painclown/dsh-proxy-bridge

轻量级 DSH 反向代理桥，专为 nginx 等 TLS 终结反代后面的 WebSocket 转发设计。

> 理念参考 [@riceawa/dsh-lan-gateway](https://github.com/rice-awa/dsh-lan-gateway)，感谢 riceawa 的启发。

## 解决什么问题

DSH Web GUI 的 WebSocket 连接在通过 nginx → 网关 → DSH 链路时会因 Origin/Host 不匹配返回 403。本插件跳过 same-site 检查，信任上游终结器（nginx）做访问控制，直接转发 HTTP + WebSocket 到 DSH。

## 架构

```
浏览器 ──HTTPS──> nginx (TLS 终结) ──HTTP──> Bridge (0.0.0.0:3083) ──HTTP──> DSH (127.0.0.1:3080)
                                              │
                                              ├── 密码门 (可选)
                                              ├── DSH Cookie 自动注入
                                              ├── WebSocket 透传 (raw TCP splice)
                                              └── 速率限制 / 会话撤销
```

- **HTTP**: 转发时重写 Host/Origin 到 `127.0.0.1:3080`
- **WebSocket**: socket 直接 splice 到上游，无 same-site 检查
- **密码门**: 可选的第二层认证（在 nginx 之上）
- **DSH Cookie 注入**: 自动为请求注入 DSH 认证 Cookie，无需手动处理 DSH 登录

## 安装

```bash
# 通过 DSH 插件命令安装
dsh plugin --profile web add @painclown/dsh-proxy-bridge

# 或手动安装
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web
npm install @painclown/dsh-proxy-bridge
```

## 快速开始

```
# 1. 启用桥（默认 3083 → 3080）
proxy_bridge enable

# 2. 设置密码
proxy_bridge config password=dsh2026

# 3. 配置 DSH Secret（从 ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml 读取）
proxy_bridge config dshSecret=<your-secret>

# 4. 检查状态
proxy_bridge status
```

## 命令

| 命令 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| `proxy_bridge status` | 查看桥状态 |
| `proxy_bridge enable` | 启动桥 |
| `proxy_bridge disable` | 停止桥 |
| `proxy_bridge restart` | 重启桥 |
| `proxy_bridge config` | 更新配置 |

### 配置示例

```
# 设置密码（至少 8 位）
proxy_bridge config password=dsh2026

# 配置 DSH Secret（自动注入 DSH 认证 Cookie）
proxy_bridge config dshSecret=vGIxivMEJblP1teRqVymk6sefy7wHMzxds9T0Unv6rE

# 启用自签名 TLS
proxy_bridge config tlsEnabled=true tlsHosts=["dsh.poxx.top","192.168.123.254"]

# 允许 LAN 免登录
proxy_bridge config lanPasswordless=true lanCidrs=["192.168.123.0/24"]

# 清除密码
proxy_bridge config password=
```

## 配置字段

| 字段 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|------|------|--------|------|
| `enabled` | boolean | `false` | 是否启动监听 |
| `port` | number | `3083` | 监听端口 (0.0.0.0) |
| `dshPort` | number | `3080` | DSH 上游端口 |
| `password` | string | `''` | 密码门（空 = 无密码） |
| `cookieName` | string | `dsh_bridge_auth` | 会话 Cookie 名 |
| `cookieMaxAgeDays` | number | `30` | Cookie 有效期（天） |
| `dshSecret` | string | `''` | DSH browser-session secret |
| `secureCookies` | boolean | `false` | Cookie 加 Secure 标志 |
| `tlsEnabled` | boolean | `false` | 启用自签名 TLS (HTTPS) |
| `tlsDays` | number | `365` | 自签名证书有效期（天） |
| `tlsHosts` | string[] | `[]` | 证书 SAN 主机列表 |
| `lanCidrs` | string[] | `[]` | 信任的 LAN CIDR |
| `lanPasswordless` | boolean | `false` | LAN/loopback 源免登录 |

## 安全特性

### 密码门

- 设置密码后，所有请求必须携带有效会话 Cookie
- 登录页：`/__bridge_login`（GET 显示表单，POST 验证密码）
- 登出：`/__bridge_logout`（POST 撤销当前会话）
- 速率限制：每 IP 每 60 秒最多 5 次登录尝试
- 密码使用 scrypt 哈希存储，明文不保存

### 会话管理

- 每个会话有唯一 ID（16 字节随机数）
- 会话 Cookie 使用 HMAC-SHA256 签名
- 登出只撤销当前会话，不影响其他
- 修改密码递增 epoch，撤销所有会话
- 状态持久化到 `~/.dsh/proxy-bridge/state.json`（0600 权限）

### DSH Cookie 注入

当客户端请求不携带 `dsh-auth-*` Cookie 时，Bridge 使用配置的 secret 自动生成并注入，使 DSH 认证透明化。

## 文件结构

```
~/.dsh/proxy-bridge/
├── state.json          # 持久化状态（Cookie secret、密码哈希、会话 epoch、已撤销会话）
└── tls/
    ├── selfsigned.crt  # 自签名证书（tlsEnabled=true 时生成）
    └── selfsigned.key  # 私钥
```

## nginx 配置示例

```nginx
server {
    listen 11007 ssl;
    server_name dsh.poxx.top;

    ssl_certificate     /path/to/cert.pem;
    ssl_certificate_key /path/to/key.pem;

    location / {
        proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:3083;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;

        # WebSocket 支持
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
        proxy_set_header Connection "upgrade";

        proxy_read_timeout 86400;
    }
}
```

## 开发

```bash
# 构建
npx tsdown

# 部署到 DSH profile
rm -rf ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/@riceawa/dsh-proxy-bridge/lib/
cp -r lib/ ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/@riceawa/dsh-proxy-bridge/lib/
```

### 源码结构

```
src/
├── index.ts            # 插件入口，工具注册，生命周期管理
├── proxy.ts            # 核心代理逻辑（HTTP 转发 + WS 透传 + 认证）
├── auth.ts             # 源分类、会话签名、速率限制
├── state.ts            # 持久化状态（scrypt 密码、Cookie secret、会话管理）
├── tls.ts              # 自签名证书生成和加载
├── login.ts            # 登录页渲染、登出路径、速率限制处理
├── config-fields.ts    # 配置 schema
└── client/
    ├── index.ts        # 客户端入口
    └── bridge-card.tsx # React 配置卡片
```

## 与 dsh-lan-gateway 的区别

| 特性 | dsh-lan-gateway | dsh-proxy-bridge |
|------|----------------|-----------------|
| Same-site 检查 | 严格（Origin/Host 必须匹配） | 跳过（信任 nginx） |
| 适用场景 | 直接暴露到 LAN | 放在 nginx 后面 |
| WS 403 问题 | 需要配置 Origin 白名单 | 自动解决 |
| DSH Cookie 注入 | 无 | 有 |
| 复杂度 | 较高（request policy、upstream session） | 较低 |

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Deterministic network egress gate for DeepSeek Harness — web fetches checked against a destination allowlist before they run
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-egress-gate

Deterministic network egress gate for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh).

Content scanning (dsh-read-guard) guards what **enters** the model; this
guards where data may **leave** to. `web_fetch` / `web_search` calls are
checked against a destination allowlist in `tools/pre-execute` and denied
before they run. Shell commands are scanned for fetch-verb URLs —
observation by default, enforcement opt-in, honest about precision. Zero LLM
calls in the trust path.

Family: read · write · do · call · leave-behind · **egress (where data may
flow)**.

## Why now (checked 2026-10-12)

Empty lane. Five keyword searches (`network allowlist`, `egress firewall`,
`url filter`, `web fetch restrict`, …) return nothing on GitHub; the awesome
list has no entry gating destinations. Neighbours are all different axes:
content-pattern secret rules (dsh-defend), LLM-judged commands
(dsh-jev-guard), proxy *configuration* (official network-proxy docs). For
teams, "which hosts may the agent reach" is the first compliance question —
and the deterministic answer was unowned.

## Policy

- Deny always wins; a non-empty `allow` list means "only these hosts"
  (`example.com` covers `api.example.com`; `*.example.com` is the explicit
  form).
- Web tools are enforced at full precision — the URL is in the arguments.
- Shell: URLs following `curl` / `wget` / `Invoke-WebRequest` /
  `Invoke-RestMethod` / `fetch` / `http` on the same command segment. This
  cannot see through scripts, variables, or proxies — so it warns by
  default and denies only when you opt into `shellMode: 'enforce'`.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile default add github:zhengqiuyang/dsh-egress-gate
```

Prebuilt `lib/` ships in the repo — git installs need no build step and no
`allowBuilds` authorization.

## Configure

```yaml
- id: dsh-egress-gate
  name: dsh-egress-gate
  config:
    webTools: [web_fetch, web_search]
    shellTool: bash            # '' disables the shell scan
    allow: [docs.deepseek.com, github.com]
    deny: [pastebin.example]
    shellMode: observe         # observe | enforce
```

## Develop

```sh
npm install && npm test
```

## Kill criteria

If dsh ships first-party destination policy, or proxy-layer plugins add
per-host rules, this freezes at its last working version with a postmortem
here.

plugins.description: Independent OpenCode Go connection plugin for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# OpenCode Go · 2

这是独立的 DeepSeek Harness 模型插件，只注册 `opencode-go-second`。
第一套 `opencode-go` 和其他供应商继续由原生适配器管理。

## 安装

适用于 DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.1` / `0.2.1-rc.2`，需要 Node.js `>=22.19.0`。
DSH 官方包通过 peer dependencies 复用宿主，模型 SDK 使用 `pi-ai 1.1.0`。
插件兼容范围通过新版 `engines.dsh` 声明。仍使用 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` 时请保留插件 `v0.2.2`。

桌面端通过 npm 安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-opencode-go-second
```

市场会通过 npm 检查已发布的新版，出现更新提示后点击更新即可。后续发布 npm 新版
不需要逐次修改市场收录条目。开发目录的 `link:` 安装不参与 npm 自动检查更新。

Web 端将 `--profile desktop` 改为 `--profile web`。也可以从源码安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:yfwu2020/dsh-opencode-go-second
```

安装后重启 DSH，在设置 → 模型 → OpenCode Go · 2 → 管理中配置 **OpenCode Go**
API 密钥，点击“获取可用模型”，选择后保存。模型是否能实际调用由账号权限、额度
和上游服务状态决定，目录查询成功不代表逐个模型已通过推理测试。

本插件新增独立的 `opencode-go-second` 连接，不替换原生适配器或其他供应商配置。
默认使用密钥引用 `OPENCODE_API_KEY`；如果已在别处使用相同引用，请先为新连接
选择独立引用，避免更新密钥时影响使用同一引用的其他连接。

### 本地开发

克隆仓库后运行 `npm ci` 和 `npm test`。需要联调时，将 DSH profile 的
`package.json` 依赖指向 `link:<项目的绝对路径>`，在 `dsh.profile.bundles` 中添加
`dsh-opencode-go-second`，并合并本仓库 `cordis.patch.yml` 中的条目；不要覆盖已有
profile 文件。DSH profile 通常位于 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`。

`migration.mjs` 仅供处理本项目特定的旧覆盖方案，不随发布包交付。
普通安装不需要运行它；维护旧方案前应备份并核对原配置。

## 使用与隔离

设置 → 模型中显示“OpenCode Go · 2”。密钥沿用 DSH 密钥库里的
`OPENCODE_API_KEY` 引用，插件不保存或打印密钥。内置 38 个备用模型；可手动刷新当前账号可用的模型。
点卡片右侧“管理”可查看和搜索模型、选择启用模型、获取可用模型。
有改动时显示“保存模型”和“撤销修改”；替换密钥需要单独点“更新密钥”。
收起面板保留未保存的修改。原生编辑入口仅在此插件卡片中隐藏，第一套不受影响。
各模型按资料使用 Chat Completions、Responses 或 Anthropic Messages 接口；
新加入的 Google 模型使用 Google Generative AI 接口。
会话标识取自 DSH 当前聊天，User-Agent 复用 DSH 的请求标识。
两个连接之间没有密钥轮换、自动降级或路由覆盖。

迁移时第二套内部名称由 `opencode` 变为 `opencode-go-second`，避免与原生 Zen
设置目录冲突。当前全局默认模型会迁移到新名称，模型和推理等级保持原值。
聊天记录不修改；若某个旧聊天单独保存了旧连接选择，需要重新选择“第二套”。
不同适配器之间的历史按 DSH 官方规则转换为通用历史，原生专用回放信息可能
不再被复用，但文本、工具调用与结果仍保留。

## 实现

依赖官方发布的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai@0.2.1-rc.1` / `0.2.1-rc.2` 和
`@earendil-works/pi-ai@1.1.0`，复用公开的 `PiAiAdapter` 以及原生 Go provider。
没有复制核心适配器源码、替换原生包或导入 app.asar 内的绝对路径。
`package-lock.json` 固定依赖版本；升级 DSH 后仍需检查公开接口的兼容性。

模型元数据合并了当时的原生 Go/Zen 目录与 models.dev 的 Go 资料。
可用 ID 来自第二套认证的 `/zen/go/v1/models` 查询，不使用未认证的公共列表。
两个旧别名 `deepseek-flash`、`omen-alpha` 沿用已存在的能力配置，能力上限未经
额外实测。DSH 支持的输入为文本和图片；不会声称支持音视频/PDF 原始输入。

## 更新模型目录

只在点击设置面板中的“获取可用模型”时查询列表；启动、定时任务和密钥更新均不会触发刷新。
手动刷新会用第二套已保存的密钥（或尚未保存的草稿密钥）查询 Go 列表，
仅将该密钥发送给 `opencode.ai`。遇到未知模型时自动补齐接入资料，资料来自
[models.dev](https://models.dev/api.json) 的 `opencode-go` 目录；这个请求不携带 API 密钥。
接口地址固定在 OpenCode 官方域名，忽略外部资料中的自定义地址。支持 Chat
Completions、Responses、Anthropic Messages 和 Google Generative AI 四种协议。

刷新后可选择启用的模型，点击“保存模型”才修改配置。网络失败、缺少资料或遇到尚未
支持的协议时保留原配置，不按名字猜测接口。已有模型的接口与能力定义保持稳定；
变更这些定义仍需要升级插件。

验证过的公开模型资料保存在系统用户缓存目录的 `dsh-opencode-go-second/catalog.json`，
不写入项目或 Git 仓库，不保存密钥。重启时可从本地资料恢复；缓存丢失或损坏时，
先提供已有资料的模型，点击“获取可用模型”可恢复其余模型。
空模型列表恢复插件默认目录；移除供应商配置会停用该连接。

接口依据：[OpenCode Go 官方端点说明](https://opencode.ai/v2/docs/console/go/#endpoints)。

## 验证

运行 `npm test` 验证实际官方适配器/SDK 对 38 个模型的接口选择、密钥与会话
隔离、流式解析、错误结果、设置注册、模型发现和第一套迁移保持不变。
还覆盖启动时不发起查询、不创建刷新计时器、手动发现不自动保存，以及缓存、
Gemini 思考等级、认证、工具回放，以及传输不响应取消时的流空闲超时。
测试替换网络传输，不产生模型调用费用；通过并不代表 38 个模型都完成了真实推理。
实际可用性受账号权限、额度、地区和服务端状态影响。

## 回退

部署前在 desktop profile 的 `backups` 目录保留原 `package.json`、
`cordis.patch.yml` 和旧覆盖包链接地址。本机部署记录、备份和日志不进入仓库。
回退时关闭 DSH，恢复这两份备份并恢复旧 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` 链接，
再重启 DSH，即回到迁移前的第二套方案。若迁移后又编辑过其他设置，先保留
当前配置，再只恢复第二套对应条目，避免覆盖后续修改。

## 仓库中的敏感信息处理

仓库不包含真实 API 密钥、密码、个人路径、账号标识、日志或部署备份。
配置中的 `OPENCODE_API_KEY` 等名称是密钥引用，不是密钥值。测试使用虚构
凭据和示例会话标识。依赖目录和本地环境文件由 `.gitignore` 排除。

## 发布新版本

本仓库的 `.github/workflows/publish.yml` 使用 npm Trusted Publisher（OIDC）。
绑定 GitHub 用户 `yfwu2020`、仓库 `dsh-opencode-go-second`、工作流文件名
`publish.yml`，环境名称留空，并允许 `npm publish`；不需要配置 npm 发布密钥。

先同步修改 `package.json` 和 `package-lock.json` 的版本号，提交并推送到 GitHub，
然后为该提交创建同版本的正式 Release（例如版本 `0.3.2` 对应标签 `v0.3.2`）。
工作流检查版本号、安装固定依赖并运行测试，通过后自动发布到 npm 的 `latest`。
普通代码推送和预发布 Release 不会触发正式发布。工作流也可手动指定已有标签重试；
已成功发布的 npm 版本不能重复发布，应检查上次结果后再决定是否重试。

plugins.description: Workspace-level MCP server manager for DeepSeek Harness: one profile-scoped server registry, per-workspace selection, managed from a sidebar panel.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-mcp-mgr

**One MCP registry for the whole profile** — declare an MCP server once, choose it per workspace, and manage every server from a panel in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar.

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

[![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/icrefin/dsh-mcp-mgr?style=flat-square)](LICENSE)
[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/icrefin/dsh-mcp-mgr?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-mcp-mgr/releases)
[![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/icrefin/dsh-mcp-mgr/ci.yml?branch=main&style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-mcp-mgr/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![Last commit](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/icrefin/dsh-mcp-mgr?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-mcp-mgr/commits/main)
[![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/icrefin/dsh-mcp-mgr?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-mcp-mgr/stargazers)
[![PRs welcome](https://img.shields.io/badge/PRs-welcome-brightgreen?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-mcp-mgr/pulls)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22.19-339933?style=flat-square&logo=node.js)](https://nodejs.org)
[![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-0.2.0--rc.2-4B5563?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

> If this plugin saves you a round of hand-editing JSON, a ⭐ star helps the next person find it.

## Why this exists

MCP servers are declared per workspace, so the same server description gets copied into every workspace file that needs it — and drifts. This plugin splits the two questions that were tangled together:

| Question | Where it is answered now |
|---|---|
| *What servers exist?* | once, in a profile-scoped registry |
| *Which ones does this workspace use?* | a `use` list in that workspace's file |

Servers move between the two files without translation, both stay hand-editable, and a workspace that never adopts the plugin keeps working exactly as before: a missing `use` means its inline `mcpServers` mount as they always did.

## Screenshots

![The MCP Servers panel: the global server registry](docs/images/mcp-servers-panel.png)

*Global servers — add, edit, delete, enable or disable a server, with the profile-level `mcp-client` registrations shown as read-only rows.*

![The Workspaces tab: per-workspace server selection](docs/images/mcp-servers-workspaces.png)

*Workspaces — which global servers each workspace selects, plus its own local servers, dangling references and parse errors.*

## The two files

```
<profile>/.dsh/dshmm/mcp-servers.json     every server definition, shared
<workspace>/.dsh/dshmm/mcp.json           `use: [...]` selects from it,
                                          and may still declare inline servers
```

A selected global server mounts once for the whole profile; inline servers mount per workspace. Strict mode mounts only the active workspace's servers.

## Features

| Surface | What it does |
|---|---|
| Sidebar row | sits directly under **Plugins** (`order: 1`) and opens the **MCP Servers** page in the centre column |
| Global servers tab | the registry: add / edit / delete / enable a server, plus the profile-level `mcp-client` registrations as read-only rows |
| Workspaces tab | per-workspace selection as checkboxes, each workspace's own local servers, dangling references, parse errors |
| JSON editing | paste a whole `mcpServers` object or one server's JSON; the host validates it and reports per-entry errors |
| Bulk import | import several servers at once, answering its own report |
| Tools | servers are registered through `mcp-client`; workspace tools use the `mcp__<serverName>__<tool>` convention |
| Panel polish | optimistic selection toggles, a 60-second background refresh, tab and scroll position preserved across reloads, and a version chip carrying the installed plugin version |

## Requirements

- Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`
- A DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2` installation (the plugin composes into a profile)
- `pnpm` 11.8.0 (`packageManager` in the root manifest pins it)

## Installation

Build both packages, pack them and hand them to the profile:

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm check                        # typecheck → build → verify, both packages
sh tools/install-into-profile.sh desktop
```

Restart DeepSeek Harness afterwards; the sidebar entry appears directly under **Plugins**.

There are two packages, and both are Loader rows of their own:

| Package | Role |
|---|---|
| `dsh-mcp-mgr` | the host half: the registry, the sync layer, and the `mcpMgr` Typert Remote contract |
| `dsh-mcp-mgr-ui` | the browser half: the sidebar row and the page it opens |

Installing the host alone leaves the sidebar row without the page it opens, so the two are built and installed together. The packages are not on npm: the profile installs them from this repository.

`dsh plugin` (a pnpm passthrough into the profile directory) is what the script uses; the Plugins page does the same thing. The desktop profile is owned by the Electron application, so `dsh --profile desktop` itself refuses to compose it, while `dsh plugin` still works.

## Quick start

1. Open **MCP Servers** in the sidebar.
2. On **Global servers**, add a server — by form or by pasting JSON:

   ```json
   {
     "shared-http-server": {
       "type": "http",
       "url": "https://mcp.example.com/mcp"
     }
   }
   ```

3. Switch to **Workspaces** and tick that server for the workspaces that should see it.
4. Restart, or let the panel's refresh confirm the new snapshot; the server's tools appear as `mcp__shared-http-server__*`.

## Configuration

Rules that apply to either file:

- a missing `type` is treated as Streamable HTTP; `${VAR}` expansion is supported;
- a stdio server without `cwd` uses the workspace root;
- `serverName` must match `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,32}$` and is globally unique — duplicates surface as conflicts;
- `"enabled": false` disables an entry without removing it; absent means enabled.

The profile registry is created on the first save from the panel. Neither file has to be created by hand.

## Remote surface

Fourteen methods on the `mcpMgr` namespace, declared once in `src/typert.descriptors.ts` and wrapped as the host manifest and the browser contribution, so the two faces cannot disagree about a wire name or a codec:

| Method | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `version` | this package's installed version, for the title chip |
| `snapshot` | the whole management view |
| `setStrictMode` · `setActiveWorkspace` | gateway state, answering the refreshed snapshot |
| `apply` · `removeServer` · `setServerEnabled` | workspace-local servers |
| `saveGlobalServer` · `saveGlobalServerJson` · `removeGlobalServer` · `setGlobalServerEnabled` | the global registry |
| `setWorkspaceSelection` · `importLocalServer` | which servers a workspace selects |
| `importJson` | bulk import, answering its own report |

## Caveats

- **"Connected" means the tools are registered** (`mcp__<name>__*` present in the tool registry), not that the network is live. `mcp-client` exposes no live connection state, so a real disconnect cannot be detected without changing dsh itself. A connection that drops keeps its last tool generation and reconnects with backoff.
- **The refresh button re-reads the host's last snapshot**; it does not probe.
- The plugin polls no registry and offers no self-update: the panel shows its installed version, and updating means rebuilding and reinstalling it here.

## License and attribution

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE). The host and UI packages derive from `dsh-mcp-mgr` 0.2.0 by **yangfch3** (MIT); that copyright line is kept in the LICENSE file, and this repository is an independent, source-built rewrite rather than a vendored copy of the published bundle.

The panel registers into the same slots dsh's own pages use (`sidebar.panellist` and `main`), and follows the platform's `STYLES.md` contract for page geometry and the version chip.

> Stars are how small projects survive. If this one earned yours, tap ⭐ — it costs nothing and helps someone else find it.

plugins.description: 适用于DeepSeek Harness的供应商模型账户用量查询插件
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-model-usage

适用于 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的**供应商模型账户用量查询插件**。

它在会话页面头部放一个「用量」入口，点开即可看到**当前对话所用模型**对应供应商账户的用量
——余额、套餐窗口、已用额度、信用余额；也可以手动切到任意可路由的模型，去查别的供应商的额度，
不必再逐个打开各家控制台。

- 插件包本体：[`model-usage/`](model-usage/)（包名 `dsh-model-usage`）
- 功能细节（原理、凭据解析、各家用量接口、刷新策略、面板内容、安装步骤）：
  [model-usage/README.md](model-usage/README.md)
- 许可证：[MIT](LICENSE)

## 仓库结构

| 路径 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| [`model-usage/`](model-usage/) | 插件包本体：node 半负责用量查询与 loopback Web 路由，浏览器半负责会话头部入口与弹窗面板 |
| [`model-usage/README.md`](model-usage/README.md) | 插件层功能说明，是使用与二次开发的主要文档 |
| [`LICENSE`](LICENSE) | MIT License |

## 快速开始

安装与挂载步骤见[插件说明](model-usage/README.md#安装)，概括为三步：

1. 把 `model-usage/` 作为插件包装进 DSH profile（`dsh plugin add <插件目录绝对路径>`，
   或直接复制 / 建 junction 到 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-model-usage`）；
2. 在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `insert` 里挂载入口 `dsh-model-usage`；
3. 重启 `dsh web`（host 半生效），浏览器硬刷新（浏览器半生效）。

## 参与贡献

**这个项目友善地欢迎开源合作，也欢迎任何人提交 PR。**
无论是新增一家供应商的用量适配器、修掉一个边界情况、改进文案与文档，还是指出我们写错的字段名，
都同样有价值；哪怕只是把某家接口的真实返回贴给我们做校准，也是实打实的帮助。

- **新供应商适配**：在 `model-usage/lib/index.js` 里认领一个 query kind（`kindOf()` 按 host / provider 判定）、
  写一个归一化函数（`{ rows }` / `{ windows, models }`），客户端会自动用通用卡片渲染；
  已支持的路由与接口形态见[用量接口](model-usage/README.md#用量接口)。
- **未文档化的接口**：如果某家用量接口没有公开文档，欢迎在 PR 描述里附上脱敏后的真实返回，
  我们会据此收敛字段名，而不是靠猜。
- **提交方式**：fork 本仓库 → 建一个语义清晰的分支 → 提交 PR，并在描述里写清「解决什么、怎么验证、影响哪些路由」。
  状态类改动请附上截图或最小复现步骤。
- **协作方式**：我们会对每个 PR 认真 review、尽量及时回复；分歧时优先讨论方案而不是互相消耗。
  提交即表示同意你的贡献以本仓库的 [MIT 许可](LICENSE)发布。
- 还不确定怎么改也没关系，先开 issue 描述你看到的场景与期望行为，我们一起来定方案。

## 许可证与生态

本项目以 [MIT License](LICENSE) 发布。

- 上游 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 同样以 **MIT** 许可发布，
  与本仓库一致，因此代码可以在两个方向自由复用；若将来某个适配器被官方收录，也不存在许可障碍。
- 本项目是**独立的社区插件**，与深度求索公司无隶属、合作或背书关系；
  "DeepSeek Harness" 是深度求索公司的注册商标，本仓库仅在描述性文字中说明兼容关系。
  命名遵循官方[品牌素材使用规范](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/BRAND_GUIDELINES.zh.md)，
  使用 `DSH` 缩写而非完整商标。
- 如果你是插件作者，可以在自己的仓库上添加 `dsh-plugin` 话题，方便社区检索（官方推荐做法）。

plugins.description: Personal Agent Skills, Pi & DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugins
plugins.readme_text:
# agent-stash

[![CI](https://github.com/Alice39s/agent-stash/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Alice39s/agent-stash/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![Sync init prompts](https://github.com/Alice39s/agent-stash/actions/workflows/sync-init-prompts.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Alice39s/agent-stash/actions/workflows/sync-init-prompts.yml)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/Alice39s/agent-stash)](LICENSE)
[![Last commit](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/Alice39s/agent-stash)](https://github.com/Alice39s/agent-stash/commits/main)
[![pi package](https://img.shields.io/badge/pi-package-111111)](https://pi.dev)
[![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-4d6bfe)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
[![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D24-339933?logo=nodedotjs&logoColor=white)](https://nodejs.org)
[![pnpm](https://img.shields.io/badge/pnpm-11-f69220?logo=pnpm&logoColor=white)](https://pnpm.io)
[![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-strict-3178c6?logo=typescript&logoColor=white)](tsconfig.json)

自用的 Agent Skills、[pi](https://pi.dev) 扩展与 [DSH（DeepSeek Harness）](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)插件合集。

## 目录

| 路径                   | 内容                                                                              |
| ---------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `src/`                 | pi 与 DSH 共用的实现                                                              |
| `pi/extensions/`       | pi 扩展，由 `package.json` 的 `pi.extensions` 声明                                |
| `dsh/`                 | DSH 插件源码、`cordis.patch.yml`、本地化文案与图标                                |
| `dist/`                | DSH 插件的构建产物，由 `pnpm build` 生成，随仓库提交                              |
| `vendor/init-prompts/` | 从上游仓库同步的 `/init` prompt、许可证与 `manifest.json`，由脚本生成，不手动修改 |
| `scripts/`             | 同步脚本                                                                          |

## 安装

### pi

```bash
pi install git:github.com/Alice39s/agent-stash
```

只在当前会话试用：

```bash
pi -e git:github.com/Alice39s/agent-stash
```

### DSH

DeepSeek Harness 桌面版：在「插件」页点「添加插件」，填入 `github:Alice39s/agent-stash` 后安装。

命令行：把仓库作为 bundle 装进某个 profile，例如 Web 界面使用的 `web`：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Alice39s/agent-stash
```

`dist/` 已随仓库提交，安装时不需要构建。DSH 的斜杠命令目前只在 Web 界面与桌面版里可用。

## `/init`

让 agent 分析当前项目并写出 `AGENTS.md`，prompt 取自其他 coding agent 的开源实现。pi 与 DSH 的用法相同。

```text
/init                         使用默认预设
/init kimi-code               使用 kimi-code 预设
/init opencode 重点写测试流程    使用 opencode 预设并附加额外指令
/init 用中文写                 第一个词不是预设名时，整段文字作为默认预设的额外指令
```

pi：

- 输入 `/init ` 后，补全菜单列出每个预设及其上游来源，默认预设标出 `(default)`。
- 选中预设后，菜单提示可以继续输入 `[extra prompt]`。

DSH：

- 命令菜单列出全部预设，默认预设标出 `(default)`。
- 输入框提示可用的预设名，例如 `[codex|kimi-code|opencode] [extra prompt]`。
- 预设列表在 DSH 加载插件时生成，修改配置后要重启 DSH 才会更新。

### 内置预设

| 预设            | 上游                                                            | 文件                                                              | 许可证     |
| --------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------- |
| `codex`（默认） | [openai/codex](https://github.com/openai/codex)                 | `codex-rs/tui/assets/prompt_for_init_command.md`                  | Apache-2.0 |
| `kimi-code`     | [MoonshotAI/kimi-code](https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-code) | `packages/agent-core-v2/src/features/sessionInit/profile/init.md` | MIT        |
| `opencode`      | [anomalyco/opencode](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode)     | `packages/core/src/plugin/command/initialize.txt`                 | MIT        |

每个预设对应的上游 commit 记录在 `vendor/init-prompts/manifest.json`。

### 额外指令与占位符

模板里的占位符在发送前替换：

- `${path}`：当前项目目录。DSH 里取会话的当前工作目录。
- `$ARGUMENTS`：额外指令。

模板没有 `$ARGUMENTS` 时，额外指令追加到 prompt 末尾的 `## Additional instructions from the user` 小节。

### 配置

配置文件按以下顺序读取，后读的覆盖先读的。

pi：

1. `~/.pi/agent/agent-stash/init.json`（设置了 `PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR` 时为 `$PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR/agent-stash/init.json`）
2. `<项目>/.pi/agent-stash/init.json`，仅在项目受信任时读取

DSH：

1. `$DSH_HOME/agent-stash/init.json`（未设置 `DSH_HOME` 时为 `~/.dsh/agent-stash/init.json`）

```json
{
  "defaultPreset": "team",
  "presets": {
    "team": {
      "file": "./team-init.md",
      "description": "团队的 AGENTS.md 模板"
    }
  }
}
```

- `defaultPreset`：不写预设名时使用的预设，默认为 `codex`。
- `presets`：自定义预设。`file` 是相对配置文件所在目录的路径，同名预设覆盖内置预设。`description` 显示在补全菜单里，不写时显示文件路径。

配置格式错误或默认预设不存在时，`/init` 直接报错。

## 上游同步

`.github/workflows/sync-init-prompts.yml` 每天运行一次，也可以手动触发。它拉取各上游默认分支最新 commit 中的 prompt 与根目录的 LICENSE、NOTICE 文件，运行检查后向 `chore/sync-init-prompts` 分支开 PR。

仓库需要在 Settings → Actions → General 中开启「Allow GitHub Actions to create and approve pull requests」，workflow 才能创建 PR。

本地同步：

```bash
GITHUB_TOKEN=<token> pnpm sync:init-prompts
```

上游列表在 `scripts/sync-init-prompts.ts` 的 `SOURCES` 中维护。

## 开发

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm check    # oxfmt --check、oxlint 类型检查与 vitest
pnpm build    # 用 tsdown 生成 dist/dsh/init.js
pnpm format
```

改动 `src/` 或 `dsh/` 后要运行 `pnpm build` 并提交 `dist/`。CI 会重新构建，`dist/` 与源码不一致时失败。

## 许可证

本仓库使用 [Apache License 2.0](LICENSE)。`vendor/init-prompts/` 下的文件沿用各自上游的许可证，许可证原文与上游 prompt 放在同一目录。

plugins.description: Read-only CSV/XLSX change review for DeepSeek Harness: align business keys, inspect values and formulas, and export review comments.
plugins.readme_text:
# SheetDiff

Review spreadsheet changes before trusting them.

SheetDiff compares two CSV or XLSX files by a business key, not by row position. It produces a local HTML report where you can inspect values, types, formulas and stored formula results, then leave comments for a follow-up with your agent.

It is an independent DeepSeek Harness plugin. It also has a small CLI. It does not edit workbooks, calculate formulas, upload data, or require an API key.

![Local review report showing a formula change and an exported comment](docs/review-demo.jpg)

## Try it locally

Requires Node.js 22.19 or newer. Clone the repository and try the synthetic demo:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/po-et/dsh-sheet-diff.git
cd dsh-sheet-diff
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm test
npm run demo
```

The demo writes two **synthetic** workbooks and a `report.html` to a new directory under `artifacts/`. Open the printed report path in a browser. The expected result is three added rows and four changed cells: two amounts, one formula with a changed stored result, and one number changed to text. Reordering rows and columns adds no changes.

For your own files:

```sh
node src/cli.js before.xlsx after.xlsx --key OrderID --out review-001
node src/cli.js examples/before.csv examples/after.csv --key OrderID --out review-csv
```

`--out` must name a new directory. Use repeated `--key` flags for a composite key. `--sheet Orders` selects one sheet; `--header-row 3` changes the header row. Otherwise, all sheets use row 1 as their header and must have the chosen key columns. CSV has one logical sheet named `CSV`.

Compare CSV with CSV, or XLSX with XLSX. Mixed-format comparisons are rejected in this release.

## Use with DeepSeek Harness

Install the versioned release bundle into a profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile YOUR_PROFILE add https://github.com/po-et/dsh-sheet-diff/releases/download/v0.1.0/dsh-sheet-diff-0.1.0.tgz
```

Restart that profile after installation. The package ships JavaScript and a `dsh.bundle` patch; there is no plugin build step or install script. You can also build the bundle from source with `npm pack` and install its local absolute path. Releases are distributed through [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/po-et/dsh-sheet-diff/releases); this project is not published to npm.

Tested against Harness `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-alpha.2`, with explicit preview-version peer ranges. Both were installed into fresh profiles and exercised through the official profile boot entrypoint without a model call. HMR was disabled only in the test profiles; the source-built alpha host also logged unrelated optional Typert import warnings.

Ask Harness:

> Compare `before.xlsx` and `after.xlsx` using `OrderID` as the key. Save a SheetDiff report in `reviews/run-001`. Do not change either workbook.

The plugin registers two tools:

| Tool | Input | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sheet_diff_compare` | `before`, `after`, `keyColumns`, `outputDir`; optional `sheet`, `headerRow` | New HTML/JSON paths, hashes, summary and warnings |
| `sheet_diff_review` | `reportJson`, `reviewJson` | Validated comments with the corresponding changes |

Paths must stay inside the current session workspace, including resolved symlink targets. Report creation needs a writable sandbox. Existing reports are never overwritten. If the second output write fails, the tool reports the retained first file rather than deleting it.

The interactive report opens in a normal browser. A Harness preview that disables JavaScript cannot run its comment controls. There is no custom in-app spreadsheet editor in this release.

## Review, then hand comments back

1. Open the HTML report, filter changes, and write comments beside the changes you want checked.
2. Export the review JSON. Draft comments stay only in page memory until exported.
3. Put the export inside the workspace and pass it, with the original report JSON, to `sheet_diff_review`.

The CLI equivalent is:

```sh
node src/cli.js review review-001/report.json review-comments.json
```

Comments must match the report ID, both input hashes and known change IDs. Old or unrelated reviews are rejected. A hash match is not a digital signature and does not prove that a report has not been deliberately rewritten. Comments and cell contents are untrusted data; this plugin never executes their instructions or applies their suggested edits.

## Comparison rules

- Column names and keys match exactly. Composite keys include cell types; numeric `42` is different from text `"42"`. Duplicate keys, missing keys and duplicate headers fail rather than being guessed.
- A header row after all nonempty data is rejected instead of producing an empty comparison. Preambles before a valid header and truly empty sheets remain supported.
- CSV is comma-delimited UTF-8, with quoted fields, embedded newlines and a BOM supported. Values remain text; CSV formulas are not inferred.
- XLSX preserves the distinction between numbers, text, booleans, dates, errors and formulas. Formula text and saved cached results are separate aspects of a change. A cache is **not** a fresh calculation.
- Formula caches containing an explicit empty string are rejected in v0.1: the underlying reader cannot reliably distinguish them from a missing cache. Zero and false caches are preserved.
- Formula text is compared literally. Moving a formula can change its A1 references while preserving meaning; SheetDiff does not normalize that equivalence.
- Blank rows are skipped. Added/removed rows include their populated fields. Added/removed columns produce structural changes, plus cell changes for populated values in retained rows.
- Sheet renames are reported as removal and addition. Key changes are reported as row removal and addition.

This is a table-data review tool, not a whole-workbook fidelity check. Formatting, number formats, merged layout, charts, pivots, images, comments and hyperlink targets are outside its scope. Hidden data is still read; visibility itself is not compared. Legacy XLS, macros, encrypted archives and external workbook connections are unsupported. Complex multi-table sheets may need to be exported to separate tables first.

## Limits and privacy

Inputs are capped at 20 MiB each, XLSX expanded contents at 64 MiB and 8 MiB per ZIP part, and comparisons at 10,000 change records or 24 MiB of serialized changes. The parser also caps serialized cells/rows at 100,000 and checks expanded merge, column and validation ranges before parsing. Exceeding a limit fails the comparison; a shortened report is never presented as complete.

Reports include changed cell data, source filenames and hashes. Treat HTML, report JSON and review JSON as sensitive as the workbooks. Sharing is manual. The page has no remote resources, analytics or automatic persistence. When used inside an AI host, tool results and imported comments may be sent to that host's configured model as part of its normal operation.

## Development

```sh
npm test
npm run smoke:host
npm pack --dry-run
```

`smoke:host` loads the shipped patch using a real Cordis loader and dispatches both tools through the real tool runtime, filesystem provider and sandbox policy. It also checks source bytes, overwrite rejection and plugin disposal. It uses a fresh temporary workspace; it does not change an existing Harness profile. The test is separate from a full CLI installation and does not use a live model.

## 中文简介

AI 改完表格后，先看清楚改了什么，再决定是否采用。SheetDiff 按订单号、账户号等业务主键对齐记录，避免把行列重排当成大量修改；数值、类型、公式和保存的计算结果分开显示。你可以在本地报告中逐条评论，导出后交回 Harness 继续处理。

首版只读 CSV/XLSX，不上传表格、不重算公式、不自动改文件。它不是表格编辑器，也不承诺检测格式、图表或所有 Excel 功能的变化。

MIT licensed. Bug reports are most useful with a small anonymized example and the expected comparison result. Please do not post confidential workbooks.

plugins.description: dsh-tool-tsfork — part of the hy-sde/dsh-plugins monorepo (DeepSeek Harness plugin).
plugins.readme_text:
<!-- MIRROR-NOTE:START -->
> [!NOTE]
> 📦 This plugin lives in the [**dsh-plugins**](https://github.com/hy-sde/dsh-plugins) monorepo — file issues & pull requests there.
> npm: [`@hy-sde-org/dsh-tool-tsfork`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@hy-sde-org/dsh-tool-tsfork)
<!-- MIRROR-NOTE:END -->

# dsh-tool-tsfork — Go-native TypeScript compiler devices for DeepSeek Harness

A standalone package, installable as **one plugin** (two device tools) for the
DeepSeek Harness: model-facing devices over a **parked Go-native TypeScript
compiler** — the [can1357/TypeScript](https://github.com/can1357/TypeScript)
perf fork (`perf/checker-speedups-v3`, TS `7.1.0-dev`). `tsfork_status`
reports the binary, version banner and build stamp; `tsfork_check` runs
one-shot `-b` project-graph checks with parsed diagnostics, wall time, and a
GOMAXPROCS cap. The compiler binary is built once and parked on the host; the
plugin only speaks the harness device seam — zero upstream harness changes.

| Identity | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Package | `@hy-sde-org/dsh-tool-tsfork` |
| Plugin id | `hy-sde-tsfork` |
| Devices | `tsfork_status` · `tsfork_check` (device-catalog tools via `dyn`) |

> **Based on [can1357/TypeScript](https://github.com/can1357/TypeScript)**
> (`perf/checker-speedups-v3`, a Go rewrite of
> [microsoft/TypeScript](https://github.com/microsoft/TypeScript), Apache-2.0
> lineage): no compiler code is ported or modified — this package is original
> plugin code that spawns the binary once per call over a stable CLI contract
> (`tsc -b`, JSON-free default output). Adapted, not ported: the harness
> device seam (`device: true` tools via `ctx.tools` + `ctx.systemPrompt`)
> exists so a deployment can expose a fast compiler without touching the
> repo's pinned toolchain. See
> [THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md](THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md).

## Why

The type gate on a large workspace is the stock `tsc -b` over the whole
solution graph — on the fork harness's 337-project host graph that was
**54.25s cold** (91.6s CPU, 4.6GB peak), and every agent that wants a
typecheck pays it serially. The Go compiler checks the same graph
byte-identically (project listings, 14/14 planted errors, deterministic
output) in **7.05s cold / ~0.6s warm** — 7.7× less wall time, 3.4× less CPU.
But nothing in a harness exposes it: gates run through `pnpm` scripts pinned
to `typescript@6.0.3`, and a plugin cannot replace a repo's own toolchain —
nor should it, because oxlint `typeAware` and the typert generator need the
JS API that TS 7 (a Go binary) does not ship. What agents need is a *device*
pointing at a parked binary: loadable per deployment, unloadable by toggling
one row, structured output, no PATH tricks, no upstream changes — while the
pinned toolchain stays exactly as pinned.

## Prerequisites

- Node.js **22.19 or newer** (the package's `engines` floor) with pnpm on `PATH`;
- a DeepSeek Harness installation with the device catalog (the package's peer
  baseline is `@deepseek-ai/cordis ~4.0.5-alpha.1`,
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` / `@deepseek-ai/dsh-system-prompt`
  `^0.2.1-alpha.2`; registries without the device concept simply present the
  tools eagerly);
- a tsfork compiler binary parked on the host (default `~/.dsh/tsfork/tsc`)
  with a `VERSION` stamp beside it — build it once from a checkout of the
  fork:

  ```bash
  git clone https://github.com/can1357/TypeScript.ts.git typescript.ts   # or your fork
  cd typescript.ts && git checkout perf/checker-speedups-v3
  go build -o ~/.dsh/tsfork/tsc ./cmd/tsc        # inside the tsc/ dir of the checkout
  printf 'source: can1357/TypeScript perf/checker-speedups-v3 @ <commit>\n' > ~/.dsh/tsfork/VERSION
  ```

  (the Go tree ships its generated files — no generate step; Go 1.27+)

## Quick start

### Route A — published npm package (recommended)

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @hy-sde-org/dsh-tool-tsfork
```

> Publishing after the Shape-A trial — until then use Route B.

### Route B — from source (validate this checkout or hack on the plugin)

```bash
git clone git@github.com:hy-sde/dsh-plugins.git
cd dsh-plugins/dsh-tool-tsfork/packages/tool-tsfork
pnpm install
PACKAGE_TARBALL="$(pnpm pack | tail -n 1)"
dsh plugin --profile web add "$PWD/$PACKAGE_TARBALL"
cd ../../../..
```

Deployment variant used for the trial (no `dsh` CLI on PATH, hand-managed
profile): link the built package into the profile with an absolute `file:`
path — `pnpm add file:<abs-path-to-package>` in the profile dir, then add
`@hy-sde-org/dsh-tool-tsfork` to `dsh.profile.bundles`. The package's own
`dsh.bundle.patch` mounts the `hy-sde-tsfork` row.

### Verify the composed configuration

```bash
dsh web --dump-config
```

### Run

Start the harness (`dsh web`) and ask the agent to check or probe a graph.
The model-facing calls (device catalog — `dyn search tsfork`):

- `tsfork_status` (no arguments) — resolved binary, `Version 7.1.0-dev`
  banner, build stamp from `<binaryDir>/VERSION`, 20s health probe.
- `tsfork_check` — `tsc -b <project>`; returns `exitCode`, `wallMs`,
  `errorCount`/`warningCount`, parsed `diagnostics` (`file:line:col TSxxxx`),
  an `outputTail`, and a reproducible `command`. `dry: true` prepends
  `--dry` (list the projects a build would run, without building). Pass
  `cwd` (and `project`) explicitly outside the deployment's default checkout.

### Uninstall

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove @hy-sde-org/dsh-tool-tsfork
```

## What the bundle does

The plugin's `cordis.patch.yml` mounts **one plain agent-plane row**
(`hy-sde-tsfork`) that consumes the deployment's host services — `tools` and
`systemPrompt` (the stock agent bundle provides both). No service, realm, or
filesystem seam of its own: each call spawns the parked compiler once, so
concurrent agent lanes are isolated by construction and the only shared-box
knob is GOMAXPROCS. It also registers the `tsfork:tools` prompt section,
which documents the buildinfo gotcha and the adoption boundary to every
session that mounts the device.

## Engine behavior

- **One-shot spawn, stdin closed.** Every call is `spawn(binary, argv)` with
  `stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe']` — the compiler never reads stdin, and
  a held-open pipe is the classic CLI-wrapper hang.
- **Flag order.** The Go parser requires `-b`/`--build` to precede the
  project path; post-project flags (`--dry`, …) are accepted after it. A
  bare `tsc <tsconfig>` (no `-b`) fails with TS5112 — the plugin always
  sends `-b` first.
- **Timeout semantics.** SIGTERM at `timeoutMs`, SIGKILL 5s later — the
  escalation is scheduled *by* the timeout, never at spawn. A timed-out run
  resolves with `timedOut: true` and the partial output instead of rejecting.
- **Output caps.** stdout/stderr are captured up to `maxOutputBytes` per
  side (default 4 MiB, flagged `outputTruncated`); diagnostics are capped at
  500 with exact counts kept beyond the cap (`diagnosticsTruncated`).
- **`.tsbuildinfo` is compiler-version-tagged.** Alternating `tsfork_check`
  with the repo's stock `tsc -b` invalidates the other side's incremental
  caches — runs go cold. The prompt section warns agents; pick a primary
  and accept the other side paying one cold run.
- **Adoption boundary.** tsfork does not replace the pinned `typescript@6.0.3`
  toolchain: oxlint `typeAware` and typert need the JS API (TS 7's npm
  package is a launcher shim with no `lib/typescript.js`). Promotion, if the
  trial proves out, is a `pnpm` override of the gate binary — not this
  plugin.

## Configuration

| Option | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `binary` | `~/.dsh/tsfork/tsc` | Compiler binary (expandable `~`), must be executable |
| `defaultProject` | — | `-b` project used when a call omits `project` |
| `defaultCwd` | — | Working directory used when a call omits `cwd` |
| `timeoutMs` | `900000` | Per-call process timeout |
| `gomaxprocs` | — | `GOMAXPROCS` written to the child env (lane-friendly parallelism cap) |
| `maxOutputBytes` | `4000000` | Cap on captured stdout/stderr bytes per side |

```yaml
- id: hy-sde-tsfork
  config:
    binary: ~/.dsh/tsfork/tsc
    defaultProject: tsconfig.host.json
    defaultCwd: /path/to/your/checkout
    timeoutMs: 900000
    gomax
