plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-bot-codex-ui

**One install for the DS Bot team + Codex-style sidebar, with their layout conflicts fixed.**

This plugin bundles a modified copy of [ds-bot](https://github.com/Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot)
(Bot team, group chats, memory) and the [dsh-codex-ui](https://github.com/MichengAI/dsh-codex-ui)
sidebar skin into a single DSH plugin. It fixes the visual conflicts that appear when
both are installed separately.

> Built on the shoulders of two giants: [Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot](https://github.com/Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot)
> and [MichengAI/dsh-codex-ui](https://github.com/MichengAI/dsh-codex-ui).

## What you get

- **DS Bot**: a team of long-lived Bots with group chats, memory, capabilities and usage tracking.
- **Codex-style sidebar**: workspace tree, search, turn navigation in a modern layout.
- **Fixed layout**: the composer, sidebar footer, account entry and conversation width
  no longer fight between the two plugins.

## What it fixes

| # | Problem (when both plugins are installed) | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Composer control row misaligned; buttons crowd | Restored the official column structure |
| 2 | Composer internal spacing wrong | Restored the official gap and padding |
| 3 | Bottom control band too tight (buttons nearly touch) | Restored a 10px rhythm |
| 4 | Sidebar footer stacks into two rows | Forced a single flex row |
| 5 | Footer height jumps between surfaces | Locked to 60px |
| 6 | Horizontal divider inconsistent between modes | Declared on the footer itself |
| 7 | Account entry wider than the mode tabs | Single 36px icon; name label hidden |
| 8 | One-way mode switch (only in Agent mode) | Two-tab switcher (Agent / DS Bot) |
| 9 | "Connect plugins" button with a standing red "!" badge | Moved into the account menu; badge retired |
| 10 | Conversation column wider than the classic Agent surface | Removed the local width pin |

## Install

**Install from GitHub** (this package vendors ds-bot via a `file:` dependency,
which means it cannot be published to npm — GitHub is the distribution channel):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Audrey-cn/dsh-bot-codex-ui
```

Or from a local checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add file:/path/to/dsh-bot-codex-ui
```

**Do not install `ds-bot` or `@michengai/dsh-codex-ui` separately** — this plugin
bundles both. Installing them alongside will cause duplicate plugin entries.

## Self-check

Two seconds after mount, the plugin verifies its layout fixes in the rendered DOM:

1. Composer row wrapper exists and is a flex container (not `display:contents`).
2. Sidebar footer is a single flex row.
3. The red warning badge is hidden.
4. The mode tabs rendered.
5. The account entry is a single icon (no name label).

If any check fails, a dismissible red warning appears in the corner and a console
warning lists what went wrong. This prevents **silent failure** — the bugs returning
without any signal.

## Build

```sh
npm run build      # writes client.js
npm run check      # verifies client.js is up to date
```

## Repository layout

```
dsh-bot-codex-ui/
  package.json          dsh.bundle manifest + dependencies
  cordis.patch.yml      mounts codex-ui + ds-bot + our self-check
  index.js              host stub
  src/client/index.js   self-check client plugin
  ds-bot/               vendored ds-bot fork (with the 10 layout fixes)
  client.js             built self-check bundle
  README.md / LICENSE / NOTICE
```

## Upstream versions

| Upstream | Version | Relationship |
|---|---|---|
| ds-bot | 0.1.5 (vendored, modified) | `ds-bot/` directory |
| @michengai/dsh-codex-ui | 1.1.36 (unmodified) | npm dependency |

When ds-bot releases a new version, merge the changes into `ds-bot/` and rebuild.
The layout fixes are in `ds-bot/src/client/`; see the git log for the exact changes.


## Upstream update tracking

Both upstreams release very frequently (ds-bot roughly daily, dsh-codex-ui every
1–2 days), so this plugin can silently fall behind. Two mechanisms prevent that:

### Automated check (GitHub Actions)

A daily workflow runs [`scripts/check-upstream.mjs`](scripts/check-upstream.mjs)
and opens (or updates) a single tracking issue when either upstream has a newer
release. If the issue is no longer relevant, it is closed automatically.

### Local check

```sh
node scripts/check-upstream.mjs                # version check only
node scripts/check-upstream.mjs --test-patch   # also test the patch on new ds-bot
node scripts/check-upstream.mjs --json         # machine-readable
```

`--test-patch` clones the newest ds-bot and attempts to apply
[`ds-bot-local.patch`](ds-bot-local.patch). If the patch applies cleanly the merge
is mechanical; if not, a manual merge is needed (see the merge procedure in
`dsbot-local/SOP.md`).

### Baselines

[`base.json`](base.json) records the upstream release versions this plugin is
built from. The vendored `ds-bot/package.json` can disagree with the npm release
(upstream git tags sometimes carry a different version), so `base.json` is the
authoritative source for the version check.

## License

Apache-2.0. See `LICENSE` and `NOTICE` for third-party attributions and
modification notices.

## Disclaimer

This is an independent community project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by,
or sponsored by DeepSeek, Fei2411, or MichengAI. "DeepSeek", "DS Bot" and "Codex"
are trademarks of their respective owners.

plugins.description: Add a Delete Session action to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, removing the Session log and its projection cache.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-delete

Add a **Delete Session** action to the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) (DSH)
sidebar. Choosing it permanently removes the Session's stored log and its projection cache, and
drops the sidebar row without a page reload.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **This project was written by AI.** The code, this README, and every other file in this
> repository were produced by an AI coding agent (see [AI authorship](#ai-authorship)). It was
> reviewed and tested against a real DSH install before publication, but you should treat it as
> AI-generated software: read the source before you run it, and expect rough edges outside the
> paths that were exercised.

---

## Why this plugin exists

DSH has no API for deleting a Session. As of the versions this was built against:

| Candidate | What it actually does |
| --- | --- |
| `sessionController` (Host `ctx.remote.session`) | `resolveAgent` / `inspect` / `list` / `search` / `create` / `selectModel` / `rename` / `fork` / `prompt` / `cancel` / `page` / `projections` — **no delete** |
| `sessionPersistence` | `create` / `open` / `flush` / `stat` / `list` — an append-only log, **no delete** |
| `workspaceRegistry.delete(id)` | Deletes a *Workspace registration* while deliberately retaining the directory and **every Session log** |
| `sessions` (client) | `retain` / `using` / `refreshProjections` / `search` / `fork` / `scope` / `binding` — **no delete** |

So the only way to offer the feature is to compose the official seams in the right order. This
plugin does exactly that, and nothing else.

## How it works

The Host half registers one loopback route, `POST /plugins/session-delete/delete`, and the browser
half adds a row to each Session's `...` menu that calls it.

Deletion runs as five steps:

1. **Stop the Session** — `workspaceRegistry.archiveSession(id, { stopActivity: true })`. This is
   the official "stop this Session's activity" path; it fans out `workspace/session-stop`, which
   `dsh-agent`, `dsh-jobs`, `dsh-schedule` and `dsh-subagent` all listen to.
2. **Detach the live Session** — `ctx.sessions.store.get(id).detach()`. The store keeps entries in
   a non-public map, and calling the entry's own `detach` is the single seam that raises
   `session/disposed`.
3. **Remove the sidebar row** — `session/disposed` → `api-session/removed`
   (`dsh-api-session-controller`) → `ctx.remote.$on("api-session/removed", …)` on the client. That
   chain is the only reason the row disappears without a reload.
   A **cold** Session (one restored from disk that was never opened in this process) has no store
   entry, so `detach` cannot fire. For that case the plugin emits `api-session/removed` itself —
   the same signal, by the same name. Nothing on the Host listens for that event, so this is
   side-effect free.
4. **Forget the membership** — `detachSession` on every Workspace, plus `unarchiveSession` and
   `unpinSession`, so no archived or pinned ghost survives.
5. **Remove the bytes** — the artifact directory under `$DSH_HOME/sessions/<encoded-cwd>/<id>/`
   and the projection cache at `$DSH_HOME/storages/session_projcache/sessions/<id>.json`.

The SQLite session index is *derived* from persistence state, so it converges on its own during the
next reconcile — the plugin does not touch it.

### Files touched on disk

Everything the plugin removes lives under `$DSH_HOME` (default `~/.dsh`):

```
$DSH_HOME/
  sessions/<encoded-cwd>/<session-id>/session.v4.jsonl[.zstd]   <- removed
  storages/session_projcache/sessions/<session-id>.json         <- removed
  storages/workspace.json                                       <- membership updated in place
```

## Install

The plugin installs as a **profile bundle**, using DSH's own plugin command:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Smile-Wood/dsh-session-delete
```

From a local checkout instead of a git host:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add C:\path\to\dsh-session-delete
```

Use the profile you actually launch DSH with (`web` is the DSH Desktop default, and is also what
`dsh plugin …` assumes when you omit `--profile`). `dsh` is a shim into the packaged CLI, placed on
`PATH` once DSH Desktop has been started at least once.

> [!NOTE]
> **The repository must be public for the `github:` shorthand.** pnpm probes the HTTPS URL first and
> only falls back to SSH when that probe fails, which is what happens for a private repository or a
> nonexistent one. On a machine where outbound SSH (port 22) is blocked, that fallback fails with
> `ssh: connect to host github.com port 22: Connection refused`. For a private repository, use an
> explicit HTTPS spec and let git's credential helper authenticate:
>
> ```sh
> dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/Smile-Wood/dsh-session-delete.git
> ```

Then reload the DSH page in your browser so it picks up the browser bundle, and open a Session's
`...` menu in the sidebar. **DSH itself does not need restarting.**

To update after new commits land, re-run the same command:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Smile-Wood/dsh-session-delete
```

Re-running `add` *is* the update path: pnpm re-resolves the ref, and a changed shipped file lands in
a new content-addressed store directory, so DSH imports a **new module URL** and the Host half
genuinely reloads. See [Host reload semantics](#host-reload-semantics).

To remove it again:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-session-delete
```

That prunes the dependency, drops the name from `dsh.profile.bundles`, and unloads both halves —
verified live: the route stops answering and the browser bundle leaves the client-module graph.

> [!NOTE]
> For a **local-path** install the profile entry is a `link:`, and pnpm was observed to leave the
> symlink at `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-session-delete` behind after a `remove`.
> It is inert, but delete it by hand if you want the tree clean. Git installs are unaffected.

### What `dsh plugin add` actually does

`dsh plugin` is a thin front end for pnpm: it forwards its arguments to pnpm **inside the profile
directory** (`$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/`). The part that makes the plugin load is what DSH does
next — it reconciles the profile manifest and, for every dependency that was just added and declares
a `dsh.bundle.patch`, appends its package name to `dsh.profile.bundles`:

```jsonc
// $DSH_HOME/profiles/web/package.json, after the add
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-session-delete": "git+https://github.com/Smile-Wood/dsh-session-delete.git"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": [
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-base",
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app",
        "…existing bundles…",
        "dsh-session-delete"        // <- appended by the add
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

`dsh.profile.bundles` is the **only** thing that decides what loads. That array is why one command
is sufficient and no `$DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml` row is required.

A dependency that declares no `dsh.bundle` is installed as a plain dependency and skipped, with a
warning:

```
dsh: warning: <name> declares no dsh.bundle — installed as a plain dependency, not a profile layer
```

The bundled [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml) is the patch this profile layer reads:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: session-delete
      name: 'dsh-session-delete'
```

`name` is the **package name**, not a path — the profile resolves it from its own `node_modules`.

> [!NOTE]
> `client.js` registers itself under the name `dsh-session-delete`, which must stay
> **character-for-character identical** to `name` in `package.json`. client-modules derives the
> browser bundle's id from the enclosing `package.json` and rejects a bundle that registers under
> anything else — and the only symptom is a menu row that silently never appears.

## Host reload semantics

Node's ESM registry caches modules by **resolved URL** and offers no invalidation hook. That has one
practical consequence:

> **Editing an installed `host.js` in place does not take effect in a running DSH.**

How much that bites depends on how you installed:

- **From git**, pnpm copies the package into its content-addressed store. A changed file produces a
  new store dire

plugins.description: Profile-level skill manager for DeepSeek Harness: a flat skill inventory with enable/disable, discovery diagnostics and a restorable trash, in a sidebar panel.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-skill-mgr

**Every skill in one list** — the whole profile inventory in a sidebar panel: see what is installed, read a skill's body, enable or disable it, repair a discovery problem, and delete it into a trash you can restore from.

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

[![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/icrefin/dsh-skill-mgr?style=flat-square)](LICENSE)
[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/icrefin/dsh-skill-mgr?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-skill-mgr/releases)
[![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/icrefin/dsh-skill-mgr/ci.yml?branch=main&style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-skill-mgr/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![Last commit](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/icrefin/dsh-skill-mgr?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-skill-mgr/commits/main)
[![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/icrefin/dsh-skill-mgr?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-skill-mgr/stargazers)
[![PRs welcome](https://img.shields.io/badge/PRs-welcome-brightgreen?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-skill-mgr/pulls)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22.19-339933?style=flat-square&logo=node.js)](https://nodejs.org)
[![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-0.2.0--rc.2-4B5563?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

> If this plugin saves you a hunt through `~/.dsh/skills`, a ⭐ star helps the next person find it.

## Why this exists

A skill is a folder with a discovery file in it, which is easy to create and hard to keep track of: which ones exist, which are currently switched off (a renamed file is invisible, not absent), which one has a broken frontmatter, and which are duplicates across the two writable roots. This plugin is the one place that answers those questions, without an editor open and without hand-renaming files.

**Enabled is the default, and disabling is a filesystem fact first.** The discovery file is renamed (`SKILL.md` → `SKILL.md.disabled`, or `<name>.md` → `<name>.md.disabled`) so the filesystem provider simply stops seeing it; a registry record is what lets the panel still list it and switch it back on.

## Screenshots

![The Skills panel: the flat profile inventory](docs/images/skills-panel.png)

*Skills — one flat table over the profile inventory (enabled and disabled alike), with search, a source filter, use-count and last-used chips, the discovery diagnostics and the restorable trash.*

![The detail view of one skill](docs/images/skill-detail.png)

*Inspect — the skill's body and metadata, with the enable/disable action for a disabled skill.*

## The registry file

```
<profile>/.dsh/dshsk/skills.json      the profile's skill management state
```

One registry holds everything the manager persists: the disabled-skill records, the trash, and the statistics checkpoint. It is reconciled at startup — a `.disabled` file with no record is adopted (an upgraded or hand-edited install), and a record whose file is gone is dropped. Writes go through an atomic same-directory temp file (`wx`, mode `0600`, then `rename`), and a read that hits unparsable JSON refuses to overwrite it and reports why.

## Features

| Surface | What it does |
|---|---|
| Sidebar row | sits directly under **Plugins** (`order: 1`) and opens the **Skills** page in the centre column |
| Skills table | one flat table of the profile inventory — Name / Source / Description / Status / Actions — with search, sorting and a source filter |
| Enable / disable | renames the discovery file and keeps the record, so the row stays visible (dimmed) and can be switched back on |
| Inspect | reads a skill's body and metadata without leaving the GUI |
| Add skill | scaffolds a new skill in a writable root |
| Discovery diagnostics | lists the skills the provider cannot see, and auto-fixes the repairable ones in place |
| Restorable trash | `Delete` moves a skill into the root's `.trash`; the panel lists it with a Restore action, and clearing the trash is explicit |
| Chat `/` menu dots | marks each candidate row as model-invocable or user-invocable, coloured from the same settings the panel reads |
| Settings card | the plugin's own configuration, in the Plugins manager |
| Attribution | the title chip carries the installed version and the author credit |

## Requirements

- Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`
- A DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2` installation (the plugin composes into a profile)
- `pnpm` 11.8.0 (`packageManager` in the manifest pins it)

## Installation

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm check                        # typecheck → build → tests → verifiers
pnpm pack                         # dist/dsh-skill-mgr-<version>.tgz
sh tools/install-into-profile.sh desktop
```

Restart DeepSeek Harness afterwards; the sidebar entry appears directly under **Plugins**.

The package is not on npm: the profile installs it from this repository. `dsh plugin` (a pnpm passthrough into the profile directory) is what the script uses, and the Plugins page does the same thing. The desktop profile is owned by the Electron application, so `dsh --profile desktop` itself refuses to compose it, while `dsh plugin` still works.

Upgrading from `dsh-skill-hub`? The two packages must not both be installed — they would both claim the plugin-config card. Remove the old bundle first; the new plugin adopts the old state file on its first load and leaves it untouched.

## Quick start

1. Open **Skills** in the sidebar. The table lists every skill in `~/.dsh/skills` and `~/.agents/skills`.
2. Search for a skill; select **Inspect** to read it, or **Disable** to switch it off for the whole profile.
3. Select **Add skill** to scaffold a new one in a writable root.
4. Read the diagnostics banner when something is not being discovered, and use its fix action on the repairable entries.

## Configuration

The Loader entry's config is the settings card; the host reads the same values through their volatile refs.

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | contribute the skill provider and the announcement; the management panel keeps working either way, because it is the surface that turns the plugin back on |
| `announceToAgent` | `true` | register the system-prompt section that tells an agent this manager exists |
| `showUseCount` | `true` | per-skill invocation-count chip |
| `showUseTime` | `true` | per-skill last-used relative time |
| `dotModelColor` | unset | `#rrggbb` for the "model-invocable" dot, in the table and the chat `/` menu |
| `dotUserColor` | unset | `#rrggbb` for the "user-invocable only" dot |
| `statsWindowDays` | `14` | rolling window for the counts; `0` = all history |
| `statsScanMinutes` | `5` | background session-log scan interval, in minutes |

## Remote surface

The browser half reads and writes through one Typert Remote namespace, `skillMgr`. Two conventions cover the whole surface: `snapshot()` is the one read (the panel loads all of its slices from a single call, cached for one render pass), and every write answers `SkillApplyResult` (`{ok:true}` / `{ok:false, error}`) after which the caller refetches.

| Area | Methods |
|---|---|
| Core | `snapshot` |
| Profile inventory | `saveGlobalSkill`, `removeGlobalSkill`, `setGlobalSkillEnabled`, `skillDetail`, `fixDiagnostic`, `skillStats` |
| Trash | `restoreTrashedSkill`, `clearTrash` |

Nine methods in total. Their parameter and result types live in `src/wire.ts` as zod schemas, and each type is `z.infer` of its schema, so the host implementation, the descriptors and the browser half cannot drift apart.

## Caveats

- **Enable/disable is profile-wide, not per workspace.** Because toggling renames one discovery file, there is no way to have a skill on in one workspace and off in another; every workspace is offered every skill in the profile inventory. A reader who needs per-workspace on/off cannot have it here.
- **Project skills are discovered, not managed.** The provider lists a workspace's own roots so an agent still sees the skills beside it, but they are never part of the profile inventory the panel manages: they cannot be toggled, deleted or adopted. Onl

plugins.description: AEMEATH Theme - sakura violet-rose theme plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI
plugins.readme_text:
# 爱弥斯主题 · AEMEATH Theme

[English](README.en.md) | 中文

渐湖边暮色里的樱花瓣，带一点虚质空间的幽光——为 **DeepSeek Harness Web** 做的紫罗兰玫粉主题。

![主题效果](assets/aemath-poster.jpg)

- **全局换装**：浅色「樱花晨光」/ 深色「樱夜」两套配色，覆盖整套 `--dsw-*` 设计令牌，不是只换一个主色
- **主题色**：紫罗兰玫粉 `#963f86`（浅色）/ `#c96f9e`（深色），按钮、链接、选中态、滚动条、代码块全部联动
- **对话背景立绘**：立绘处理成淡彩后作为对话区背景层（全屏固定层 + 左侧遮罩淡出，不依赖任何带构建 hash 的组件类名）
- **Q 版徽章**：左下角圆形小头像，白圈 + 紫粉描边 + 柔光
- **favicon 与标题**：飞行雪绒·像素海豹 favicon，页面标题改为 `DeepSeek Harness - AEMEATH Theme`
- **零请求**：样式表、立绘、favicon 全部内联在插件里，不向外要任何资源

## 安装

主题是一个**客户端插件**（client plugin），装完刷新页面即可见效。

### 方式一：从插件市场

设置 → **插件市场** → 搜索 `aemath`（或「爱弥斯」）→ 一键安装 → 刷新页面。

### 方式二：命令行（`dsh web` 的 web profile）

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-theme-aemath
```

装完 **重启 `dsh web`**。

### 方式三：手动启用（装的是本地目录 / 压缩包时）

包已经在 profile 里、只是还没被加载时，往 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`
（`~\.dsh\profiles\web\cordis.patch.yml`）加一条 insert：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: ui-theme-aemath
      name: 'dsh-theme-aemath'
```

然后重启 `dsh web`。

> 桌面客户端（Electron）读的是 **`desktop` profile**，`dsh plugin` 按设计不碰它。
> 在桌面端要让 DSH 自己装：直接在会话里说「装一下 dsh-theme-aemath」。

### 关掉主题

三种都行，选一个：

```yaml
# ~\.dsh\profiles\web\cordis.patch.yml
- id: ui-theme-aemath
  disabled: true
```

或者把上面那条 insert 注释掉，或者在设置 → 插件里热禁用。重启 / 热重载后
主题消失，界面回到出厂配色——插件不会残留任何注入。

## 生效范围

主题覆盖的是 **配色令牌 + 两个装饰层**，不动任何组件结构：

| 覆盖的东西 | 怎么实现的 |
| --- | --- |
| 全部 `--dsw-*` 令牌 | `html body` 下重定义，浅深两套靠 `[data-ds-dark-theme]` 切换 |
| 对话区背景立绘 | `html body::before`，`z-index: 50`（在内容层之上、弹层之下），`pointer-events: none` |
| 左下角 Q 版徽章 | `html body::after`，`z-index: 999`，`pointer-events: none` |
| favicon / 页面标题 | 客户端插件在 `ctx.effect` 里换，卸载即还原 |

因为它只用到 `body` 上的伪元素和 CSS 变量，**前端升级换了构建 hash 也不会失效**——
这是刻意的：主题以前把图放进 dist，dsh 一升级就被还原，踩过一次。

## 微调

想改的话，直接改 `src/aemath-theme.css` 顶部的几个变量：

```css
--aemath-art-opacity: 0.42;   /* 背景立绘强度：越高越明显，也越"蒙" */
--aemath-chibi-size: 96px;    /* Q 版徽章尺寸 */
--aemath-chibi-left: 92px;    /* 徽章水平位置（侧边栏宽 - 尺寸）/ 2 */
--aemath-chibi-bottom: 170px; /* 徽章离底距离 */
```

改完重建：

```powershell
node scripts/build-client.mjs
```

重建是幂等的、可复现的：背景图按内容哈希 stamp 缓存标记，Q 版内联为 data URI，
favicon 内联为 SVG data URI。`lib/client.js` 是构建产物，别手改。

### 换立绘

1. 新的背景图存成 `assets/aemath-bg.jpg`（建议 1600px 宽、JPEG 质量 80 上下，
   主题会把它压到 `--aemath-art-opacity` 的透明度当水印用）
2. 新的 Q 版小图存成 `assets/aemath-chibi.jpg`（正方形，会被裁成圆形）
3. `node scripts/build-client.mjs`

> 本仓库内置的立绘为作者自有素材。**替换/二次分发前请确认你拥有所用图片的权利。**

## 项目结构

```
dsh-theme-aemath/
├── package.json            # dsh.client.platform = web
├── lib/                    # 发布产物（构建 + 手写）
│   ├── client.js           #   浏览器半边：内联整份样式表（构建产物）
│   └── index.js            #   host 半边：提供 /aemath-assets/* 素材路由
├── src/
│   ├── aemath-theme.css    # 主题源头：两套配色 + 背景层 + Q 版
│   └── client.template.js  # client 半边模板（__CSS__ / __SVG__ 占位）
├── scripts/
│   ├── build-client.mjs    # 零依赖构建脚本
│   ├── self-check.mjs      # 上架前自检（63 项）
│   └── make-poster.py      # 生成 assets/aemath-poster.jpg（需 Pillow）
├── assets/
│   ├── aemath-poster.jpg   # 市场/README 预览海报（合成图，非界面截图）
│   ├── aemath-bg.jpg       # 对话背景立绘（经淡彩处理）
│   ├── aemath-chibi.jpg    # Q 版徽章（构建期内联）
│   └── aemath-favicon.svg  # 像素海豹 favicon（构建期内联）
├── screenshots.json        # 市场截图清单
└── PUBLISHING.md           # 上架插件市场的完整步骤（不进 npm 包）
```

## 自检

改完东西、发布之前跑一次：

```powershell
node scripts/self-check.mjs
```

63 项检查：包清单（name / version / exports / `dsh.client.platform` / files 白名单）、
素材是不是真的 JPEG、`lib/client.js` 能不能被客户端加载器上下文执行、`apply()` 有没有
真的把样式表挂进 `document.head`、favicon 有没有换成功、host 路由对目录穿越和非法
方法返回什么、产物里有没有残留本机绝对路径。

## 上架

插件市场的条目来自 [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin)
精选列表（市场本身不维护清单）。从这台机器到上架要走的三步——npm 发布、
GitHub 仓库、提 PR——都写在 [PUBLISHING.md](PUBLISHING.md) 里，包含命令和坑。

## 素材路由

host 半边只做一件事：开一条 `/aemath-assets/*`。

- 只提供 `assets/` 里 **`aemath-` 前缀**的文件，目录成分一律丢掉——`..`、绝对路径、编码穿越都进不来
- 只接受 `GET` / `HEAD`
- 素材目录**相对模块自身**解析，不写死绝对路径，所以 `node_modules` 安装和 `link:.` 开发安装都能找到图
- 带 `?v=<内容哈希>`，换图立刻生效

## 许可

MIT。主题是非官方同人作品，与《鸣潮》/ 库洛游戏无关。

plugins.description: Agent profiles for DSH: per-session persona, duties, avatar and long-term memory, injected as a system-prompt section.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-agent-profiles —— 智能体配置

> **English summary** — Multiple AI agent profiles for DSH (DeepSeek Harness): role, avatar, personality, speaking style, ground rules and long-term memory — one global default, plus a per-conversation override with its own instructions and memory.
> **Install:** `dsh plugin add dsh-agent-profiles` (recommended, from npm). The tarball and from-source alternatives are in the 安装 / Install section below. Then restart DSH for the host half and reload the page for the client half.
> **Highlights:** choose the active profile, pin a profile per conversation, memory-injection toggle, import / export, restore defaults.
> **Language:** the settings UI follows the host language setting — Chinese and English dictionaries are both built in. **Model-facing prompts stay in Chinese** by design.
> **License:** MIT.

多套 AI 智能体配置：**角色设定 / 性格特点 / 说话习惯 / 行为准则 / 长期记忆摘要 / 记忆条目**。

两层作用范围：

| 层           | 在哪改            | 作用范围                                  |
| ----------- | -------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| **全局当前配置**  | 设置 →「智能体配置」    | 没做专属设定的对话都用它                          |
| **每个对话的配置** | 输入框左侧下拉 + ⚙ 面板 | 只影响这一个对话；可固定某套配置，还能写**本对话专属**的补充设定与记忆 |

无论哪一层，切换都是**立即生效且只影响之后的对话**，历史记录一个字都不动。

## 安装 / Install

**✅ 推荐 / Recommended —— 从 npm 安装（用包名，不要手抄 tarball 地址）：**

```bash
dsh plugin add dsh-agent-profiles
```

*装完按提示重启 DSH；客户端那一半刷新页面即可生效。*
*Restart DSH when prompted; reload the page for the client half.*

### 备选方式 / Alternatives

**① tarball —— 直接装打包文件 / install the packed tarball**

```bash
dsh plugin add https://registry.npmjs.org/dsh-agent-profiles/-/dsh-agent-profiles-0.7.0.tgz
```

**② 源码 —— clone 后把本地目录链接进 profile / from source: clone and link the folder**

```bash
git clone https://github.com/MoYu-CN/dsh-agent-profiles.git
dsh plugin add "link:<你的目录>/dsh-agent-profiles"
```

`link:` 不拷贝、直接软链，改代码立刻生效 —— 适合要改插件本身的场景。
`link:` symlinks instead of copying, so local edits take effect immediately — use it when you want to modify the plugin itself.

## 界面

### 设置 →「智能体配置」

![设置页](docs/settings-page.png)

*设置页：左栏配置列表（新建 / 复制 / 导入 / 导出），右栏编辑名称、头像与角色设定。*
*The settings page: the profile list on the left, and the name / avatar / role fields on the right.*

### 输入框左侧的快速切换器

![快速切换器](docs/quick-switcher.png)

*快速切换器：给**这个对话**挑一套配置 ——「跟随全局」表示用设置页里当前那一套。*
*The quick switcher: pick a profile for **this conversation**; "follow global" means the active profile from the settings page.*

### 回合头的头像与名称

![回合头](docs/message-header.png)

*回合头：本插件在官方「已完成 …」那一行**上方**加一行「[头像] 配置名」，官方那一行原样保留。*
*The turn head: this plugin adds an "[avatar] profile name" line **above** the stock "completed …" row, leaving that row untouched.*

### 长期记忆条目

![长期记忆](docs/memory-settings.png)

*长期记忆：逐条编辑**长期记忆条目**（每条自带「编辑 / 删除」），下方实时显示「长期记忆占用 746 / 5000 字；超过上限会自动提炼压缩」。*
*Long-term memory: edit the **long-term memory entries** one by one (each with its own edit / delete), with a live "long-term memory uses 746 / 5000 characters; past the cap it is condensed automatically" readout below.*

> 截图为**中文界面**下的实测界面（设置 UI 跟随宿主语言，内置中英两套词典）。
> The screenshots show the UI in Chinese (the settings UI follows the host language; both dictionaries ship built in).

---

## 1. 整体结构与模块划分

```
dsh-agent-profiles/
├── package.json          ── ① 包清单：bundle patch + dsh.client 声明 + meta/icon
├── cordis.patch.yml      ── ① 装配：插入 agent-profiles 行，硬依赖 webServer
├── icon.svg              ── ① 插件卡片图标
├── locale/zh.json,en.json── ② 元数据文案（宿主读插件卡片用）
└── lib/
    ├── store.js          ── ③ 数据模型 + 持久化 + 导入导出 + 变更算子
    ├── prompt.js         ── ④ 配置 → 注入文本（记忆开关、优先级声明、截断）
    ├── routes.js         ── ⑤ Host HTTP API（/__ap/*）+ index.html 脚本注入
    ├── index.js          ── ⑥ Host 入口：装配 store/prompt/routes + 注册提示词段落
    └── client.js         ── ⑦ 浏览器半：设置页（分栏）+ 输入框快速切换器
```

### 数据流

```
                       ┌──────────────── Host 进程 ────────────────┐
  设置页 / 快速切换器   │                                            │
   （浏览器）           │   routes.js  /__ap/state   /__ap/command   │
        │  fetch        │      │            /__ap/preview  /__ap/export
        └──────────────►│      ▼                                     │
                        │   store.js ──► profiles.json（原子写）      │
                        │      │                                     │
                        │      │  每次组装提示词时现算                │
                        │      ▼                                     │
                        │   prompt.js ──► systemPrompt.section(      │
                        │                   text: () => renderActive)│
                        └────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                                         │
                                         ▼
                              模型看到的本轮系统提示词
```

### 为什么这么切

| 模块          | 单独成层的理由                                                |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `store.js`  | 「配置长什么样、存哪、坏了怎么办」的生命周期是**磁盘**；与「怎么渲染成提示词」「怎么传给界面」完全不同步 |
| `prompt.js` | 这是**产品文案**层：段落顺序、空字段省略、记忆开关、截断说明都会随反馈反复改；改它不该碰到数据与传输代码 |
| `routes.js` | 传输与鉴权（同源守卫、体积上限、方法限制）是一组独立关注点，与业务算子分开才好测               |
| `index.js`  | 只做装配与降级（缺服务时怎么办），本身不含业务规则                              |
| `client.js` | 浏览器半必须自包含：不能 require 任何 Harness Client 包（见下）           |

---

## 2. 关键设计决策

### ① 提示词段落交的是「函数」，不是「字符串」

```js
systemPrompt.section({
  name: "agent-profiles:persona",
  order: 860,
  text: () => renderActive(store),   // ← 每次组装现算
});
```

字符串在注册那一刻就定死了，之后切换配置不会生效（重复注册同名段落会抛错）。  
交函数则**每次组装读一次当前的 activeId**，于是：

- 切换配置 ⇒ 下一次组装就是新配置 ⇒ **立即生效**；
- 历史消息存在会话日志里，本插件从不写它 ⇒ **历史不受影响**。

这两条不是顺手做到的，是把渲染做成函数直接换来的性质。

### ② `systemPrompt` 不进 `inject`，走 `ctx.get()` 软探测

硬依赖的语义是「缺了就整个插件停在 pending」。缺 `systemPrompt` 会让**设置界面也不出现**，  
用户连「为什么没有界面」都无从判断。所以：注入是增强，界面是本体，本体不该被增强拖死。  
（`webServer` 是硬依赖 —— 没它连界面都发不出去。）

### ③ 「每个对话一套」靠 **agent 作用域的同名段落**，不靠全局开关

全局段落只知道全局配置 —— 它拿不到「现在在跟哪个对话说话」。所以每个对话要有一个  
挂在该 agent 自己 ctx 上的段落：

```js
ctx.on("agent/created", ({ agent }) => {          // agent.id 就是 sessionId
  agentCtx.effect(() => systemPrompt.section({
    name: "agent-profiles:persona",                // ← 与全局段落**同名**
    order: 860,
    text: () => renderForSession(store, sessionId),
  }));
});
```

官方规则是「作用域段落压过同名全局段落」，于是：

- 有 agent 作用域段落 ⇒ 用**这个对话**的绑定与专属设定；
- 没有（非 agent 组装、或 `agent.ctx` 拿不到）⇒ 回落到全局段落的全局配置。

`agent/created` 是 **await 的**（早于第一步组装），所以注册一定赶在第一次注入之前完成；  
拿不到 `agent.ctx` 时**只降级 + 记一条 warning，绝不抛错** ——  
那个事件抛错会让 **agent 创建失败**，比「本对话设定没生效」严重得多。

两层各自的组装次数都会记进诊断（`本对话段 SN 次 / 全局兜底段 GN 次`），  
设置页能直接看到 —— 「每个对话独立注入」不是靠信念，是靠这个计数。

### ④ 出厂默认就带着一套准则

默认启用的「通用助手」是**填好内容**的（用户明确要求）：实事求是、简洁直白、不猜想臆想、  
服从现行的 AI 内容规范与平台审核要求、做没做好都如实说。出厂即生效 —— 新会话里默认助手  
就按这套说话，不用先手动配置。

> 早期版本这里是**刻意留空**的，理由是「装一个插件不该悄悄改变用户助手的行为」。  
> 用户看过实际效果后明确要求给默认助手写准则，于是**有意填上**。  
> 想回到零注入：把这一套的四个内容字段清空即可，`hasContent()` 会自动让它不进提示词  
> （注入与技能目录都会跳过它）。  
> 测试里把「默认准则必须含这五条」钉成了断言 —— 谁清空，谁就要面对红灯。

### ④c 长期记忆的自动化：工具 + 每 5 回合后台提炼 + 超限压缩

用户选择的是**两者都要**：模型能主动存，插件再定期兜底。

```
① 工具 memory_save      模型觉得值得长期记住 → 当场写进「本对话生效的那套配置」
② 后台提炼（每 5 回合）  插件读对话 → 调一次模型 → 把要点存进去
③ 超限压缩             长期记忆 > 5000 字 → 调模型合并成「摘要 + 精简条目」
```

**触发点**是 `agent/status` 变成 `idle`（一个回合跑完）——  
不能挂 `running`，那是回合**开始**，内容还没产生。

**写入目标**按会话 id **当场解析**（会话绑定优先，否则全局当前），  
绝不缓存「当前配置 id」：用户在对话中途切换配置时，缓存会把记忆写错地方。

**为什么压缩必须由插件做、不能交给模型自觉**：模型不知道「记忆满了」。  
预算判断只能由持有数据的一方做。

**四条硬约束（每条都对应一种「把会话弄坏」的形态，都有测试）**：

1. **绝不抛错到调用方**。后台跑的代码，任何异常都不该影响用户正在进行的对话；  
   所有对外调用包 try/catch，失败只记日志。
2. **绝不并发**。同一会话同一时刻只跑一次；否则两次跑起来会重复写同一批记忆。
3. **输入必须有上限**。送进模型的对话摘录截断到 6000 字 —— 那是用户的钱。
4. **输出必须能解析**。要求模型「一行一条」，**不用 JSON**：JSON 一旦格式跑偏整批丢失，  
   行文本最坏只是存进一条废话。压缩结果为空时**保持原样**，绝不冒险覆盖。

**缺服务要在装载时就说清楚**（缺 `sessionQuery` / `llm` / `tools` 各一条告警）：  
静默跳过的现象是「功能好像没生效」，用户分不清是没触发还是没能力。

**顺带修掉的一个真 bug**：`ProfileStore.command()` 原来只回传 `notice`，  
把算子自己的附加字段（`memory.autoAdd` 的 `added`）丢了 ——  
现象是「记忆明明存进去了，日志和诊断里却什么都没有」。现在附加字段原样带出。

### ④b 空配置不注入、且记忆关闭时整块消失

只起了个名字的配置不产生注入（`hasContent()`）。  
关闭记忆注入时是**整块不出现**，而不是出现「（记忆已关闭）」——后者仍占上下文，  
还会暗示模型「有记忆但你看不到」，让它开始猜记忆内容，比不注入更糟。

### ⑤ 客户端不 require 任何 Harness Client 包

官方 `practices.md` 明令禁止：那些包随版本变化、plain-JS 无类型检查，  
一个抛错的组件会**清空整个插槽条目**。所以控件全部自己写，样式只用 `--dsw-alias-*` token

plugins.readme_text:
# Employed by Guaq AI for DeepSeek Harness

Live job search for [DeepSeek Harness](https://dsh-plugin.org) (dsh): search roles verified on about 5,000 employer applicant-tracking boards, open an employer's hiring profile, and brief a hiring market, from inside a dsh session.

This bundle mounts two things:

- the Employed skills (`skills/`), as an isolated skill provider;
- the remote Employed MCP server, `https://jobs.guaqai.me/mcp`, over Streamable HTTP.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Guaq-AI/employed-dsh
```

Then, inside a session, store your API key (create one at <https://jobs.guaqai.me/profile>):

```text
/employed-login <api-key>
```

dsh's MCP client has no OAuth flow, so this bundle signs in with an API key kept in dsh's credential store. The key is never written to this package or to the session log, and it is sent only to `https://jobs.guaqai.me/mcp`.

## Details

- **Category:** Integrations & Connections.
- **Compatibility:** DeepSeek Harness with the `web` profile; the bundle is an ES module that exports `apply(ctx)` and uses dsh's own `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem`. Any platform dsh runs on.
- **Permissions and external services:** one outbound connection, to `https://jobs.guaqai.me/mcp`, carrying the search filters the model chooses and your API key as a Bearer token. Account tools change only your own Employed data (profile, tracker, alerts), and only when you ask; nothing applies to jobs or contacts employers. No hooks, no shell commands, no files written.
- **Example prompts:** "Find entry-level backend roles in India." "Is Stripe hiring in London right now?"
- **Known limitations:** dsh's MCP client has no OAuth, so sign-in is by API key. Not yet run against a live dsh build; please open an issue if anything fails.

## Other agents

Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI, Cursor, Gemini CLI and the rest install from [Guaq-AI/employed-plugins](https://github.com/Guaq-AI/employed-plugins), which signs in with OAuth instead of an API key.

## About this repository

Generated from `plugins/` in the Employed source tree by `scripts/sync_public_repo.py`; edit there, not here. MIT licensed, see [LICENSE](LICENSE). Report security issues to support@guaqai.me.

plugins.description: Sage mode（贤者模式）: a read-only advisory session mode for DeepSeek Harness — answer, advise, review, teach, brainstorm, and diagnose with read/search/web tools only.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-sage-mode · Sage Mode

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A **read-only advisory mode** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) sessions.
Enter with `/sage`, leave with `/sage off`.

While the mode is active, the session keeps only read/search/web tools. Every tool that
edits, deletes, or executes is **hidden from the model** and **denied at execution**.
At the same time an advisory system-prompt section turns the model into your thinking
partner: it answers, advises, evaluates, explains, brainstorms, and diagnoses — instead of
changing your workspace.

The name comes from **Sage (贤者)**: the wise one gives counsel, not a hand.

## Why

Coding agents are built to act. Sometimes you do not want action — you want to understand
code, compare approaches, learn a concept, brainstorm, or debug an error. Sage mode gives
that intent a first-class switch: the agent can still read your repository and search the
web, but it cannot touch anything.

## Usage

| Input | Effect |
|---|---|
| `/sage` | Enter Sage mode: read-only tools only, advisory prompt injected |
| `/sage <question>` | Enter the mode **and** send that question as your next message (images/files allowed) |
| `/sage off` | Leave; the full toolset is restored immediately |

Typical uses: understanding an unfamiliar implementation, learning a codebase, comparing
design options, brainstorming, pasting a stack trace. When you are ready to actually change
code, run `/sage off`.

Entering the mode changes what the model can call, not the sandbox: hidden tools are removed
from the request's tool catalog entirely, and anything that still reaches dispatch is refused
by a `tools.guard()` that returns "let the user run `/sage off` first".

## Tools kept (default)

`read` `read_image` `glob` `grep` `web_search` `web_fetch` `ask_user_question` `skill`
`cordis_inspect_list` `cordis_inspect_query` `load_workspace_dependencies`

Everything else is hidden — `write` `edit` `ops_replace`, `pwsh`/`bash` and background jobs,
`subagent`/`send_message`, `plugin_manager`, `todo_write`, `present`, goal and team-task
tools, and so on. Names that do not exist in your composition are ignored, so one list works
across agent presets.

## Reference

### Optional dependency: dsh-ops

The fast read-only tools — `ops_glob`, `ops_grep`, `ops_inspect_local_file` — come from
**[dsh-ops](https://github.com/T-Auto/dsh-ops)**, a separate bundle. Sage mode declares them
as an **optional dependency** (`optionalTools` in [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml)):

- **dsh-ops installed** → those tools are adopted into the allow list and stay available.
- **dsh-ops absent** → the names are ignored and everything else keeps working. A missing
  optional provider is never an error.


To adopt a read-only tool from any other bundle, extend the map without touching the code:

```yaml
config:
  optionalTools:
    some-other-plugin: [their_read_tool]
```

### Also see

- [dsh-ops](https://github.com/T-Auto/dsh-ops) — the optional source of the `ops_*` tools.
- [Sage mode repository](https://github.com/zero360-TYN/dsh-sage-mode) — this plugin.

## Install

Open **Plugin Manager** in the Harness and enter this repository's URL as the install spec:

```
https://github.com/zero360-TYN/dsh-sage-mode
```
![pic_location: /readme_pic/install.png](/readme_pic/install.png)
The manager reads a GitHub repository URL as a git install spec, clones the package, adds its
`sage-mode` row, and activates it. Updating later means installing the same URL again; a fresh
JavaScript module generation needs an app restart to load.

<details>
<summary>Alternative: install from a local directory</summary>

From a checkout, point the manager at the absolute path instead:

```
plugin_manager(action: "install_bundle", target: "<absolute path to this repo>")
```

That installs the package as a **link**, so editing files in the repo affects the live plugin
directly — convenient while developing.

</details>

## Configuration

The row's defaults live in [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml). Your own overrides belong
in the profile's user layer (`$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml`). A patch replaces
the targeted row's **whole** `config`, so restate every key you want to keep:

```yaml
- id: sage-mode
  name: dsh-sage-mode
  config:
    command: sage          # command name (default: sage)
    sectionOrder: 3255     # prompt section placement
    allowedTools: [read, grep, web_search]   # keep only these
    optionalTools:         # optional deps: adopt their read-only tools when present
      dsh-ops: [ops_glob, ops_grep, ops_inspect_local_file]
    section: |             # the full advisory prompt
      ...
```

Unknown keys fail at load instead of being ignored, so a typo cannot silently disable your
configuration. Missing keys fall back to their defaults.

## How it works

- **State lives in the session log.** The mode folds the `command/run` + `command/done`
  pair the commands service already writes, so it adds **no custom event type** — an
  unknown event type would make older readers refuse to reopen the session. Resume and fork
  restore the mode automatically.
- **Enforced per agent.** `agent.ctx.tools.restrict({ allow })` hides the mutating tools and
  `agent.ctx.tools.guard()` denies anything that still reaches dispatch. Both disposers are
  owned by `agent.ctx` *and* kept in the plugin's own effect, so agent disposal and plugin
  unload both unwind them.
- **Zero `@deepseek-ai/*` dependencies.** A profile-installed bundle resolves those only from
  the dsh installation, so the plugin uses Node builtins plus services reached through `ctx`.
- The prompt section is registered on the agent's own scope and returns an empty string while
  the mode is off — no token cost when unused.

## Known limits

- Applies to the **current session only**; other tabs and sessions are unaffected.
- Under PTC mode the `run_code` transport itself is kept (otherwise the whole tool surface
  becomes unusable), but the generated SDK exposes only the permitted read-only tools.
- Plan mode's `exit_plan_mode` is hidden too; leave plan mode with `/plan off` or `/sage off`.
- Sandbox and approval policy are unaffected — this plugin governs **which tools the model
  holds**, not filesystem permissions.

## Test

```powershell
node test/self-test.mjs
```

Covers config validation, the session-log fold, the command contract, restriction/guard
registration and release, the fallback mask for unusual compositions, and admitting agents
that already existed when the plugin loaded.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: DSH 会话思考档位插件（think-level）：每个会话六档推理开关（关闭/低/中/高/最高/超高），子代理继承，就近收敛到模型支持档位
plugins.readme_text:
**每个会话页面单独设定推理档位（关闭 / 低 / 中 / 高 / 最高 / 超高），子代理继承所属会话档位。** [![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-65a30d?style=flat)](LICENSE) [![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.x-0ea5e9?style=flat)](#-兼容性) [![platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-DeepSeek%20Harness-0ea5e9?style=flat)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) ![language](https://img.shields.io/badge/language-JS%20plain-F0DB4F?style=flat&logo=javascript&logoColor=000) **中文** · [English](README.en.md)
--- ## ✨ 功能 - **每会话独立**：会话输入区「思考 ▾」六档圆弧选择器，写入本会话档位，会话之间互不影响 - **子代理继承**：沿 `session.header.parentSession` 归属链，找到最近单独设定的会话档位 - **就近收敛**：按目标模型 `reasoningEfforts` **实际支持**的档位自动收敛（如四档模型上 中→高、最高→超高），绝不直发模型不认识的档位 - **模型选择器清理**：隐藏 DSH 原生「推理等级 >」入口与其二级面板（能力词典保留给请求链，界面不再露出） - **双入口同写**：UI 选择器与 `set_thinking_level` 工具走同一写通道，实时生效、持久化到 profile 补丁层 ## 📦 安装 ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add github:373831615/dsh-think-level ``` 本地目录安装：`dsh plugin --profile web add <本目录绝对路径>`。 ## 🧩 兼容性 | 项 | 支持 | |---|---| | **DSH 内核** | **0.2.x** —— 实测 `0.2.1-alpha.1`（开发期同时覆盖 `0.2.0-rc.2`） | | 界面 | DSH Web（client 半 `platform: web`） | | Node.js | ≥ 20.18.1（安装期） | - 依赖声明：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings`（可选 peer，内核自带）`^0.2.0-rc.1 || ^0.2.1-0`、`@deepseek-ai/schemastery@^3.18.1` - 内核 API 基线（均为 **0.2.x 世代**）：`agent/request` 瀑布、volatile Config、settings 表单写通道、`conversation.input.left` 插槽、`remote.session` 命名空间 - **0.1.x 未测不承诺**；0.3.x 未出、届时回归再认证 ## 🧭 使用 六档从低到高（内部档位 id）： | 思考 ▾ | 关闭 | 低 | 中 | 高 | 最高 | 超高 | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---| | 档位 | `off` | `low` | `medium` | `high` | `xhigh` | `max` | - **会话输入区**（模型选择器同排左侧）：点「思考 ▾」为**本会话**选档；未设定的会话显示并跟随默认档 - **对助手说**：「把本会话思考调到超高」→ 工具 `set_thinking_level`（`action=get|set`、`target=session|default`） - **默认档**（未单独设定的会话生效）：`set_thinking_level target=default`，或补丁层 `think-level.config.level` ## ⚙️ 生效机制 ``` 「思考 ▾」/ set_thinking_level │ （同一写通道：configForms → remote.settings → volatile） ▼ Config: level（默认档）+ sessions{会话id: 档位} │ ▼ agent/request 瀑布（prepend，最外层=最终值） 有效档位 = sessions[本会话] ?? 沿父链继承 ?? level │ 就近收敛到 reasoning.efforts ▼ 每次模型调用的 reasoningEffort （子代理继承所属会话档位） ``` - 标题生成、压缩摘要等内部调用不走该瀑布（保持便宜） - 模型配置里的 `reasoningEfforts` 声明是**档位词典**（模型认哪几档的元数据），留给请求链使用；删掉会让六档开关失效 ## 🗂 目录结构 ``` think-level/ ├── main.js # Host：Config（level + sessions）+ agent/request 改写 + set_thinking_level 工具 ├── client.js # Client：会话输入区「思考 ▾」+ 模型选择器推理等级隐藏 ├── cordis.patch.yml # Loader 行（id=think-level，即设置命名空间） ├── locale/ # 显示元数据（en / zh） ├── docs/banner.svg # 横幅 ├── icon.svg # 图标 └── package.json ``` ## 🧪 开发备注 - **Client 半（client.js）存盘即生效**（client-hmr 轮询 + SSE 热替换，或刷新页面） - **Host 半（main.js）改码受模块代际缓存约束**：同身份热替换在运行中进程里不生效，可靠做法是换包名/目录/行 id 全新身份重装，或重启内核 - 工具契约坑：`output.render(args, value)` 首参是工具入参；schemastery `z.dict(inner, sKey)` 第一参是**值** schema - 隐藏推理等级入口的刀口：remote 命名空间方法是 getter-only 访问器，包装要打底层 `invokeRemote` ## 📄 许可证 [MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: REA reverse-engineering tools for DeepSeek Harness, as a filtering MCP bridge
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-rea

Full [REA](https://github.com/morluto/rea) 6.4.0 MCP tools and its original version-matched skill for DeepSeek Harness. English | [中文](README.zh.md)

## What is preserved

- All **170 upstream tools**, including navigation, decompilation, Android/ADB, managed code, JavaScript/Electron and runtime analysis. No invented entry/navigate/analyze tiers.
- Original input schemas and descriptions, with stable DSH names `mcp__rea__<upstream-name>`.
- The official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` handles pagination, notifications, cancellation, lifecycle, output validation and attachment projection.
- Original `reverse-engineer-anything` skill v37, tool_count=170 and all six references. The plugin registers the package's skill with its own resource directory; it does not overwrite Codex/user skills.
- Original stateful upstream MCP process and complete Evidence `content`/`structuredContent`. No result summaries or reconstructed IDs.
- All **six original MCP prompts** with their 14 arguments and the original dynamic completions, reachable from the composer's `/` menu on the *same* REA Client, process and analysis session as the 170 tools.

REA is an exact npm dependency, not a reimplementation. Native engines and commercial licenses remain bring-your-own, exactly as upstream.

## Prompt templates in the `/` menu

The six original prompts enter through the composer's own `/` menu, under the `rea` group (`/rea:investigate_feature`, `/rea:compare_versions`, `/rea:verify_reconstruction`, `/rea:trace_crash`, `/rea:audit_residual_unknowns`, `/rea:prepare_bounded_process_capture`) — the surface a Codex user already knows, where Codex exposes these same MCP prompts. **No extra button or permanent control is added to the composer.**

Picking an entry opens that template's argument form: the original argument descriptions, upstream argument completions (target documents, providers, procedures, retained Evidence, captures, manifests, occurrences, unresolved unknowns) and an exact-text preview you can insert into the draft.

Fidelity rules of that panel:

- Discovery and resolution are both originals: the menu lists `prompts/list`, the form calls `prompts/get`, and completions call `completion/complete` on the connection the tools already use — no second REA process, no rewritten templates, no cached or fabricated suggestions.
- A pick returns `handled`: the slash pipeline inserts and rewrites nothing, so choosing a template changes no draft text.
- Preview never executes analysis; every tool call stays a separate, explicit model decision.
- Insertion is a plain draft write. The panel never submits, never sends and never selects a target; you edit or send the draft yourself.
- A generation guard rejects a render whose answer arrives after the connection changed, so a stale template can never be inserted.
- The menu group is Web-only. CLI/headless profiles keep all 170 tools and the skill; only the `/` group is absent.

Because DSH caches each package's client metadata for the lifetime of a Host process, adding this entry requires **one DSH restart** after upgrading: a running Host that already mounted `dsh-rea` before this version has cached it as a host-only package and will not serve the new bundle until it restarts. No configuration change is needed.

## Install

The package has not been published to npm. Install from the repository using DSH's plugin manager, or select a packaged release tarball when available:

```text
github:JeremyWangCY/dsh-rea
```

For local development, install the absolute directory of this checkout through the plugin manager. Use the currently active profile; Web UI does not necessarily mean the `web` profile (desktop can host the same UI).

## Configuration

The bundle inserts the host plugin. Defaults expose everything and leave DSH's native/PTC presentation untouched:

```yaml
- id: dsh-rea
  config:
    serverName: rea
    toolCallTimeoutMs: 300000
    # Optional supported standalone Node executable:
    # nodeCommand: 'C:\path\to\node.exe'
```

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| enabled | true | Enable the plugin |
| serverName | rea | Official bridge namespace |
| tools | all | Compatibility marker; subsets are no longer supported |
| nodeCommand | empty | Host executable; Electron uses `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1`. Set an explicit supported Node if child analysis workers cannot use the host executable |
| env | {} | Explicit REA provider environment; official bridge scrubs inherited credential-shaped/DSH variables |
| toolCallTimeoutMs | 300000 | MCP call timeout; not an assurance that the outer agent/PTC deadline is longer |
| failOnStartupError | true | Report startup failure rather than silently exposing an empty tool set |

Supported Node range: `^22.19.0 || ^24.11.0 || >=26.0.0`; 23/25 are unsupported. No runtime or analysis engine is installed/upgraded by plugin activation. Existing unrelated approval/preset settings are not changed. Automatic reconnection is disabled deliberately: a new REA process loses target/provider/retained Evidence state; reload explicitly after a disconnect.

### Native versus PTC

All tools remain registered in both modes. PTC belongs to DSH's tools/agent preset, not REA; the plugin does not switch every other tool into PTC.

Measured in an isolated real Cordis deployment on this machine:

| Presentation | Model-side tool JSON | Generated SDK text |
|---|---:|---:|
| native, all 170 | 436,594 bytes | 0 |
| PTC, `run_code` only | 944 bytes | 86,633 bytes |

These are **bytes, not tokenizer counts**. The previous v0.1 claim of ~543k input tokens incorrectly counted MCP output schemas as model input. PTC is not zero-context; SDK text is in the prompt. Its default worker wall limit is 600s, compute limit 60s and output limit 64MiB. Only returned/printed values become the outer result, so return complete Evidence when needed. PTC and native preserve tool results, but they are different model interfaces and are not proven to produce identical answers.

Use the original skill's routing, Evidence and provider-recovery instructions. REA CLI JSON also preserves full Evidence IDs; unlike long-lived MCP it is normally one-shot and does not retain a provider/target across commands. CLI output still consumes context if fed back to the model.

## Verification and limits

`verify/integration.mjs` runs the real Cordis ToolRuntime, original upstream MCP and DSH worker-thread PTC, then deeply compares results. Covered: all 170 names/descriptions/input schemas, original skill, the six original prompt metadata sets and their rendered messages, an original provider completion, JS analysis and data-flow tracing, retained-reference view, Evidence bundle listing, a one-record offline HAR, one-member ZIP lifecycle/inventory, upstream errors, pre-dispatch cancellation, disposal, explicit startup failure. `test/client.test.mjs` loads the real browser bundle against a minimal React/DOM harness and drives the actual `/` source: idle silence (the session slot renders nothing and no request is sent), source registration, candidate filtering, a `handled` pick that writes no draft, argument gating, completion payloads, exact preview text, draft-preserving insertion through `setDraft` only, error surfacing, and the post-upgrade restart hint. `verify/connection.mjs` mounts the real installed `WebServer` + `Connection` and speaks the real wire: 401 without the browser session, then `prompts/list`/`get`/`complete` deep-equal to a direct MCP client, plus envelope, content-type, Host-fence and disposal refusals. `pnpm test` runs 10 unit/harness tests; `pnpm verify` runs the 35-check differential suite. Install dependencies with a supported Node and pnpm first. Optional `DSH_REA_TEST_MODULE_ROOT` points at an installed DSH module root for exercising those exact Host services; by default the checkout's test dependencies are used. See `verification/integration-report.json` in the source checkout.

Not claimed: all 170 operations executed; native decompilers/ADB/JEB/browser capture equivalence; mid-flight expensive-operation cancellation; identical LLM answers; every model provider's schema limits; exhaustive completion c

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 会话导出插件：在 dsh Web 会话「更多」菜单注入「导出 Markdown / 导出 PDF」，纯前端注入、零 npm 依赖。Export DSH sessions to Markdown or PDF from the web GUI.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-export-plugin · 会话导出 Markdown + PDF 在 dsh 会话行"更多"菜单里,于"归档会话"下方注入两项: - **导出 Markdown** —— 与 PDF 同一套**极简问答对**（只有用户输入 + 该轮最后一条助手可见回复）转成 `.md` 下载。 - **导出 PDF** —— 只取**用户输入 + 该轮最后一条助手可见回复**(文字与图片),排成干净的问答对,A4 排版后经系统打印对话框"另存为 PDF"。 ## 设计 复用官方 `dsh-session-log-export` 包的 `/api/session.export` route(返回 ZIP,内含 canonical JSONL log + `media/.` 图片),前端 fetch 拿 ZIP → 浏览器原生 `DecompressionStream('deflate-raw')` 解压 → 迷你 ZIP 解析器找根 `session*.jsonl`(PDF 再解 `media/*`)→ 按 V4 event type 转换 → `.md` 下载,或渲染打印专用 HTML 到隐藏 `iframe srcdoc` 并调 `contentWindow.print()`。 **纯前端注入,零 npm 依赖,不读 zstd**(官方已用 persistence read handle 把 log 解好放进 ZIP),不碰 persistence。PDF 走 `window.print` 而不是 jsPDF/pdfMake:零依赖、中文用系统字体、图片与 CSS 排版交给浏览器。 ## PDF 导出范围 | 事件 / 内容 | 是否导出 | |---|---| | `user/message` 且 `source.kind === 'user'`(真实用户输入,含图片) | ✅ | | `agent/inbox/spliced` 里 role=user 的插入消息 | ✅ 与上一条是**同一个 message id**,按 id 去重只出一次 | | `runtime-context` / `time-context` / `skill-catalog` / 工作区指令等**系统注入** | ❌ 它们也走 `user/message`,按 `source.kind` 滤掉 | | `assistant/message` 的 `text` block | ✅ 但**每轮只留最后一条** | | `assistant/message` 的 `image` block | ✅ | | 同一轮里工具调用前后的**过渡说明文本** | ❌ 被该轮最后一条覆盖 | | `thinking` / `reasoning` block(思考过程) | ❌ | | `tool_use` / `tool_result` / `tool/call` / `tool/result` | ❌ | | `system/message` / `developer/message` | ❌ | | `assistant/attempt`(半途草稿、流式分片) | ❌ | | 子代理会话(`includeDescendants=false`) | ❌ | | 未知/其它事件类型 | ❌ | 即 PDF 是一份干净的"我问了什么 / 最终答了什么"记录,不含模型内部过程。配对规则:以 `turn/end` 作为一轮的边界,把该轮的用户输入与**最后一条**助手可见回复排成一组;日志末尾再收尾 flush 一次,所以被打断 / 未正常结束的回合也不会丢内容。用户消息里的图片会内嵌到 PDF(缺图时输出 `[图片未随会话导出]` 占位)。 > **为什么必须"按 id 去重 + 按 source.kind 过滤"**(来自真实会话日志的教训): > 同一条用户输入在 `agent/inbox/spliced` 与 `user/message` 里**各记一次、共用同一个 message id**, > 不去重就会每句提问出现两遍;而 `runtime-context`、`time-context`、`skill-catalog`、工作区指令 > (如 CLAUDE.md,实测上万字符)也是 `user/message`,不按 `source.kind === 'user'` 过滤就会**冒充用户提问** > 混进 PDF。两者叠加曾是 PDF 里"重复提问 + 莫名其妙的成段内容"的直接原因。 ## 导出的 Markdown 结构 Markdown 与 PDF **共用同一套"极简问答对"**（同一份 `jsonlToBlocks` 输出），只有标题、角色、正文和图片占位： ``` # Session - Created: - Workspace: ## 👤 用户 <用户消息> ## 🤖 助手 <助手回复（保留 Markdown 代码块与列表）> ## 👤 用户 …（每轮如此） ``` 不再包含工具调用 / 工具结果 / 系统提示词 / 思考过程 / 上下文注入 / 未知事件的 JSON dump。图片位置输出 `[图片]` 占位（Markdown 不做 base64 内嵌，避免文件膨胀）。 实测（同一会话 `session-5494db1e`）：**旧导出 146,662 字节 → 新导出 3,208 字节**（约 2.2%）。 > 需要**完整会话日志**（含工具调用、系统提示词）时，用会话菜单里官方 `dsh-session-log-export` 提供的导出项，它仍会给出完整的 ZIP/日志。 ## 菜单挂载的真实 DOM 官方菜单行由 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` 的 `MenuItemButton` 渲染(类名是 CSS module 哈希): ```html
``` 注入做法:按文本 `归档会话` / `取消归档` 找到 `[role="menuitem"]`,再取它的外层 `div.itemWrap`,**克隆整个 `itemWrap`**(不是只克隆 button——`.itemWrap` 是 `position:relative` 的整行单元,只克隆 button 会让两个 button 挤在同一个包裹层里),然后改 `itemLabel` 文字、替换 svg 图标、移除 `shortcut`、绑定 click,依次插到原行后面(Markdown 在前、PDF 在后)。 ## 文件 - `index.js` — apply 注入,通过 `webServer.tapIndex` 把 HTML 注入 `` 前 - `inject.mjs` — 导出 `exportInjectHtml` 字符串,含 CSS + JS IIFE(两个导出项 + ZIP 解析 + MD/PDF 两条转换链) - `cordis.patch.yml` — 插件 bundle 声明 - `package.json` — 包配置 - `test-inject.mjs` — 回归测试(见下) ## 安装 ```bash npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add D:\dsh-code\export-plugin ``` 插件以**目录链接**安装(profile 的 `dsh-export-plugin` → `link:D:/dsh-code/export-plugin`),改 `inject.mjs` / `index.js` 后**只需重启 dsh**(`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`),不必重新 add;改 `package.json` 结构字段需重新 add。 > `inject.mjs` 的注入串在服务启动时随模块加载定格,重启前改动不会生效。 ## 自测(改完 inject.mjs 先跑这个) ```bash node test-inject.mjs ``` 它做六件事: 1. 断言外层模板字面量里**没有残留的单反斜杠** `\n` / `\.` / `\d`; 2. 提取内联 `

plugins.description: Runtime evidence that helps agents trace, profile, and burn down hotspots in application and native code, GPU kernels, and inference stacks.
plugins.readme_text:
flameox

Bounded local runtime evidence for coding agents.

Flameox coordinates profilers, benchmark tools, trace processors, and direct local targets. It turns an explicit artifact or command into bounded evidence while keeping durable preservation optional. The agent chooses hypotheses and experiments; Flameox records observed inputs, execution provenance, typed evidence, coverage, and limitations. There is no workspace to initialize or project configuration to maintain. Pass exact artifact paths to analysis and an explicit argv plus absolute working directory to capture. Flameox does not search parent directories, edit project files, or provide a hosted service. ## Quick start Configure an MCP client with the global setup command: ```console npx flameox@latest setup ``` Setup detects supported clients and asks which configurations to update. For automation, select clients explicitly, for example `--client codex --yes` or `--all --yes`; `--dry-run` reports the paths and actions without writing. Setup preserves unrelated client configuration and does not change project files. See [the npm package guide](npm/README.md) for details. Update existing MCP registrations with: ```console npx flameox@latest update ``` `update --check` reports available updates without changing configuration. Updates preserve each client's provider extras and settings, verify the new environment before changing release pins, and report which clients need a restart or reconnect. Use `--client codex` to select one client, or `--version 0.2.8` to select a specific release, including for rollback. The Python CLI exposes the same `flameox update` command. For direct CLI use, pass exact artifact paths or an explicit command: ```console uvx flameox analyze preview_artifact /absolute/path/to/artifact.json uvx flameox capture --provider direct --cwd "$PWD" -- python benchmark.py ``` To launch the stdio MCP server manually: ```console uvx flameox mcp serve ``` For local development, clone the repository, install its development dependencies, and inspect the available tools: ```console git clone https://github.com/morluto/flameox.git cd flameox uv sync --extra dev --extra memory --extra trace --extra cpu uv run flameox mcp inspect ``` ## Evidence and storage Analysis and unpreserved capture use bounded session scratch. Session `analysis_id` values expire when evicted or when the server stops. Explicit preservation creates the user-level Flameox data directory and stores native bytes and a canonical evidence bundle by SHA-256. Set `FLAMEOX_DATA_DIR` to choose another location. Preservation is optional; it does not imply full console-output retention. Flameox distinguishes observed, derived, and inferred claims. Profiles guide exploration but do not establish causality or performance improvement. Confirmatory claims require representative workloads, declared metrics and estimands, compatible identities, preserved samples, and a semantic oracle. ## MCP The MCP server has no workspace binding. It exposes named analysis and capture tools through the same operation registry as the CLI. Analysis tools accept explicit sources; capture tools accept a typed target and provider. Tool schemas expose operation-specific fields directly. Inspect the catalog with `flameox mcp inspect`; use `--tool TOOL_NAME` for focused schemas and examples. The complete contract and current tool catalog are in [the interface guide](docs/interfaces.md). Tools return their full bounded results inline, including failures and recovery actions. Preserved evidence has a durable `evidence_id`; `inspect_evidence` returns its redacted metadata and replay sources inline. Capture takes argv, not a shell string. A direct target supplies an absolute working directory and bounded environment overrides. Results may include `next_page`; replay its named analysis tool and arguments unchanged. Capture continuations read collected artifacts and do not rerun the target. MCP work belongs to the live request, so cancellation applies directly and no detached job survives a restart. ## Documentation - [Architecture](docs/architecture.md) describes process and package boundaries. - [Storage and evidence](docs/storage-and-evidence.md) defines preservation and provenance. - [Investigations](docs/investigations.md) covers experiments, comparison, and evidence quality. - [Adapters](docs/adapters.md) documents provider compatibility and integration policy. - [Runtime safety](docs/runtime-safety.md) covers limits, recovery, integrity, and privacy. - [Interfaces](docs/interfaces.md) defines CLI and MCP contracts. - [Testing](docs/testing.md) describes test selections and known proof gaps. ## Development Flameox requires Python 3.12 or newer and uses the committed `uv.lock`. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for development setup and contribution guidance. ```console uv run ruff check src tests tools uv run ruff format --check src tests tools uv run mypy src tests tools uv run pytest -q ``` Flameox is licensed under the MIT License.

plugins.description: DSH 可视化技能商店 — Visual skill market inside DeepSeek Harness: browse, search, install and manage Agent Skills
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-skill-market

DeepSeek Harness（DSH）可视化技能商店：逛一逛，点一下，装好。

分类浏览、精选推荐、卡片流、搜索、热度参考、一键安装，
外加内建管理（已装列表 / 启停 / 卸载 / 回收站恢复）。纯前端 + 本地实现，无后端、零运行时依赖。

## 功能

- **逛店**：★ 精选横排大卡、分类筛选（办公协同 / 开发工具 / 内容创作 / 文档处理 / 技能与商店）、中英文搜索、star 热度
- **安装**：一键从 GitHub 公开仓库安装技能包（SKILL.md + 资源），同名冲突保护，仓库级缓存（同仓库第二个技能秒装）
- **仓库源**：货架来源透明化，可添加任意 GitHub 技能仓库并浏览其中技能逐个安装
- **管理**：已装列表（区分商店安装 / 本地既有、启用 / 停用）、卸载进回收站、恢复、彻底删除、诊断标示
- **更新跟踪**：安装记录上游 commit，一键检查、按技能更新
- **货架运营**：精选清单（registry）支持远程仓库覆盖 + 内置种子兜底，社区经 PR 上架
- **入口开关**：插件管理页自带配置卡片，可隐藏 / 显示设置侧边栏的商店入口

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin add dsh-skill-market
```

或在 DSH 客户端插件市场搜索 `dsh-skill-market`（收录后可用）。

## 使用

安装后打开 DSH 设置，侧边栏会出现「技能商店」入口；四个页签：逛店 / 仓库源 / 已装 / 回收站。

## 架构

```
src/          服务端（cordis 插件，挂 /api/dsh-skill-market 路由）
  index.ts      插件入口：路由注册 + 请求来源校验
  registry.ts   精选清单：远程拉取（stale-while-revalidate）+ 磁盘缓存 + 内置种子兜底
  installer.ts  安装 / 卸载 / 已装扫描 / 启停 / 诊断 / 更新跟踪 / 回收站
  sources.ts    自定义仓库源管理
  unzip.ts      零依赖 zip 解包（Node 内置 zlib）
  paths.ts      目录解析（DSH_HOME 跨平台）
client/       客户端（React，经 __ModuleLoader__ 注入设置页）
  index.tsx     settings.section + 配置卡片三 seat 注册
  App.tsx       逛店 / 仓库源 / 已装 / 回收站四视图
scripts/
build.mjs     esbuild 双端打包
release.mjs   版本发布（升版本 / 构建 / pack / tag / Release）
```

技能包安装到 `~/.dsh/skills/`（尊重 `DSH_HOME` 环境变量），与 DSH 原生技能加载机制兼容。

## 安全

- 所有变更请求校验来源（loopback / 可信主机 + 专属标记头）
- 技能包路径逐条校验（防路径穿越 / Windows 保留名 / 符号链接逃逸）
- 解压体积双重限额（32 MiB 压缩 / 64 MiB 展开）
- 上架清单人工审核；第三方技能的 SKILL.md 本质是提示词，安装前请知悉来源

## License

MIT

plugins.description: A Keyboard Shortcuts settings page for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), with permission-mode cycling, reasoning-effort stepping, prompt navigation, a status-page shortcut, a task-list toggle, and an optional composer key remap.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-keyboard-shortcut

A Keyboard Shortcuts settings page for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), with permission-mode
cycling, reasoning-effort stepping, prompt navigation, a status-page shortcut, a
task-list toggle, and an optional composer key remap.

[中文文档](README.zh-CN.md)

## Overview

`dsh-keyboard-shortcut` adds one page to DSH's Settings panel and eight shortcuts
to the application. The page lists every binding in the running application,
lets you change the ones this plugin owns, and carries a switch for remapping the
composer's Enter keys.

Every shortcut this plugin adds is an ordinary DSH command. It appears in the
shortcut reference, it can be rebound, and it respects the same conflict rules as
the built-in commands.

## Requirements

| Requirement | Minimum |
|---|---|
| DeepSeek Harness | `0.2.0-rc.2` |
| Node.js (for building from source) | `22.12.0` |

This plugin is a **client plugin**: everything it does happens in the browser
half. Its Host half is an empty `apply` that exists only so DSH serves the
browser bundle.

## Install

Install into a profile with the DSH plugin command:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-keyboard-shortcut
```

Then restart the profile, or toggle the bundle off and on from **Settings →
Plugins** if the profile reloads live.

## What you get

### A Keyboard Shortcuts settings page

**Settings → Keyboard shortcuts** sits directly after General. It has four
sections:

- **Plugin shortcuts** — the commands this plugin owns, each row editable. Click
  a row, press a combination, and it saves. Press Escape to cancel.
- **Input navigation** — the two page-key shortcuts. These have no command id,
  so they are listed read-only rather than being rebindable; the reason is under
  [Known limitations](#known-limitations).
- **Input optimisation** — the composer key switch described below.
- **Application shortcuts** — every other registered command, read-only. This is
  the table that makes a binding conflict comprehensible: when a combination is
  refused, the row that already owns it is visible right there.

### Shortcuts

| Shortcut | Action | Platforms |
|---|---|---|
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Q</kbd> | Cycle to the next permission mode | Desktop Windows, macOS |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>1</kbd> | Lower the reasoning effort one level | Desktop |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>2</kbd> | Raise the reasoning effort one level | Desktop |
| <kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>A</kbd> | Open the DeepSeek status page in the sidebar browser | Desktop |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>L</kbd> | Expand or collapse the task list | Desktop |
| <kbd>PgUp</kbd> | Go to the previous input | All (fixed) |
| <kbd>PgDn</kbd> | Go to the next input | All (fixed) |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>/</kbd> | Open this plugin's settings page | All |

<kbd>Ctrl</kbd>/<kbd>Cmd</kbd>+<kbd>/</kbd> is the built-in shortcut reference's
default binding. This plugin claims it through the shortcut preference layer, so
the reference dialog moves off that key and stays reachable from **Settings →
General → Edit shortcuts**. Turning the switch off restores the original
binding.

### Input optimisation

When enabled, the composer's three Enter gestures rotate:

| Stroke | Default | With input optimisation |
|---|---|---|
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> | Send | Insert a line break |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Enter</kbd> | Complementary Queue/Steer | Send |
| <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Enter</kbd> | Insert a line break | Complementary Queue/Steer |

The switch is off by default.

## Configuration

The plugin reads two preferences from browser storage. Both are off-by-default
except the shortcut takeover, and both are per device.

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `optimizeComposerKeys` | `false` | Rotate the composer's Enter gestures |
| `takeOverShortcutKey` | `true` | Give <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>/</kbd> to this plugin |

Preferences live in `localStorage` under `dsh.keyboard-shortcut.v1`, beside the
key bindings DSH itself stores per device. They are not in the Host settings
document, so one machine's choice cannot rewrite another's.

Changing a binding through the settings page writes to the same store DSH's own
shortcut editor uses: `localStorage` on Web, and `userData/keybindings.json`
under Electron.

## Permissions

The plugin requests no elevated permissions. It reads the session projections
DSH already publishes to the browser and runs the same `/permission` command the
built-in picker runs. It performs no filesystem access and no network requests.

## Known limitations

- **Cycle, effort, status-page and task-list shortcuts are Desktop-only by
  default.** DSH reserves <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Q</kbd> outside Desktop Windows
  and macOS, and browsers claim <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>1</kbd>…<kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>8</kbd>
  for tab switching. <kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>A</kbd> and <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>L</kbd>
  are not admitted by the browser allowlist at all — a single non-primary
  modifier is refused, and both keys are spoken for. All five commands exist on
  every platform and can be bound by hand; they simply ship unbound where the
  combination cannot work.
- **The status-page shortcut reuses an open page.** The sidebar browser
  registers itself as a tab type that may appear more than once, so opening it
  through the sidebar's own API always mints a new tab. The plugin therefore
  looks for an existing browser tab first and reveals it, expanding the column
  if it is collapsed. A tab belonging to another session is ignored, because the
  sidebar only reveals tabs in the session on screen.
- **The task-list toggle clicks the panel header.** DSH keeps the collapsed
  state inside the panel component and exposes no handle, so the shortcut drives
  the same button a click would. A session with no task list shows nothing to
  toggle, which the shortcut reports instead of failing.
- **Prompt navigation drives the turn rail.** DSH publishes no service for
  jumping to a turn, so the shortcut activates the rail's own marks. A turn is
  anchored at its first user message, so "previous input" means "previous turn".
- **The page keys cannot be registered, so they are read raw.**
  <kbd>PgUp</kbd>/<kbd>PgDn</kbd> are handled through `observeFixedInput`
  rather than `registerFixed`, because DSH's shortcut registry validates every
  declared code against a closed whitelist — `Key*`, `Digit*`, `F1`–`F24`, and a
  fixed set of named keys that does **not** include the page keys.
  `registerFixed` normalizes its bindings up front and throws
  `Unsupported shortcut code: PageUp`, so a registration could never succeed.
  The keyboard layer forwards every keydown to `observeFixedInput` regardless of
  registration, so the keys work; they just have no catalog row, and the settings
  page lists them from a local table as non-rebindable rows.
- **The composer remap is a DOM-layer integration.** The composer's keymap is
  private to `dsh-client-ui-conversation`; the option rewrites an event's
  modifier flags rather than reimplementing the send logic. See
  [docs/design.md](docs/design.md) for the reasoning and the failure mode.
- **The settings navigation glyph is a DOM patch.** DSH chooses navigation icons
  with a hardcoded switch on the section id and offers no icon field on the
  registration, so the glyph is applied with a CSS mask.
- **Recording loses React state.** Rebinding re-registers the command and
  re-renders the page, like any catalog change.

## Development

```sh
npm install
npm run build      # writes lib/index.js and lib/client.js
npm test           # build check + unit tests
npm run watch      # rebuild the client half on change
```

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) and
[docs/development.md](docs/development.md).

## Documentation

- [docs/design.md](docs/design.md) — architecture and the decisions behind it
- [docs/shortcuts.md](docs/shortcuts.md) — every binding, its owner, and its
  failure modes
- [docs/development.md](docs/development.md) — building, testing, releasing

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: 把本机已登录的 Cursor 模型接入 DeepSeek Harness：原生 LlmAdapter 直连 agent.v1.AgentService/Run 双向流
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-connect-cursor

把本机已登录的 Cursor 桌面应用的模型接入 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（`dsh`），在 dsh 的模型选择器里直接使用 Cursor 账号能调用的模型。

> 非官方。逆向自 Cursor 的 `agent.v1.AgentService/Run` 私有协议（ConnectRPC + Protobuf + HTTP/2 双向流），与 Cursor（Ansysphere）、DeepSeek 均无关联。仅供个人学习研究。

## 工作原理

- 读 Cursor 桌面应用的登录态（`state.vscdb` 里的 JWT），不启动额外 OAuth
- 通过 HTTP/2 双向流调用 `agent.v1.AgentService/Run`，用原生 `LlmAdapter` 把 Cursor 的流式增量翻成 dsh 的 `StreamChunk`（不走 loopback 代理）
- 模型目录通过 `AvailableModels` unary 调用实时拉取

## 凭据来源（按优先级）

1. `CURSOR_ACCESS_TOKEN` 环境变量
2. 桌面应用 `state.vscdb`（SQLite，需 Node 22.5+ 内置 `node:sqlite`）
3. CLI 的 `auth.json`（macOS/Linux `~/.config/cursor/`，Windows `%APPDATA%\Cursor\`）
4. `CURSOR_API_KEY`（`crsr_` 开头，换取短期 token）

均为只读，不写入桌面应用文件。JWT 约 1 小时有效，由运行中的桌面应用刷新；过期时重新打开 Cursor 即可。

## 已知限制

- 协议私有、版本门控：`x-cursor-client-version` 过期会被上游以误导性限流错误拒绝，用 `CURSOR_CLI_VERSION` 跟一个真实 CLI 版本号
- `model_details.model_id` 必须是默认 variant 的 slug（如 `claude-sonnet-5-thinking-high`），基础 id 会被拒为 `ERROR_BAD_MODEL_NAME`
- `UserMessageAction` 必须带 `request_context`（缺了服务端只发心跳不产出）
- `lib/schema.js` 从 Cursor 自带的 `workbench.desktop.main.js` 提取 protobuf schema（约 800 个类型），供 Cursor 升级后重新核对字段号；编码本身不依赖它
- token 用量统计：Cursor 不总发 `turn_ended`，`usage` 可能为空

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:greatyao/dsh-connect-cursor
```

安装后重启 dsh，模型选择器出现 `cursor` 分组。

## 开发

```sh
node --test test/*.test.js   # 46 个单测
```

## 平台支持

macOS / Windows / Linux。插件按平台探测 Cursor 桌面应用的安装位置：

- macOS：`/Applications/Cursor.app/Contents/Resources/app`
- Windows：`%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\cursor\resources\app`
- Linux：`/usr/share/cursor/resources/app`、`/opt/Cursor/resources/app`

非默认安装位置用 `CURSOR_APP_PATH` 指向应用根目录，或用 `CURSOR_WORKBENCH_BUNDLE` 直接指向 `workbench.desktop.main.js`。

凭据按平台读取：macOS `~/Library/Application Support/Cursor/User/globalStorage/state.vscdb`、Windows `%APPDATA%\Cursor\User\globalStorage\state.vscdb`、Linux `~/.config/Cursor/User/globalStorage/state.vscdb`。需 Node 22.5+（内置 `node:sqlite`）。

Windows 上未实测；如遇问题请提 issue。

## 免责声明

仅供个人学习研究使用。使用者需遵守 Cursor 的服务条款，因使用本项目产生的后果由使用者自行承担。

## 许可证

MIT

plugins.description: 算法备案与告知：查算法推荐服务有没有关闭选项、告知、备案。
plugins.readme_text:
# @deepwhale-cn/dsh-algorithm-filing

**算法备案与告知** —— 查算法推荐服务有没有**关闭选项**、告知、备案。

## 不装它会怎样

你的 App 有「猜你喜欢」，代码大概是这样：

```js
async function recommend(userId) {
  const tags = await getUserTags(userId);
  return await rankByTags(tags);
}
```

**功能正常，但漏了一条硬要求：**

> **《互联网信息服务算法推荐管理规定》第十七条**
> 应当向用户提供选择或者删除用于针对其个人特征的标签的功能，
> **提供便捷的关闭算法推荐服务的选项。**
> 用户选择关闭算法推荐服务的，**应当立即停止提供相关服务**。

**这是「必须提供」，不是「建议提供」。** 而且关闭后要**真的停止** —— 不是记下偏好但照推。

## 关键词
**关键词**：算法备案 · 算法推荐 · 关闭算法推荐 · 关闭个性化 · 算法说明 · 深度合成标识 · AI 生成标识 · 算法治理
**Keywords**: algorithm filing · recommendation algorithm · opt-out · algorithm disclosure · AI-generated label

## 它查什么

| 级别 | 内容 | 依据 |
|---|---|---|
| 🔴 高 | 有推荐算法但**找不到关闭选项** | 算法推荐规定 17 条 |
| 🟡 中 | 找不到算法推荐**说明/公示** | 算法推荐规定 16 条 |
| 🟡 中 | 找不到**算法备案号** | 算法推荐规定 24 条 |
| 🟡 中 | AI 生成内容找不到**标识** | 深度合成规定 17 条 |

## 四条规则都是「条件适用」的

没有推荐算法 / 没有 AI 生成功能的项目，这四条**全部不适用** —— 引擎会记为「未运行」，
而不是报「找不到」。（这是条件规则能力 `check.when`，也是防假绿的一部分。）

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-algorithm-filing
# 或纯 CLI
npx @deepwhale-cn/dsh-algorithm-filing
```

![dsh-algorithm-filing 检查报告示例](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-algorithm-filing/report.png)

![dsh-algorithm-filing 演示模式输出](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-algorithm-filing/demo.png)

![dsh-algorithm-filing 规则与依据](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-algorithm-filing/rules.png)

## 用法

```bash
dsh-algorithm-filing --demo
dsh-algorithm-filing --list-rules
dsh-algorithm-filing --html r.html
```

## 边界

- **备案不是所有推荐服务都要** —— 第 24 条限定「具有舆论属性或社会动员能力」的服务
  （资讯、社交、直播、热搜类）。电商推荐可能不需要。**报出来请自行确认适用范围。**
- **不验证备案号真伪** —— 那要去网信办备案系统查，本工具不联网。
- **「关闭选项」只查代码里有没有** —— 产品上真的能关、关了真的停，需要人工验证。
- **靠关键词识别功能** —— 自定义命名会漏。
- 与 [dsh-consent-guard](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-consent-guard) 分工：
  那个查**个人信息同意**，这个查**算法服务**的专门要求。

本插件是一个工具。使用者必须遵守所在地区法律法规，**对使用本项目造成的任何后果自行承担责任。**

---

## 深鲸网安守护系列（共 31 个）

> 一个插件做一件事。**安全问题是链式的** —— 配套用才完整。
