plugins.description: Normify · DSH 插件：把项目架构写成归一化的分形模块树，三层校验（写时 / 校验 / 冻结回执）、30 个 normify_* 工具 + normify-gen 技能，一键渲染单文件交互式架构图；支持伴随式开发（change_open → brief → check → 实施 → refresh → change_close）。
plugins.readme_text:
English · 简体中文

Normify · 归一化框架图构建器

把整个项目描述成一棵"人机共读"的分形模块树：AI 负责分析与创作，确定性引擎负责校验、编译与渲染 —— 点开任意模块，就是一张更精细的子图。

--- ## 0. 一句话 Normify 是 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件**，也是**一套写给 AI 用的开发流程**： - **给 AI 的**：`normify-gen` 技能 + **31 个 `normify_*` 工具** —— 让模型把仓库分析成模块树结构数据， 并在后续开发中**先建图后编程、伴随编程改图**（计划态建树 → 逐个实现 → 关单收尾）。 - **给引擎的**：零容忍校验（L1 写时 / L2 全项目 / L3 冻结）+ 确定性编译（`tree.json` 等四件产物，SHA-256 冻结） + 渲染数据（`renders/`，决定"每一层怎么画"）。 - **给人的**：**单文件交互式架构图**（`normify.html`）—— 逐层下钻、悬停看介绍、一键中英切换、深链接、 多树、**API 直连箭头**、跨层聚合、缩放与搜索。零依赖，双击即开。 > 它不是"生成一张图就结束"的工具：结构数据与代码**互为契约**，每次改动都能被 `normify_sync` 检出漂移， > 并以 `normify_change_close`（**0 error 强制**）收尾，让"代码 → 架构图"永远同步。


引擎层：14 个模块、API 直连箭头（箭头锚定到具体 API 行）、带标签的子系统依赖、跨层聚合虚线

## 1. 它解决什么问题 | 痛点 | Normify 的做法 | | --- | --- | | 架构图一画完就过期 | 结构数据是**可校验的源数据**：`normify_sync` 按 `fingerprint` 检出漂移，`normify_change_close` 强制 0 error 收尾 | | 图太粗，看不出接口契约 | 粒度到**单一功能单元**，API 写在叶子上，箭头可锚定到具体 API（`from_api`/`to_api`） | | AI 改代码时"看不见全局" | `normify_brief` 给出目标模块契约、影响面（谁依赖我）、规则约束与验收清单 | | 设计先写代码后补文档，必然漂移 | **计划态先建树**（`state: planned`）→ 实现后 `normify_module_refresh(activate)` 自动转 active | | 结构规范靠人自觉 | `policy.yml` 架构规则（依赖方向 / 禁依赖 / 无环 / 深度 / 跨树 / 命名）由 `validate` 强制执行 | | 大仓库一次生成太重 | 增量再生成：只重建受影响子树，`layouts_to_review` 点名要复核的层 | ## 2. 核心特性 ### 2.1 数据模型：分形 + 零冗余 - **唯一元素**：整个数据库由无数个结构完全相同的**基本模块**构成（每个模块 = 一个 Markdown 文件）。 - **只存 `parent`**：单方向引用，`children` 由索引导出 —— 不会出现"父子各说各话"。 - **API 只在叶子存一次**：聚合、统计、索引全部是编译期派生数据（`tree.json` / `api-index.json`）。 - **两类边**：containment（树边，导航骨架）+ dependency（箭头，可跨子树、跨树，按 `kind` 着色）。 - **路径式 id + 不变 uid**：AI 沿 id 逐层定位（类二分查找）；`uid` 在改名/移动时保持不变，git diff 稳定。 - **深度不设上限**（0.5.0 起）：想有多细就拆多细，深度不再成为"合并模块"的理由。 ### 2.2 三层校验，fail-closed | 层 | 时机 | 内容 | | --- | --- | --- | | **L1** | 每次写入 | 必填字段、id 文法、uid、parent 一致性、双语长度、source/apis/deps 形状、state/replacement | | **L2** | `normify_validate` | 全项目：唯一性、文件↔id 映射、叶子/非叶子规则、API 键唯一、依赖目标、环、渲染数据交叉校验、架构规则、变更日志、（可选）仓库证据（source 存在性 + 指纹一致） | | **L3** | `normify_build` | 任何 error 都不产出产物；产出即 SHA-256 冻结进 `receipt.json` | 每条诊断都带 `severity / code / message / subject / evidence / supportedFixes` —— **AI 可自行修复**。 ### 2.3 渲染器：单文件、可下钻、API 直连 - 单文件 HTML（内联 CSS/JS，**零外部依赖**、零遥测），双击即开，可直接归档/发人。 - 逐层下钻 + 面包屑 + 搜索（模块名/API）+ 大纲视图 + API 浏览器。 - **API 直连**：叶子框内展示 API 明细行，箭头锚定到具体 API 行的端口；同一 API 行上的多条边自动扇形分离。 - 跨层依赖聚合为虚线 `×N`（默认隐藏，工具栏或 `?agg=1` 开启，悬停看明细）。 - 深链接：`#module=`、`#api=`、`#view=outline`、`?lang=zh|en`、`?agg=1`；缩放 / 悬停高亮 / 明暗主题。 - **几何自检**：仓库自带 `check-geometry.mjs`，逐层断言"线不出界 / 不贴框 / 不穿框 / 不压线"。 ### 2.4 伴随开发：先建图后编程 ``` change_open → brief → check → module_batch(state=planned) → 【写代码】 → module_refresh(activate) → change_close(0 error 强制) → verified + revision.after ``` - **计划态**：源码还不存在也能先建树（`fingerprint: pending`），`validate` 放行； - **禁止假激活**：源码没落地就 `activate` 直接被拒； - **收尾即闭环**：`change_close` 会刷新指纹 → 校验（0 error 强制）→ 编译（可选渲染）→ 标记 `verified`， 任何一步失败都不关闭，变更保持原状态； - **改图随代码**：`normify_sync` 用 `git diff` + 未跟踪文件定位受影响模块与指纹漂移，`module_patch` 跟随更新。 ### 2.5 架构规则先行（policy.yml） | 规则 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `dependency-direction` | 层顺序即允许的依赖方向（如 plugin → tools → engine），可控制同层是否允许 | | `forbid-dependency` | 禁止某些 from → to 的依赖（可按 kind / state 过滤） | | `acyclic` | 依赖图禁止成环（可含跨树） | | `max-depth` | id 段数上限（**可选**：不写就是不限，0.5.0 起默认不限） | | `cross-tree` | 跨树依赖策略：`forbid` / `allow` / `require-to-api` | | `naming` | 作用域内 id 段的命名正则 | 安装后 `normify_validate` / `normify_build` / `normify_check` 全部强制执行；**违规先改设计，不能绕过**。 ## 3. 最新变化 ### v0.5.4 · 把"第二轮 A/B 实测"暴露的 4 个工具缺陷修掉（当前版本） 第二轮 A/B 换了题目（**表格公式引擎 + CLI**，同一份规范、隐藏黑盒 88 项、外加**差分模糊测试**）。 两组最终 B 88/88、A 87/88（差异只有一条 §5.2 语义）；这一版修的是**工具侧**新暴露的 4 个坑： - **`mode:"patch"` 的静默 no-op 被拦下**：原来 `items:[{patch:{id, tags:[...]}}]`（少一层包装）会返回 `ok:true, count:1` 却**一个字段都没改**——最危险的"假成功"。现在直接报 `args/invalid-patch`， evidence 里给出收到的键与正确形状 `{patch:{id, patch:{...}}}`；单模块 `normify_module_patch` 传空补丁 同样报 `args/empty-patch`（只给 `expect_updated_at` 也不再静默通过）。 - **`normify_module_refresh` 不再强依赖 git**：`repoRoot` 不是 git 仓库时，以前直接 `refresh/git-failed` 失败（实测中 AI 只能 `git init` 才能激活模块）。现在改成**降级**：指纹照常重算、 `state` 照常激活，`revision` 保持模块原值，并给出 `refresh/git-unavailable` 警告与修法。 - **`change_open` 的 `acceptance` 报错具体化**：以前把 `{zh,en}` 写进 acceptance 只有一句笼统报错； 现在明确写出"**第 N 条不是非空字符串（收到 …）：验收标准只接受纯字符串**"，并提示双语描述写进 `title`/`intent`。 - **`normify_help` 支持 `topic:"tool:<工具名>"`**：`tools` 主题现在每个工具都带**必填/可选**摘要， 新主题可按需打印**完整参数树**（类型 / 描述 / 必填，由注册表实时生成、与运行时校验同源）。 实测里 AI 为确认 `mode=patch` 的嵌套形状去读了插件源码——这条主题正是为了消灭这种绕路。 ### v0.5.3 · 把「伴随编程实测」暴露的 4 个摩擦点修掉 这四个问题来自一次真实的 A/B 对照实验：两个 AI 用同一份规范写同一个后端，一个带插件走伴随流程、一个纯手写 （最终代码在隐藏黑盒验收上都是 **42/42**）。插件组多交付了 41 模块 / 110 API / 10 层的结构数据，但也踩到了下面 4 个坑： - **`normify_help` 支持 `topic`**：此前它完全忽略入参，只返回同一份字段速查 —— 实测里 AI 为了拿准 `change_open` / `layout_upsert` / `change_close` 的参数名，只能去读插件源码（多花约 4 分钟）。 现在按主题返回：`fields`（默认）/ `deps`（箭头与 API 直连）/ `renders` / `flow`（伴随流程）/ `tools`（工具清单）/ `policy` / `errors`（常见诊断码与修法）/ `all`；**传错主题会直接报错并列出可用主题**，不再静默忽略。 - **项目初始化通道**：新增第 31 个工具 `normify_project_init` —— 建 `normify-/` + 默认架构规则， 可选 `root` 一步创建"计划态根模块"（幂等）；同时 `normify_change_open` 现在也会**自动建项目目录** （此前报 `project/no-modules`，AI 只能用 `module_batch {items:[],dry_run:true}` 绕过去）； `normify_brief` 遇到不存在的模块会给出"先 init / 先建树 / 改用 task"的可执行提示。 - **批量诊断的因果链**：一条 `label-too-long` 曾连带出 3 条 `dep/target-missing`（因为 L1 失败的模块会被移出批次工作集）， AI 只能去读源码才能确认根因。现在连带错误改报 `dep/target-dropped` / `structure/parent-dropped`， 在 message 与 evidence 里点明**根因诊断码**，并在失败响应的 `root_causes` 里直接列出被丢弃的模块（附 `hint`）。 - **「API 直连」引导**：两端都声明了 API 却没写 `from_api` / `to_api` 的箭头，`normify_validate` 会给出**聚合** warning `dep/unanchored`（条数 + 前 3 条示例）。这正是实验里被浪费的能力：110 条 API 声明，54 条箭头 0 条锚定 —— 不锚定，箭头就只能落在框边，钉不到 API 行上。**引导≠放宽**：锚错键仍然是 error。 ### v0.5.2 · 修掉三处会写坏数据的真实缺陷 - **`normify_module_upsert` 的必填表不再丢失**：`parameters.required` 恢复为 `["frontmatter"]`， `frontmatter` 的 9 个必填字段（uid / id / parent / name / description / source / revision / updated_at / fingerprint） 也重新出现在 schema 里。此前嵌套 schema 被二次编译，必填表被整段丢掉 —— 模型看到的约束与运行时实际校验不一致。 - **`normify_module_move` 迁移渲染数据时重写内容**：`id` / `order` / `groups.children` / `edge_hints` 全部改写到新 id， 并同步维护**旧父级**（删掉已迁出子模块的引用）与**新父级**（把新 id 补进 `order`）。 修复前：move 完之后项目立刻被 L2 判为 `layout/id-mismatch` + `layout/order-child` 等（实测 8–9 个 error，0.5.2 后为 0）。 - **晋升为容器时不再把 API 留在容器上**：叶子被晋升（显式 `normify_module_promote`、写子模块自动晋升、move 到叶子底下） 时，容器上残留的 `apis` 会被摘除，并回报 `structure/api-dropped-on-promote` 警告（附丢失的 API 键清单）—— 修复前项目会直接卡在 `api/non-leaf`。 - **API 默认全展开**：渲染数据字段 `max_api_rows` 缺省 **0 = 全部展开**，叶子上的 API 一行不折叠；需要收窄时显式写 1..48。 - 三处缺陷各自配了回归断言：`tests/regression-0.5.2.mjs`（34 项，全绿）。 ### v0.5.1 · 渲染器防重叠（线压线 12 → 0） - **修复连线共线重叠**：28 层合计 **12 处 → 0 处**。四处根因： ① 首选路由只判"不穿别人的框"，从不检查是否压到已画的线 → 改为只接受 `violations === 0` 的候选； ② API 锚定端口没有端口分离（同一 API 行被多条边共用） → 行内 ±5.5px 扇形分离； ③ API 端口落在上下边时被放进框内部 → 上下边退回按边均匀分离； ④ `segClear` 整块跳过源/目标框 → 新增"进入自身框内部"检查（内缩 2px）。 - 节点/分组间距 170 → 220，给密集层更多自由通道。 ### v0.5.0 · 取消模块数量上限 - **删除 `MAX_DEPTH = 12`** 硬限制：树可以一直下钻到"单一功能单元"；需要限层时用 `policy.yml` 的 `max-depth` 规则显式声明（`maxDepth` 放宽到 1..64）。 - SKILL：目标深度改为"不设上限"，单批上限 40 → 200，新增"每叶 API 尽量 3–5 条"的粒度指引。
更早的版本（v0.4.x / v0.3 / v0.2 / v0.1） - **v0.4.1**：渲染器 v3 定稿（自由通道走线、viewBox 全几何自适应、API 直连、跨层聚合、缩放与悬停）； `normify_sync` 识别**未跟踪的新文件**（`git ls-files --others`）。 - **v0.4.0**：伴随开发（`state: pla

plugins.description: TypeSafe Jev for DeepSeek Harness, the Model Context Protocol, and plain Node: typed judgments instead of prose, offline by default.
plugins.readme_text:
# jevcore
[![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/jevcore?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/plugins/PerryLink/jevcore?ref=badge)

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)
[![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore/badge)](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore)
[![jevcore MCP server](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore/badges/score.svg)](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore)

TypeSafe [Jev](https://typesafe.ai) for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
and any other MCP host.

Jev is not a chat model. It answers typed questions — `noul` (yes/no), `choice`, `score` — and returns
calibrated probabilities. It does not write prose, and asking it to is a category error. This project
gives an agent exactly that surface, and nothing more.

**Offline by default. Egress disclosed. Nothing default-on.**

---

**📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/).

<!-- star-cta -->
## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你

这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（40+ 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。

*English:* part of a 40+ plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it.


## Three packages, one decision layer

| Package | What it is | Use it when |
|---|---|---|
| [`jevcore`](packages/core) | The decisions. Imports nothing from DeepSeek Harness or Cordis. | You want Jev in a plain script, a service, or your own harness |
| [`jevcore-dsh`](packages/dsh) | The DSH plugin: one service, three tools, two opt-in gates | You are running DeepSeek Harness |
| [`jevcore-mcp`](packages/mcp) | The same three tools over MCP, with a stdio binary | Your host speaks MCP but is not DSH |

The adapters are thin on purpose. `packages/dsh` is four files: it declares tool schemas and
translates hook payloads. Everything decision-shaped — the primitives, the providers, the egress
contract, the policy, the gates — lives in core, so a new adapter cannot drift from the guarantees
the others make.
One runtime requirement differs across the three: `jevcore-dsh` tracks the harness and needs
Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`, while `jevcore` and `jevcore-mcp` need `>=20`.

---

## Why this exists

Between 2026-09-17 and 09-20, nineteen plugins appeared that wire Jev into DSH. Auditing their source
found a consistent pattern: the module labelled *guard*, *gate*, or *warden* was also the module
shipping prompts, tool arguments, and file contents to a third party, and the README generally did not
say so. Several were enabled by default. One gate could be reconfigured by the model it was guarding.

This project is the same idea with those failure modes designed out:

| Property | How it is guaranteed here |
|---|---|
| No network call unless you ask for one | Default provider is an offline mock; the live path needs both `provider: live` and a resolved credential |
| Every transmission named before it happens | One startup log line per feature: `off` or `SENDS <feature> { fields }` |
| Gates register nothing when disabled | Verified by test, not by policy — a disabled gate adds no event listener at all |
| The model cannot widen its own constraints | No tool exposes gate configuration |
| A judge that cannot answer never means "allow" | Undecided resolves through explicit config, defaulting to `ask` |

---

## The egress contract

This is the part worth reading before installing.

Transmission is decided per feature, and every feature defaults to off. The plugin prints its own
contract at load:

```
[jevcore] provider=mock  endpoint=none  egress=OFF  (no network calls will be made; every answer is synthetic)
[jevcore] ready - provider=mock - gates: safety=off context=off
```

With `provider: live` and every feature enabled, the same report becomes explicit about what leaves:

```
[jevcore] provider=live  endpoint=https://api.typesafe.ai  egress=ON
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_ask  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_rank  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_check  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:safety  { state<=8000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:context  { state<=6000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   redaction is best-effort; it removes named fields and known secret shapes, and cannot
             recognise an unrecognised secret in free text
```

| Feature | Off by default? | What it sends |
|---|---|---|
| `tool:jev_ask` | runs when the model calls it | the arguments the model passed, after redaction |
| `tool:jev_rank` | runs when the model calls it | the query plus every candidate |
| `tool:jev_check` | runs when the model calls it | the claim and its evidence |
| `gate:safety` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | the tool name, its arguments, the workspace root |
| `gate:context` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | a large tool result the agent just received |

The tools transmit only when the model chooses to call them, which is visible in the transcript. The
gates would run on every matching tool call, which is not, so they are opt-in.

### Redaction, and its honest limit

Before anything is sent, `src/redact.ts` runs two passes: values under sensitive field names
(`password`, `token`, `apiKey`, `authorization`, …) are replaced wholesale, and secret-shaped strings
that survive into free text are pattern-matched (`Bearer …`, `sk-…`, `ts_live_…`, AWS/GitHub/Google
key shapes, JWTs, private-key headers, credentials in connection strings).

This is a mitigation, not a permission. A secret that sits under an unrecognised key name *and* does
not match a known shape will pass through. If that possibility is unacceptable for your workload, do
not enable the live provider.

---

## Install

### As a DeepSeek Harness plugin

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add jevcore-dsh
```

Or from a checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/dsh
```

`packages/dsh` imports `jevcore` by name, so a checkout also needs core
resolvable from the profile (`add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/core`).

Then confirm the row activated — the plugin list should show `jev` as `active`,
not `failed` — and check the startup report in the log.

### As an MCP server

For a host that speaks MCP, the same three tools are available over stdio:

```sh
npx -y jevcore-mcp
```

To wire it into DeepSeek Harness specifically, install a configuration-only bundle
whose patch inserts the harness's own MCP client:

```yml
- insert:
    - id: jev-mcp
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: jev
        transport: stdio
        command: npx
        args: ['-y', 'jevcore-mcp']
        env:
          TYPESAFE_API_KEY: '<the key>'
        failOnStartupError: true
```

The env map is not optional: DSH strips every credential-shaped name — anything
containing KEY, PASSWORD, SECRET or TOKEN, in any case — from the environment it
hands a spawned server, then merges this map back in afterwards. A key exported in
your shell never arrives, and the server stays on the offline mock without
reporting an error.

The provider is chosen from the environment:

| Variable | Effect |
|---|---|
| `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` | Selects the TypeSafe route when present |
| `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` | Selects the OpenRouter route when present and no TypeSafe key is set |
| `JEV_PROVIDER` | `mock`, `live`, or `openrouter` — overrides the heuristic above |
| `TYPESAFE_MODEL` / `OPENROUTER_MODEL` | Model id for the selected route |
| `TYPESAFE_BASE_URL` / `OPENROUTER_BASE_URL` | API root for the selected route |

With neither key it stays on the offline mock. Unlike the plugin, the MCP server
resolves its credential once at startup, so a missing key with
`JEV_PROVIDER=live` is a startup error rather than a per-call surprise.

plugins.description: Session deletion for DeepSeek Harness: recoverable trash-based delete, a sidebar menu row, and session_delete / session_restore agent tools.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-delete

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

[![test](https://github.com/hakulat2023/dsh-session-delete/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/hakulat2023/dsh-session-delete/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-0b7285)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

Session **deletion** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

DeepSeek Harness can archive a Session, but archiving only hides it — there is no way to get rid of
one. This plugin adds that missing verb: **Delete session** in the Session row's “…” menu, a
`remote.sessionDelete` host namespace, and the `session_delete` / `session_restore` agent tools.

Deletion is deliberately **recoverable**: the Session's durable log is moved into a local trash
directory, so a mistake costs a `mv`, not a conversation.

- [What it does](#what-it-does)
- [Requirements](#requirements)
- [Install](#install)
- [Use](#use)
- [Configuration](#configuration)
- [Semantics and limits](#semantics-and-limits)
- [Development](#development)
- [Verified behaviour](#verified-behaviour)
- [License](#license)

## What it does

One deletion performs four steps:

1. **Admission.** The Session is asked the same questions archiving asks, through the
   `workspace/session-activity` waterfall. Live work is refused unless the caller allows a stop;
   when it is, `workspace/session-stop` cancels the turn and the plugin waits (bounded) for the
   Session to go idle. A Session still resident in the host process is refused *before any side
   effect* and only deleted after a second, explicit confirmation.
2. **Trash the log.** The Session's own directory is handed to the **platform's own trash** — the
   Finder's Trash on macOS, the XDG trash on Linux, the Recycle Bin on Windows — as
   `<sessionId>-<timestamp>`, carrying a `trash.json` record with the title, `cwd`, original
   directory, byte/file counts, and deletion time. `purge: true` deletes it outright instead.
   A small record is also written under `$DSH_HOME/session-delete/entries/` (entry path plus original
   directory, **no Session content**), because macOS refuses to let a process *enumerate* `~/.Trash`
   (TCC): without it a trashed Session could not be found again. See
   [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md).
3. **Drop the registrations.** The Session is detached from every Workspace account
   (`sessionIds`), removed from the registry-global archive and pin sets, and its projection-cache
   record is deleted.
4. **Tell the UI.** `api-session/removed` is emitted, so every connected browser drops the row
   immediately.

The Session directory is located through the persistence backend's own `locate(header)` when it
offers one, so a backend that changes its on-disk layout does not need a plugin update; otherwise the
plugin falls back to the documented `sessions/<projectKey(cwd)>/<encodeSegment(id)>` layout.

## Requirements

| | |
|---|---|
| DeepSeek Harness | `0.2.x` (developed and verified against `0.2.0-rc.2`) |
| Node.js | `>= 20` |
| Surface | any profile that mounts the Session store, the JSONL persistence backend, the Workspace registry, and the Web client (`dsh-web-app` / desktop) |

The plugin has **no npm dependencies** and **no build step**: the browser half is a hand-written
module in the `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` shape the Web client already consumes,
and the host half imports nothing outside `node:*`. See
[docs/plugin-packaging.md](docs/plugin-packaging.md) for why that matters for third-party plugins.

## Install

The package is a DSH **bundle**: `package.json` declares `dsh.bundle.patch` and `dsh.client`, and
`cordis.patch.yml` inserts the host row.

```bash
# from a local checkout (this repository)
plugin_manager install_bundle   target: /absolute/path/to/dsh-session-delete

# or from GitHub, by tag, with the bundled CLI
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:hakulat2023/dsh-session-delete#v0.1.0

# or from the registry, once published
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-session-delete
```

The bundle patch that gets mounted is one row:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: session-delete
      name: dsh-session-delete
```

After installing, **restart the application once**. The host half is a Node ESM module and the
running process keeps the module generation it already loaded (DSH's own limitation: a replaced
package needs a restart to load fresh JavaScript). The browser half is served from disk and only
needs a page reload.

## Use

### Web UI

Session row → **“…”** → **Delete session** → confirm.

- A **running** Session is stopped first: the first confirmation already carries that intent.
- A Session that is still **resident** in the host (typically the one you have open) is described as
  such and needs a second confirmation; the first click has no side effect at all.
- On success the row disappears everywhere and a toast reports the outcome **and the trash directory**
  (a Session whose log was already gone is reported as such, never as a move).

### Agent tools

| Tool | Arguments | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `session_delete` | `session_id` (required), `stop_activity` (default `true`), `force` (default `false`), `purge` (default `false`) | Moves the Session to the trash; `purge: true` deletes the bytes permanently instead. |
| `session_restore` | `session_id` (required) | Moves a trashed Session directory back to its original location. |

### Remote namespace

`remote.sessionDelete.delete({ sessionId, stopActivity?, force?, purge? })` and
`remote.sessionDelete.restore({ sessionId })` — the same operations the UI dialog uses.

### Restoring by hand

A trashed Session is an ordinary directory in the platform's trash:

| Platform | Where it went | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| macOS | `~/.Trash/<sessionId>-<timestamp>/` | Finder shows it; “Put Back” is not offered (Finder did not move it), but `session_restore` works |
| Linux | `$XDG_DATA_HOME/Trash/files/…` with its `.trashinfo` | the desktop's own “Restore” works as well |
| Windows | the Recycle Bin | the plugin cannot read the bin back, so restore it by hand |

```bash
cat ~/.Trash/<sessionId>-*/trash.json      # originalDirectory, title, cwd, sizes
```

`session_restore(session_id)` puts it back and withdraws both records; the Session reappears in the
list once the Workspace registry next indexes stored headers (a reload, or the next launch).

## Configuration

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `trash` | `"system"` | Destination: `"system"` uses the platform's own trash, `"directory"` uses `trashRoot`, and any other string is taken as an absolute directory. |
| `trashRoot` | `$DSH_HOME/session-trash` | The directory used by `trash: directory` (and by `trashRoot` alone, for 0.1 compatibility). |
| `restoreIndexRoot` | `$DSH_HOME/session-delete` | Where the restore records live (`entries/<entry name>.json`). Metadata only — never Session content. |

```yaml
# keep the platform trash (the default): nothing to configure
- id: session-delete
  name: dsh-session-delete

# or own the destination, e.g. on a machine whose ~/.Trash is undesirable
- id: session-delete
  name: dsh-session-delete
  config:
    trash: directory
    trashRoot: /Volumes/big/dsh-session-trash
```

## Semantics and limits

- **Your trash, your decision.** Deleted Sessions land in the platform's trash and stay there until
  *you* empty it; the plugin never empties it, and it leaves no trash directory of its own behind.
- **macOS will not let a process list `~/.Trash`.** Moving in, reading a known entry, and moving it
  back out all work; `readdir` is refused by TCC. That is the only reason a restore record exists —
  `session_restore` follows the record instead of searching the trash. Emptying the trash makes the
  record stale, and a stale record is pruned rather than reported as a failure.
- **Windows restore is manual.** The Recycle Bin has no consumer-facing API for finding an entry
  again, so `session_delete` reports `trashedTo: null` and `session_restore` explains that the folder
  has to be restored f

plugins.description: Open-source, local-first envelope messaging for DeepSeek Harness: a TypeScript node, human-first inbox, explainable collaborator discovery, and bounded LAN recovery.
plugins.readme_text:
# Linko

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Linko is open-source, local-first envelope messaging for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). It helps agents find the right collaborator, exchange scoped context, and continue a task under explicit human-controlled policies.

Linko is an early runnable MVP. The repository remains specification-driven: product boundaries, state transitions, delivery recovery, privacy rules, and architecture decisions are written beside the runtime.

## Why Linko

LAN messaging and approval panels are useful building blocks. Linko adds the part that becomes more useful with a person's own evidence and context:

- Each person and Agent can keep a subjective set of capability claims; later releases may attach signatures without creating a global reputation score.
- A task query can produce a local recommendation with evidence and an explanation.
- Context is shared by scope and purpose instead of being broadcast as a complete private history.
- A person can answer an inbound request, ask their Agent to draft a reply, or delegate a bounded response policy.
- Every delivery is a small envelope with a human-readable cover, machine-readable semantics, and an optional local body or safe surface.
- The experimental first group profile is capped at 500 member principals, with group delivery and message-layer E2EE as separate milestones.

## Project status

The MVP runs a SQLite-backed node and a human-first envelope inbox. It supports an explicit two-node HTTPS pairing profile with a durable outbox, pinned certificates, bearer authentication, retry-safe command IDs, and REST recovery. The local node also exposes an advisory loopback WebSocket for live UI hints; paired WSS delivery remains a later milestone. The replaceable TypeScript DSH companion bridge now provides `ask`, `inbox`, `inspect`, `draft`, `approve`, and `reply` adapters over the local API. Message signatures and E2EE remain later milestones; this is not a 20,000-node capacity claim.

- Product scope: [English](docs/specs/0001-product-scope.md) · [中文](docs/specs/0001-product-scope.zh.md)
- Architecture: [English](docs/architecture.md) · [中文](docs/architecture.zh.md)
- State and storage: [English](docs/specs/0005-state-and-storage.md) · [中文](docs/specs/0005-state-and-storage.zh.md)
- Review record: [English](docs/review.md) · [中文](docs/review.zh.md)
- Roadmap: [English](ROADMAP.md) · [中文](ROADMAP.zh.md)
- Decisions: [English](docs/decisions/README.md) · [中文](docs/decisions/README.zh.md)
- Local node MVP: [English](packages/node/README.md) · [中文](packages/node/README.zh.md)
- DSH companion bridge: [English](packages/bridge/README.md) · [中文](packages/bridge/README.zh.md)
- Envelope inbox UI: [English](packages/web/DESIGN.md) · [中文](packages/web/DESIGN.zh.md)

## Design direction

The first physical store is one SQLite database behind one TypeScript node. Immutable event content is durable; delivery attempts, read state, approvals, and notifications are local operational state. REST cursor synchronization and the SQLite outbox remain the canonical recovery path. The approved [2026 transport decision](docs/decisions/0010-wss-live-session-and-recovery.md) selects WSS as the online live session; its implementation remains pending. A graph can be materialized later as a view over claims; a graph database is not required.

The network uses ordinary IP and authenticated TCP/TLS connections, with explicit pairing. mDNS/DNS-SD is an optional discovery hint only; it does not grant trust or carry message bodies. Linko adds no application-layer router or payload flooding, and requires no Linko-specific router or switch feature. WebTransport/QUIC remain deferred experiments alongside DHT, Merkle synchronization, full-mesh sockets, blockchain consensus, and Rust/WASM; each needs a measured reason and a fallback test.

## DeepSeek Harness fit

Linko is intended to be a community plugin and companion protocol for the DeepSeek Harness ecosystem. It follows the Harness model that capabilities are composable plugins, while keeping the Linko protocol independently usable by other agents and clients.

## Contributing

Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) and the repository guidance in [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md). Early contributions are most useful as design review, threat modeling, interoperability experiments, and small protocol fixtures.

## Topics

The repository is indexed with dsh, dsh-plugin, deepseek-harness, agent-collaboration, local-first, lan-messaging, envelope-messaging, human-in-the-loop, sqlite, typescript, and pnpm.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

# @deepwhale-cn/dsh-ai-output-trust

[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/feely0208/dsh-ai-output-trust)


**大模型安全**：直接执行模型输出（eval / shell / SQL / 文件路径）是风险很高的一类 —— 这里查代码里有没有这么干。

**关键词**：AI 输出 · AI 安全 · 提示注入 · 提示词注入 · 大模型安全 · 任意代码执行 · LLM 安全 · 大模型
**Keywords**: AI output trust · prompt injection · LLM security · code execution · OWASP LLM
**AI 输出信任边界** —— 检查代码有没有直接执行 AI 输出。

## 不装它会怎样

你的 agent 里有这么一行：

```js
eval(aiResponse);
```

想法是「让模型生成一小段脚本，我执行它」。

**但 AI 输出是不可信输入** —— 它可能被提示注入控制，也可能自己发挥。
你等于把**任意代码执行权交给了一个概率模型**。

OWASP 把这单列为 **LLM05 Improper Output Handling**。

## 它查什么

| 级别 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| 🔴 严重 | `eval(aiResponse)` / `new Function(...)` |
| 🔴 严重 | AI 输出拼进 `exec` / `spawn` |
| 🟠 高 | AI 输出拼进 SQL |
| 🟠 高 | 文件路径来自 AI 输出（路径穿越）|

## 它不会误报「只是调了模型」

变量识别用**精确命名**，不是「看到 `.content` 就报」。

**这段不报**（调了模型，但当成不可信输入处理）：
```js
const raw = result.choices[0].message.content;
const parsed = safeJsonParse(raw);
if (!schema.validate(parsed)) throw new Error('invalid');
```

**这段报**：
```js
eval(aiResponse);
```

## 正确的做法

```
AI 输出 → 结构化解析 → Schema 校验 → 白名单分支
        → 参数化查询
        → 路径规范化 + 断言在允许根目录内
```

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-ai-output-trust
# 或纯 CLI
npx @deepwhale-cn/dsh-ai-output-trust
```

## 用法

```bash
dsh-ai-output-trust --demo          # 看检出效果
dsh-ai-output-trust --list-rules    # 列出规则和依据
dsh-ai-output-trust --html r.html
```

![dsh-ai-output-trust 检查报告示例](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-ai-output-trust/report.png)

![dsh-ai-output-trust 演示模式输出](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-ai-output-trust/demo.png)

![dsh-ai-output-trust 规则与依据](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-ai-output-trust/rules.png)

## 边界

- **只查四种明确的高危用法**（eval / shell / SQL / 路径）。其它「间接信任」不在范围。
- **靠变量命名识别** —— 建议统一命名（`ai*` / `llm*` / `model*`），否则会漏。
- **不做数据流分析**，只看调用点附近。
- 与 [dsh-ci-guard](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-ci-guard) 分工：那个查 GitHub Actions 脚本注入，这个查运行时。

本插件是一个工具。使用者必须遵守所在地区法律法规，**对使用本项目造成的任何后果自行承担责任。**

---

## 深鲸网安守护系列（共 31 个）

> 一个插件做一件事。**安全问题是链式的** —— 配套用才完整。

**国内合规** ｜ [等保对照](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-mlps) · [日志留存](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-log-retention) · [备案公示](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-filing) · [用户同意](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-consent-guard) · [个人信息权利](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-rights) · [未成年人保护](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-minor-guard) · [影响评估](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-pipia) · [数据分类分级](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-classify) · [算法备案](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-algorithm-filing) · [数据出境](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-data-export) · [国密合规](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-crypto) · [AI 内容标识](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-ai-labeling)

**AI 与 Agent 治理** ｜ [**AI 输出信任**](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-ai-output-trust) · [外部内容信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-content-trust) · [MCP 安全](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-mcp-audit) · [Agent 权限](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-agent-scope) · [策略核对](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-agent-policy) · [可疑指令](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-phishing-guard)

**数据与凭据** ｜ [敏感数据](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-scan) · [密钥轮换](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-key-rotate) · [数据留存](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-lifecycle) · [配置审计](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-env-audit) · [密钥扫描](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-secret-scan)

**供应链与构建** ｜ [开源许可](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-license-guard) · [依赖投毒](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-dep-audit) · [CI 安全](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-ci-guard) · [工具审查](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-tool-vet) · [物料清单](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-sbom)

**权限与应急** ｜ [最小权限](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-least-privilege) · [告警外发](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-alert-relay) · [应急证据包](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-incident-package)

plugins.description: Declare an enterprise world, derive the agent's tools and permissions from it, and enforce them. A platform on DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.readme_text:
# DeepWork

[![CI](https://github.com/zhangcun1995521/deepwork/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/zhangcun1995521/deepwork/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

> An enterprise agent has to know what a project is, who owns it, which customer it belongs
> to, and **what it is allowed to touch**. DeepWork is where an enterprise writes that down —
> and where an agent's tools and permissions are derived from it, and enforced.
>
> It is deliberately not part of an agent. The world it describes belongs to the enterprise, so
> the second agent, the third, and the one after that read the same one.

DeepWork is a platform built on [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
(DSH). DSH ships a complete agent harness; DeepWork adds the one thing it does not ship — the
enterprise's own world, and the rules for acting in it. A plugin, not a fork, and a new domain
costs YAML rather than code.

## The whole project, as one line

Every part of this repository is one step of the same journey: a **world is declared**, an
**agent is equipped** from it, and what that agent does is **governed** on the way out.

```
   the enterprise's world                       what the agent gets
   ──────────────────────                       ────────────────────
①  declared    objects, relations, states,  →   a domain is data: `schema.yaml` and the
               who may write what                instances beside it

②  derived     read tools, the write tool,  →   a capability is declared, not coded —
               declared actions and queries      nothing in TypeScript to add or remove

③  authorised  `written_by` per type,       →   the host's own file and shell tools are
               roles per deployment              covered too; no roles means read-only

④  gated       states, the moves between    →   a move needing a second pair of eyes is
               them, and what each needs         refused without a verdict from somebody
                                                 other than the person making the move

⑤  recorded    the audit trail and write    →   every attempt, refusals included; field
               provenance                        names and never field values

⑥  checked     `npm run validate`           →   a declaration that did not take effect is
                                                 a failure, not a silence
```

Read it top to bottom and this repository is one thing. Read the sections below out of order
and it is a list of mechanisms.

The same line as a picture:

```mermaid
flowchart TB
  subgraph assembly["assembly"]
    prof["a profile: which plugins, which roles, which domain, which mode — changing the deployment changes only this layer"]
  end

  subgraph data["a domain — data, not code"]
    schema["schema.yaml — objects · relations · functions · states and transitions · who may write · actions · queries · situation · skill"]
    inst["the instances beside it"]
  end

  subgraph dw["DeepWork — a plugin, not a fork"]
    eng["the engine — reads the domain, builds the graph, derives the edges"]
    der["derivation — the read tools and query modes, the write tool, declared actions, the lifecycle's requirements"]
    gov["governance — the guard mounted globally in front of every call, permissions derived from written_by, review checked against provenance, an audit of field names and never field values"]
    inj["injection — the rules the situation marks, in the prompt and in the catalogue"]
    cap["a capability — a second plugin, declaring what its tools touch"]
  end

  subgraph hosted["the host — DeepSeek Harness"]
    loop["the agent loop · the tool registry · the skill and prompt registries · the session"]
    own["its own file and shell tools"]
  end

  prof --> dw
  schema --> eng
  inst --> eng
  eng --> der
  eng --> gov
  eng --> inj
  der -->|"the tool surface an agent is given"| loop
  inj -->|"the rules block, and the catalogue"| loop
  gov -->|"judges each call before it runs"| loop
  cap -->|"declares, so it is judged too"| gov
  gov -->|"or the host's own tools are the way around it"| own
  loop -->|"a write that was allowed"| wrote["the instance file, and one structured audit entry"]
  gov --> refused["a refusal, and one structured audit entry naming the rule that refused"]
```

Two places in that picture answer questions people expect one place to answer, so they are worth
naming. The guard is the door: before any tool runs, may this call touch this path at all. The write
path is the desk: may this content be written, by this caller, in this state. A capability's own
tools stop at the door; this plugin's write tool passes the door unjudged and is settled at the desk,
because nothing declares `ontology_write` and it is not in the built-in table — so its authority
lives inside the tool rather than in the mounted guard.

[docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md) is the same route written out — the layers, one write end to end, and the limits named; and the [same document in Chinese](docs/architecture.zh.md) is there for a reader who works in Chinese.

## Who this is for

Anyone putting an agent into a real business system. A forward-deployed engineer standing up
the first use case; a platform team that has to answer "what is this agent allowed to touch,
and who approved it"; the team that inherits it six months later.

## If you only look at one thing

`packages/ontology/examples/engagement` is the whole line at small scale: four stages, three of
them gated on a signature scoped to that stage, one declared action, one relation.

```sh
corepack pnpm install            # once, right after cloning — nothing else is needed
npm run validate                  # is it sound? exit 0 or a list of what did not take effect
node packages/ontology/scripts/show-derivation.ts packages/ontology/examples/engagement
```

The second command prints what came out of the declaration — and note what it prints with no
roles configured: three read tools, no write tool, and no actions derived, because an
unconfigured deployment is a read-only one.

Then `packages/ontology/src/examples.test.ts` runs it for real — a stage cannot be entered
without its signature, a signature for one stage does not open the next, and the role that
makes a move cannot sign for it. Those three sentences are the project, and they are a test
rather than a paragraph.

## The gap this fills

DSH ships a complete agent harness — loop, tools, skills, workflows, plan mode, approval,
subagents, sandboxing. What it does not ship is any notion of *the enterprise world* the
agent is working in. A general agent sees `document_001`, `project_782`, `user_23891`. An
enterprise agent needs to know what a project is, who owns it, which customer it belongs
to, and what it is allowed to touch.

That gap is semantic, not mechanical. This project fills it, and nothing else.

There is a third layer between the model and the harness, and this project is it. A model
reasons; a harness executes; neither knows what the enterprise *is*. That layer has to be
**declared**, and that word is doing the work. A context assembled per request out of whatever a
search surfaced is a guess about relevance — a good guess, and still a guess, and different on
Tuesday. A context declared as objects, relations and rules is a fact the enterprise can be asked
about, diffed, and held to, and the same question asked twice answers the same way.

It also has to distinguish what somebody vouched for from what merely got recorded. A layer that
cannot tell a rule a person signed off on from a note an agent wrote yesterday has made its own
trustworthiness a second thing nobody can check — so that distinction is a lifecycle here, and
only the vouched-for half ever reaches an agent.

```
DSH provides                    DeepWork adds
──────────────                  ──────────────
agent loop                      ontology    entities, relations, declared queries
tools                           governance  written_by, file_location, required_fields
skills                          injection   the vouched-for rules, marked for the situation in hand
                                audit

plugins.description: 本地一个窗口，驱动你所有机器上的 dsh · Drive the dsh instances on your other machines from one local window
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-control

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

**Every machine already runs dsh. Make this one window the front end for all of them.**

Chat with the dsh instances on your other machines, natively from your local sidebar.
Remote sessions stream back token by token; the remote uses its own model credentials,
tools and sandbox. Zero changes on the remote. Zero dependencies. One-line install.

![dsh-control in action](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/6mt/dsh-control/main/docs/hero.png)

*Two dsh windows answering the same question. The left window shows a session auto-named
`控制端·<local title>` (①) — that naming only happens on the machine the plugin drives. The right
window shows the workspace `cn-dsh2` the plugin created (②) and the model route set to the
environment name (③).*

> 🎬 A 15-second capture (one-click connect → streaming reply) is being recorded.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your profile> add github:6mt/dsh-control
```

Use the profile you already run (usually `web` or `desktop`). No build step, no native
modules, no dependencies — the plugin is plain JavaScript and installs as-is.

<details>
<summary>GitHub slow or blocked? Install from the release tarball instead</summary>

Download [dsh-control-0.1.1.tgz](https://github.com/6mt/dsh-control/releases/download/v0.1.1/dsh-control-0.1.1.tgz)
and run:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your profile> add ./dsh-control-0.1.1.tgz
```
</details>

After installing, **fully quit and reopen dsh** (⌘Q). A「远程 dsh 环境」panel appears
in the right sidebar.

> An npm package (`dsh-control`) is prepared and can be published later; the GitHub
> command above is the current install path.

## Versions & updating

- **What you get**: `github:6mt/dsh-control` installs the newest commit of `main` and
  **pins it in your profile's lockfile** — it does not silently follow later commits.
- **Update**: `dsh plugin --profile <your profile> update dsh-control`
  *(pnpm re-resolves the git ref and pulls the new code)*
- **Pin a version**: `github:6mt/dsh-control#v0.1.0` (tag) or `github:6mt/dsh-control#<commit>`
- Changes are recorded in [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).

## How is this different from dsh-remote / dsh-remote-ssh?

![How the two approaches differ](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/6mt/dsh-control/main/docs/compare.svg)

| | Remote-workspace plugins (dsh-remote, …) | **dsh-control** |
|---|---|---|
| The remote machine is a | **file system** (SFTP tool set) | **dsh that is already running there** |
| Sessions live | local session + remote directory | **remote sessions, native in your sidebar** |
| Credentials & tools | configured locally, SSH config duplicated | the remote's own — nothing copied |
| Remote needs | only SSH | dsh installed (≥0.2.0-rc.2) with its web instance running |
| Changes on the remote | some deploy dsh for you | **zero** (read-only probing + the remote's own API) |

The two **coexist** (tested side by side): no dsh on the remote → use dsh-remote;
dsh already there → use dsh-control.

## What it does

![The remote dsh environments panel](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/6mt/dsh-control/main/docs/panel.png)

*The「远程 dsh 环境」panel: type `user@host` and connect — the row then reports its state and
whether the environment already has its workspace.*

- **One-click connect** — type `user@host`; the plugin probes the remote dsh, fetches
  its access token and opens an encrypted channel (~5 s)
- **Automatic workspace** — each environment gets a same-named local workspace; any
  session created inside it automatically becomes a remote session
- **True streaming** — remote replies flow in token by token, not dumped at the end
- **Paired naming** — remote sessions are named `控制端·<local title>`, so both sides match
- **Visible & self-healing** — remote sessions are marked in the sidebar; disconnects
  are reported honestly and repaired by one click

## Security

**What it does on your machine**: one state file
(`$DSH_HOME/dsh-control/state.json`, mode 0600, holds the remote access tokens) and an
on-demand SSH tunnel process.
**What it never does**: no installs or writes on the remote, no lifecycle management of
the remote dsh, never reads your other local credentials, tokens never enter logs.
When passwordless SSH is not set up it shows the exact one-line fix — passwords are
never stored. Details in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## Known limitations

- The remote must already run dsh with its web instance (otherwise use a
  remote-workspace plugin)
- Connects over SSH (passwordless or configured key; a direct no-SSH mode is on the roadmap)
- Sidebar markers and the streaming feel are verified by eye per release
- Cancelling a remote turn is implemented but marked experimental

## Development

```sh
node --check lib/*.js
for t in test/*.test.mjs; do node "$t"; done   # 52 checks: unit / contract / structural invariants
scripts/verify-boot-selfheal.sh                # boot self-heal (needs a local dsh runtime)
```

## License

MIT © 6mt

plugins.description: General Agentics distribution bundle for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): one install brings white-label brand, curated plugins, bundled skills, and MCP pre-configuration. Built on DeepSeek Harness (DSH), MIT licensed.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-general-agentics **General Agentics 發行套件（bundle）for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)。** 用戶先安裝 DSH，再安裝本套件，一次獲得： 1. **貼牌**：側邊欄 mark/wordmark、對話首頁 hero 文字 logo 與致敬行、品牌主色、分頁標題、favicon、輸入框下方的 START HERE 模塊（皆為執行期替換，不修改、不破壞已安裝的 DSH） 2. **自帶技能**：14 個（`ga-identity` ＋ 13 個方法論技能，見下） 3. **MCP 預配置**：`ga-status`（`ga_bundle_info` 身分回報 ＋ `ga_health_check` 安裝健康自檢） 4. **設定面板**：Settings → General Agentics（bundle 版本、每個精選插件的版本與更新狀態、隨附技能、一鍵／手動更新） 5. **13 個精選第三方插件**：隨套件安裝並啟用（見「精選插件」一節） Built on DeepSeek Harness (DSH), MIT licensed. ## 設計原則 - **只走官方縫隙**：品牌透過三個 generic brand slot 佔位（`priority: -1` 陰影覆蓋官方 occupants——slot 規則是「同 cell 最低 priority 者渲染」），不停用 `ui-brand-official`，不修改任何 DSH 檔案。 - **不破簽章、不怕升級**：本套件存在於 profile（`~/.dsh/profiles//node_modules`），DSH 升級不會覆蓋它；解除安裝即完全還原官方品牌。 - **手寫、零建置**：`lib/client.js` 採用 shell module loader 的 lazy-CJS 形狀（與 dsh-pomodoro 等第三方出貨格式一致），無需 repo 內未發佈的 build preset。 ## 覆蓋範圍（誠實清單） | 表面 | 本套件 | 備註 | |---|---|---| | 側邊欄 mark / wordmark | ✅ | slot 佔位；2026-10-13 瀏覽器實測（乾淨 profile）確認渲染 | | 對話首頁 hero mark | ✅ | slot 佔位；實測確認我們的 wordmark 渲染 | | 品牌主色 | ✅ | `theme.overrideTokens`（light/dark 成對，契約要求）。注意 token 寫在 `` 的 inline style 上，不是 `:root`；量測時別探 `document.documentElement` | | 分頁標題 | ✅ | 執行期改寫 + MutationObserver 抵抗 shell 重設；實測 `document.title === "General Agentics"` | | favicon | ✅ | 執行期替換 `link[rel=icon]`；實測兩個 link 皆為 data URI 且含品牌色 | | PWA 名稱 | ⚠️ 盡力 | manifest link 換 data URI，瀏覽器是否採納視實作 | | 首跑 Preview Notice 彈窗 | ❌ 未覆蓋 | client 樹內字串，一次點名 DeepSeek Harness 三次，是客戶第一眼看到的畫面。2026-10-13 瀏覽器實測發現；client.js 修得到（尚未修） | | Hero tagline「Into the Unknown」 | ❌ 未覆蓋 | 與我們的 hero wordmark 並排顯示；同為 client 樹內字串，尚未修 | | 桌面殼（Dock icon／選單／About） | ❌ | 在簽章保護的 app.asar 內，本套件不碰 | | host 端字串（system prompt、User-Agent） | ❌ | 硬編碼；以 `ga-identity` skill 於任務層補償 | ## 安裝 ```sh # 方式一：GUI（App 運行中）——側欄 Plugins → Add plugin → 貼包名或本機路徑 dsh-general-agentics # npm 包名（發佈後） /path/to/dsh-general-agentics # 本機 clone 的絕對路徑 # 方式二：模型側工具（App 運行中）——對話中請 agent 執行 # plugin_manager { action: "install_bundle", target: "dsh-general-agentics" } # 方式三：CLI（desktop profile 須先完全退出桌面 App） dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-general-agentics ``` 安裝後： - **網頁重新整理一次**（Cmd+R）即可載入品牌 client half（側邊欄 mark/wordmark、hero 文字 logo 與致敬行、主色、分頁標題、favicon、輸入框下方的 START HERE 模塊） - **新建的 session** 會獲得 `ga-identity` 等 14 個技能與 `mcp__ga-status__ga_bundle_info` 工具（MCP 伺服器於組合套用時即由 host spawn） - 完全重啟 App 亦無妨 **解除安裝／停用**： ```sh # 停用（保留檔案）：GUI Plugins 頁關閉 bundle，或在 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 寫： # - id: general-agentics # disabled: true # 解除安裝：GUI Plugins → Remove，或退出 App 後 CLI： dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-general-agentics ``` **開發迭代**：以 `link:` 指向本機 clone 安裝——改 `lib/client.js` 後重新整理頁面即生效； 改 `cordis.patch.yml` 或 `lib/index.js`（host 半）則套用新組合（HMR live）。 內容變更後重新以 `file:` 安裝時記得升版號——pnpm 對同版號的 `file:` 包可能不重新解包。 離線驗證組合用拋棄式 profile：見 `docs/ops-lessons.md` rule 13。 **發布前注意**： - LICENSE 已在 repo 根目錄（npm 自動收入 tarball） - MCP row 已是可攜形式（`process.execPath` + `baseUrl`，見 `cordis.patch.yml`；實測紀錄在 `docs/ops-lessons.md` rule 14） - 對外表述維持 "Built on DeepSeek Harness (DSH), MIT licensed" ## 套件結構 ``` dsh-general-agentics/ ├── package.json # dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client 宣告＋精選插件 dependencies ├── cordis.patch.yml # 本套件 Loader row＋MCP row＋精選插件 insert rows ├── lib/ │ ├── index.js # host half：技能 provider（掃 skills/ 註冊） │ └── client.js # browser half：品牌 slot、主題、標題/favicon、START HERE ├── brand/ │ ├── mark.svg # 佔位 mark 設計檔（client.js 內有對應 inline 版本） │ └── wordmark.svg # 佔位 wordmark 設計檔 ├── skills/ │ ├── ga-identity/ # 自帶技能：General Agentics 身分與簽署 │ ├── (13 個方法論技能) # vendored from obra/superpowers @ bb92a77（MIT，逐字未改） │ ├── superpowers/ # 上游 LICENSE + UPSTREAM-SHA（無 SKILL.md，不註冊） │ └── THIRD-PARTY.md # 署名與更新指引 ├── mcp/ │ └── ga-status-server.mjs # ga_bundle_info 狀態回報（零依賴 stdio MCP server） └── test/ └── skill-provider.test.mjs # node --test，零依賴 ``` ## 換正式品牌素材 | 要換什麼 | 改哪裡 | |---|---| | 產品名稱 | `lib/client.js` 的 `PRODUCT_NAME` / `PRODUCT_SHORT_NAME` | | mark 圖形 | `lib/client.js` 的 `GAMark`（paths）＋ `brand/mark.svg` | | wordmark | `lib/client.js` 的 `GAName` | | 品牌色 | `lib/client.js` 的 `BRAND_COLOR` / `FAVICON_COLOR`（light/dark 成對） | | favicon | `lib/client.js` 的 `faviconHref()` | ## 隨附技能（bundled skills） 14 個技能隨包註冊（`ctx.skills.registerProvider`，bundled rank 600——用戶自帶同名技能一律優先）： - `ga-identity`：以 General Agentics 身分自介與簽署產出 - 13 個方法論技能 vendored 自 [obra/superpowers](https://github.com/obra/superpowers)（MIT，逐字未改）： `brainstorming`、`writing-plans`、`executing-plans`、`test-driven-development`、`systematic-debugging`、`verification-before-completion`、`writing-skills`、`diagnosing-superpowers`、`subagent-driven-development`、`dispatching-parallel-agents`、`requesting-code-review`、`receiving-code-review`、`finishing-a-development-branch` ——15 個上游技能取 13；`using-superpowers`（其「任何回應前必查技能」規則與 `ga-identity` 的身分主導權衝突）與 `using-git-worktrees`（團隊 git 工作流）刻意不入，理由見 `skills/THIRD-PARTY.md`。 **感謝**：Jesse Vincent (obra) 與 superpowers 貢獻者；詳見 `skills/THIRD-PARTY.md`。 ## 精選插件（curated plugins） 隨套件安裝並自動啟用（`dependencies` ＋ `cordis.patch.yml` 的 insert row；row id 一律 `ga-` 前綴，避免與用戶直裝的同名插件撞 id）。 | 插件 | 功能 | 需要什麼才會「看得見」 | |---|---|---| | `dshmarket` | 插件市集 | 設定 → Plugin Market | | `dsh-better-sidebar` | 側欄：檔案樹／編輯器／變更／任務／側聊 | 基本即有；`agentOpenTools` 與 sentinel tab 已預設開啟（只新增，不動其他 tab） | | `dsh-comments` | **自家工具**：劃選回覆片段、逐段點評，可一鍵把全部點評組裝成訊息送回 | 立即可用 | | `dsh-promptimizer` | **自家工具**：一鍵用當前選定模型改寫草稿 prompt（Light/Standard/Deep） | 需要可用的模型 | | `dsh-sentinel` | 排程監看面板（BSD-3-Clause，隨包附授權） | 立即可用；better-sidebar 的 sentinel tab 已預設開啟 | | `dsh-cost-meter` | 會話費用統計 | 每條回覆的用量行（本套件已預設 `performanceUsage: detailed`） | | `@changfenhuang/dsh-genui` | 回覆內嵌互動 UI 卡片 | 本套件已預設區塊位置與提示 | | `dsh-context` | 上下文洞察／管理 | 本套件已預設開啟 fleet 分頁 | | `@liustack/modsearch` | 免費網頁＋X 搜尋聚合 | 本套件已接管 `web` 的 `searchProvider`（用戶 profile patch 可改回） | | `@ricardochen1996/dsh-browser-use` | 瀏覽器自動化 | **需 `uv`**（首次自動建 Python venv ~25MB） | | `@xmanrui/dsh-im` | 微信／飛書／企微／釘釘／TG／Slack… 橋接 | **需 IM 應用憑證**，否則只有背景日誌 | | `@liustack/modlens` | 給純文字 LLM 的視覺能力 | **需 Antigravity CLI**（未隨包） | | `dsh-mobile` | 手機／局域網安全訪問、目錄選擇器 | 佔用一個 TCP 埠（預設 3443）；同機第二個 gateway 會撞埠 | ## DSH 版本相容性（0.2.1 的安裝閘門） DSH 0.2.1 起，安裝時會先讀插件的 manifest 檢查相容性（`dsh-app-boot` 的 plugin-compatibility）：**有 `engines.dsh` 就只看它，否則檢查它對 `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` 的 peer 範圍**，用 `semver.satisfies(..., {includePrerelease:true})` 判斷。**只要有一個插件不合格，整個安裝會被拒絕並回滾**。 因此本套件： - 宣告 `engines.dsh: ">=0.2.1-rc.2"`（只用 `>=`，才不會把 rc 版擋掉） - 精選清單以 **0.2.1 可接受的版本**為 floor；發佈前用 `npm run check-dsh-compat` 核對 - **兩個插件目前不納入**（在 0.2.1 上無法安裝，非我們能修）： | 插件 | 原因 | |---|---| | `@michengai/dsh-agency-agents` | 所有已發佈版本的 peer 只列出 0.1.x 的 dsh，沒有任何版本被 0.2.1 接受 | | `dsh-web-search-pro` | 0.2.x 全部封頂 `<0.2.1-0`；唯一能過的是 0.1.2（降級，故不納入） | 需要它們時可手動安裝並自負風險： ```sh dsh plugin --profile

allow-version @ --dsh-version 0.2.1-rc.2 --accept-risk ``` 上游發佈相容版本後，把 row 加回 `cordis.patch.yml` 即可（`test/bundle-manifest.test.mjs` 會檢查依賴與 row 是否一致）。 ## 設定面板（Settings → General Agentics） 設定側欄多一個 **General Agentics** 分頁，回答「這個 bundle 到底裝了什麼、要不要更新」，並在介面上分成五個區塊： 1. **狀態總覽**：版本、狀態 chip（已是最新／N 項待處理／可更新）、檢查時間，以及「重新檢查」 2. **需要注意**：缺少外部依賴（`uv` 等，附一鍵複製修法）、未提供（可複製安裝指令）、直裝重複 3. **更新**：一鍵更新（二次確認）＋進度計時＋`aria-live`，失敗顯示 `code` 與原因，並有可複製的手動指令 4. **精選插件**：依用途分組（搜尋／介面／行動／自家／通訊），可篩選（全部／有新版／需注意／未提供）與搜尋；每列可展開看宣告範圍、已裝與 registry 版本、落後原因、複製安裝指令與 npm 連結 5. **隨附技能**與**前置條件**（無法隨 npm 套件提供的項目，標示已就緒／需自行確認） 首次開啟會有一張可關閉的「這個 bundle 給了你什麼」引導卡。面板語言**跟隨瀏覽器**（zh/en，可用 `localStorage['general-agentics/lang']` 覆寫），所有字串來自兩份鍵集相同的字典。 - **bundle 版本**：目前版本 vs registry 最新版（本地開發版領先 registry 時會標「本地版本領先 registry」而不是誤報有更新） - **13 個精選插件**：每個的宣告範圍、**實際已安裝版本**、registry 最新版，以及 `有新版` / `最新` / `未提供` / `直裝重複` 標記（後者代表這個 profile 又直裝了一份，會啟用兩次） - **14 個隨附技能**：名稱清單 - **更新**：一鍵更新走 profile 的 plugin manager（`installBundle`）；沒有 manager 的 profile 會顯示可複製的手動指令（**desktop profile 的 CLI 被 Electron 獨佔，請用面板按鈕**）。`link:`／`file:` 安裝會額外提示「更新會改用 registry 版本」 - **精選插件怎麼更新**：插件是上游 npm 套件的依賴，**bundle 升版本身不會移動插件版本**（pnpm 以 lock 為準）；只有當該次發佈**提高了 floor**（例如 `^0.68.1` → `^0.72.0`）時，一鍵更新才會把插件一起帶上去。發佈前用 `npm run check-upstream` 看差距，提 floor 後必須在乾淨 profile 驗證過再發（0.x 的 minor 依 semver 可能不相容） 資料來自 host 半註冊的唯讀端

plugins.description: Output house rules for every DeepSeek Harness agent: no check-mark or cross glyphs in replies or written files, and a light kaomoji habit in conversation. One global prompt section, so every preset, workspace and subagent obeys without a single preset edit.
plugins.readme_text:
# Oishikunaare-Moe-Moe-Kyun

> Chinese documentation: [README.zh-CN.md](README.zh-CN.md)

Output house rules for an AI agent: one core, and four ways to reach it. The rules are about how an
agent writes - judgement glyphs, emoji, the kaomoji habit, the language it thinks in - and none of that
is specific to one harness, so the package is not either.

| entry | what it is | how it is wired |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **CLI** `mmk` | `rules`, `lib`, `check`, `notice`, `voice`, `review`, `wire` | a shell, a git hook, CI, or a person asking whether a line would be refused. Exit 3 means a breach |
| **MCP server** | `mmk_rules`, `mmk_check`, `mmk_notice` and the `mmk://rules` resource | any MCP client, no assumption about which agent is on the other side |
| **Claude Code hook** | corrects a breach while the turn is still open | `Stop` answers `{"decision":"block","reason":<notice>}`, `UserPromptSubmit` and `SessionStart` attach context |
| **DSH plugin** | one global system prompt section for a whole profile | mounted once by the roster, so it reaches every preset, workspace, conversation and subagent |
| **modules** | `oishikunaare-moe-moe-kyun/portable`, `/transcripts` | writing another adapter: all of the above are thin layers over those two files |

`mmk wire <target>` prints the wiring for a specific place - the hook block, the MCP client block, the
`AGENTS.md` / `CLAUDE.md` / `GEMINI.md` rules block, the DSH plugin row - with real paths filled in.

### What is verified where

An entry that has never met the thing it is written for is not the same as one that has, and the
difference is worth stating instead of implying. This table is the honest version.

| entry | how it is verified |
| --- | --- |
| DSH plugin | In production on the machine this was written on: mounted in a live profile, and its rules and self-check are visible in real sessions |
| CLI `mmk` | Used on that machine for real work - auditing a session, answering whether a line would be refused - and exercised by `test/portable.mjs` |
| MCP server | The protocol is checked locally: a handshake, `tools/list`, every tool called, `resources/read`. The client half depends on the client |
| Claude Code hook | **Documented contract plus recorded fixtures only** (`npm run test:adapters`); never run against a live Claude Code, because none is installed here. The contract has moved between releases, so treat this one as a candidate rather than a supported entry |
| rules files (`mmk wire ...-md`) | The block is generated from the same resolved rules the plugin serves, so the text is verified; whether a given program reads that file is its own documentation |

When a harness that is not on this machine does become available, the way to close the gap is one
recorded payload: save the stdin JSON a hook actually receives as `adapters/fixtures/<harness>/<case>.json`
and `npm run test:adapters` replays it. That is what the fixture directory is for, and it is why adding
an adapter is cheap once someone can run the client - and why writing five of them from memory would not
be.

The DSH plugin row is worth explaining, because it is the anti-drift argument: a profile-level plugin is
mounted once by the roster, so the section it registers reaches every agent that joins that standing
scope - every preset, every workspace, every new conversation, and subagents too. That is why it is done
there rather than in fifteen preset files: a preset is a copy, and a copy is a thing that drifts. The
other entries exist because the same rules are worth having where no such roster exists.

Four rules ship today.

1. **Symbol discipline** - no check-mark or cross judgement glyphs, in a reply or in a file the agent
   writes. Those glyphs pollute context and regression parameters, and a file written today is read
   back into context tomorrow, so the ban covers files and not just replies. Say it in words instead:
   pass / fail, works / broken, applied / not applied, yes / no.
   Write for a reader who reads every sentence: normal punctuation is welcome, and the judgement belongs
   in words. Marks must not carry the structure either - a paragraph that reads as prose beats a column
   of markers, an item in a list should be a short sentence rather than a label, and a kaomoji is tone
   rather than layout.
2. **No emoji** - zero, in replies, in the agent's own thinking and in every file it writes. The ban is
   by colour rather than by block: the picture blocks are banned whole (pictographs, faces, transport,
   the supplemental pictographs), while in the two mixed blocks - Miscellaneous Symbols and the arrows
   block - only the code points that default to colour presentation count, so a pointing hand or a plain
   arrow drawn in lines is fine and a coloured umbrella or circle is not. The variation selector U+FE0F,
   the zero width joiner and the skin tone modifiers are named too, and a mark followed by U+FE0E is the
   writer asking for lines, which is honoured. Decoration is carved out - a heart, a note, a star, a
   sparkle, a flower - so the ban admits exactly the code points the loaded palette uses.
3. **Kaomoji habit** - Japanese-style emoticons in conversation and in the agent's own thinking, at a
   floor rather than as garnish: at least one per three sentences, and any reply of two sentences or
   more carries one. Aim above the floor. Faces rotate rather than repeat, and places that take none
   take none - a stack trace, a table of numbers, a serious conclusion. The self-check counts the
   **reply text** only, and the notice says so in one clause: the rule asks for the habit in thinking
   as well, but a glyph in thinking pollutes the transcript while a missing face there does not, so the
   floor is counted where it is visible.
4. **Thinking language** - think and answer in the user's own language instead of defaulting to
   English, which is not a neutral metalanguage: a Chinese conversation reasoned about in English is
   exactly the habit the rule exists to replace. Chinese gets Chinese with Japanese particles and
   terminology mixed in where they fall naturally; Japanese gets Japanese. English is available in one
   case only, the moe-fandom register - romanized Japanese words (kawaii, sugoi, moe, senpai, yabai,
   baka), fandom English (nya~, ehehe, ufufu, desu wa, the honorifics -chan / -san / -sama), waves and
   long vowels, alongside the kaomoji palette. Dry technical English is not that register. The reason
   is in the rule: the grammar and the logic of English do not match the habits of moe-fandom culture.
   It covers thinking and replies, and it never buys a fandom register with correctness - technical
   content stays accurate. File contents, code, commands and commit messages still carry no tone.
   This rule has its own self-check, the last of the four to get one: it reads the newest thinking block
   against what the human in the session has been writing, and when the thinking comes back in Latin
   while the reader writes Chinese or Japanese it says so once per drift, within a per-session budget
   (`languageCheck` / `languageCheckMax`). The numbers that argued for building it: CJK was 21.6% of the
   reasoning channel in one window and 2.4% in a later one, with nothing in the loop naming the drift.

Rule 4 differs from 1-3 in one mechanical way: it is not a per-rule override. `bannedSymbols`,
`kaomoji` and the `rules` object replace the rules they name, while the thinking-language block is
appended after them (and before `append`), because "mount this plugin and the agent thinks in the
user's language" is the promise of mounting it. `enabled: false` is what takes it away.

## Where this package takes its material from

This is a standard for **MMK itself** - the source of the markers, the palette and the prose it
ships - not a rule the plugin hands to an agent. Nothing here is injected into a prompt.

- **Taken**: moe-fandom culture of 1990-2015 - 90s bishoujo games and OVAs, 2000s galge and light
  novels, VOCALOID and doujin music, 2000s-2010s anime, and the mid-2010s "yami-kawaii" look. The
  traditional moe attributes stay available: tsundere, natural airhead, frail, denpa,

plugins.description: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) sidebar session deletion plugin for 0.2.0-rc.2 - replaces the version-incompatible dsh-session-delete
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-delete-next

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）侧栏**会话删除**插件 —— 为当前运行时（`0.2.0-rc.2`）重写的版本，
替代插件市场里因 peer 版本范围（`^0.1.0-rc.5`）不兼容而装不上的 `dsh-session-delete`。

仓库：<https://github.com/ljp888/dsh-session-delete-next>

[English](#english) | 中文

---

## 中文

### 功能

| 入口 | 菜单项 | 行为 |
|---|---|---|
| 会话行 `…` 菜单 | **删除会话** | 永久删除该会话的全部本地记录，不可恢复 |

要点：

- 危险操作，红色菜单项 + 独立确认对话框（明示「不可恢复」并显示会话标题）。
- **运行中的会话一律拒绝删除**（含当前会话）——宿主端返回 `409 live`，对话框给出提示。
- 删除后立即从侧栏消失，**无需刷新**（复用官方已转发的 `api-session/removed` 事件）。
- 菜单文案跟随 GUI 语言（中文 / 英文），走官方 locale 服务。

### 技术实现

与旧版插件的关键差异：**不再用 DOM 注入**。`0.2.0-rc.2` 已开放官方扩展点，本插件走
标准 slot 机制，不会随侧栏结构变化而静默失效。

**Host 半**（`index.js`，纯 ESM）

- 只 `inject: ['webServer']`，其余服务（`sessionPersistence` / `workspaceRegistry` /
  `sessions` / `storageDomain`）按请求用 `ctx.get()` 惰性获取，缺失时降级而不是拒绝加载。
- 注册同源路由 `POST /dsh-session-delete-next/delete`，请求体 `{ sessionId }`。
- 删除顺序（**先删文件，后记账**，失败绝不留下「已隐藏但未删除」的半删状态）：
  1. 拒绝 live / 已创建未落盘的会话；
  2. `ctx.sessionPersistence.stat(id)` 定位日志，`locate(header).path` 取路径，
     删除其所在目录（含 `session.lock`）；
  3. 安全校验：文件名必须匹配后端自己的 `session.v<N>.jsonl[.zst|.zstd|.gz]`，
     且目录必须位于持久化后端的 `root` 之内，否则拒绝；
  4. 清理 `session_projcache` 投影缓存；
  5. 从 workspace 账目 `detachSession`，并清除归档标记；
  6. `ctx.emit('api-session/removed', id)` 通知浏览器。
- 同源校验：跨站 `Origin` 直接 `403`。

**Client 半**（`client.js`，手写浏览器 bundle，无需构建）

- `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id: '<包名>', factory })` 懒注册。
- 注册到官方 slot：
  - `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item`（会话 `…` 菜单，`order: 500`，排在
    pin/rename/fork/archive 之后）；
  - `shell.overlay`（确认对话框，独立于菜单生命周期）。
- 复用宿主注入的 `useMenuOpenState()` 关闭菜单；`t()` 来自 `ctx.locale.register`。
- 若宿主缺少所需 UI primitives，只告警并跳过注册，不会让 slot 渲染崩溃。

### 安装

最省事的方式是直接 clone 成 profile 的插件目录（`<profile>` 默认为 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`）：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/ljp888/dsh-session-delete-next.git \
  ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-session-delete-next
```

Windows PowerShell 对应写法：

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/ljp888/dsh-session-delete-next.git `
  "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-session-delete-next"
```

然后手动复制文件也可以，步骤：

1. 把整个包目录复制到 `<profile>/node_modules/dsh-session-delete-next/`
   （`<profile>` 默认为 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`）。
2. 在 `<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` **追加**一行挂载（此文件被 HMR 监听，保存后即热加载）：

   ```yaml
   - insert:
       - id: dsh-session-delete-next
         name: dsh-session-delete-next
   ```

3. 浏览器刷新一次即可看到菜单项。

> 不写入 profile 的 `package.json`：本包不在 npm 上，写成 `dependencies` 会让后续
> `pnpm install` / `dsh plugin` 操作去 registry 拉取而失败。代价是将来在 profile 里跑
> `pnpm install` 可能把这个目录剪掉，重装即可。

### 已知限制

- **不能删除 live 会话。** 官方没有公开的「驱逐运行中会话」API，所以正在运行或已打开的
  会话会被拒绝。先关掉它（或重启 DSH）再删。
- **子智能体会话**也可删除；删除后父会话的子智能体目录会少一项，界面会随
  `api-session/removed` 自行收敛。
- **附件不删。** `~/.dsh/attachments/**` 是内容寻址、跨会话共享的，删除会话不会动它。
- Windows 上若另一个进程仍持有 `session.lock`，`rm` 可能报 `EBUSY`；此时对话框会显示
  原始错误且**磁盘状态不变**，重试即可。
- 全量删除（按工作区批量）未实现——只做单个会话删除，减少不可验证的失败路径。

### 实测验证状态（本机）

| 项目 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 宿主端加载 + 路由注册 | ✅ `~/.dsh/logs/desktop-next.log`：`[dsh-session-delete-next] host ready: POST /dsh-session-delete-next/delete` |
| profile 热加载（无需重启） | ✅ 追加 patch 行后 Loader 自动刷新，日志即出现上述行 |
| 侧栏 `…` 菜单出现「删除会话」 | ✅ 红色危险样式 + 分隔线，排在官方「归档会话」之后 |
| 中文 locale 解析 | ✅ 显示「删除会话」，不是原始 key |
| 确认对话框 | ✅ 标题、含会话名插值的正文、红色「永久删除」、取消 |
| 执行真正删除（成功路径） | ⚠️ **未执行** —— 原因见下 |

**为什么没做破坏性实测**：验证时侧栏只有一条会话，正是承载那次对话的活跃会话。
官方在 `0.2.0-rc.2` 没有公开「驱逐运行中会话」的 API，所以插件会拒绝删除它；
跑通「删除成功」路径需要一个**非活跃**会话当靶子，我不拿真实对话历史去赌。
想自行确认：新开一个会话 → 随便发一条消息 → 切回原会话 → 对那个测试会话执行删除。
删除成功的判据是 `~/.dsh/sessions/<项目目录>/<会话 id>/` 整个目录消失，且侧栏该行立即消失。

> 注：`index.js` 的 fail-closed 安全加固（`sessions` 服务不可用时拒绝删除）不在 HMR
> 模块监听根内，需**重启 DSH** 才在运行实例中生效；之前的运行实例行为一致。

## English

Adds the missing **Delete session** action to the sidebar session row menu of DSH
`0.2.0-rc.2`, replacing the marketplace `dsh-session-delete` whose peer range
(`^0.1.0-rc.5`) no longer resolves.

- Permanently removes the session's local records; red danger styling plus a
  confirmation dialog that states the action is irreversible.
- Running/open sessions are refused (`409 live`) — they are never deleted.
- The row disappears immediately, with no refresh, by re-emitting the official
  `api-session/removed` forwarded event.
- Localized through the client locale service (zh/en).

Unlike the original plugin this uses the **official slots** rather than DOM
injection: `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item` for the menu row and
`shell.overlay` for the dialog. Files are removed before any bookkeeping, so a
failure never leaves a session that is hidden but still on disk.

Install: clone this repository straight into the profile's plugin directory —
`git clone https://github.com/ljp888/dsh-session-delete-next.git ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-session-delete-next`
— then append the `- insert:` row to `<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` and refresh the
page. The profile `package.json` is deliberately left untouched because this
package is not published to npm.

## License

MIT

# dsh-sidebar-toggle

简体中文 · English

为 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）Web GUI 提供侧边栏分组模式的快捷切换：无需展开视图选项菜单，通过 **`Alt+R` 快捷键**或**直接点击侧边栏分组标题**（`会话` / `工作区` / `Sessions` / `Workspaces`），即可在**按工作区分组**（`workspace`）与**平铺会话列表**（`flat`）之间一键来回切换。 ## 功能与交互 1. **全局快捷键 `Alt+R`**： - 在页面任意位置按下 `Alt+R` 即可切换侧边栏分组模式（`workspace` ↔ `flat`）。 - 自动避让输入法组合输入状态（`e.isComposing || e.keyCode === 229`），不影响中文等 IME 选词。 2. **点击侧边栏分组标题**： - 为侧边栏顶部标题文本（`[class*="sectionHeader"] [class*="sectionLabel"]`，即中文界面的「会话」/「工作区」或英文界面的 `Sessions` / `Workspaces`）注入手型指针（`cursor: pointer`）与悬停透明度反馈（`hover: opacity: 0.8`）。 - 单击标题文本即刻切换分组视图（若标题处于隐藏态 `sectionLabelHidden` 则忽略点击）。 每次切换时，插件调用宿主 `sidebar.workspaces` 槽位的原生 `setGroupBy` action，并在浏览器控制台输出一行状态日志： ```text [dsh-sidebar-toggle] groupBy: workspace -> flat [dsh-sidebar-toggle] groupBy: flat -> workspace ``` ## 安装 从 npm 安装（预构建，免额外配置）： ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-sidebar-toggle ``` 安装后无需手动修改配置文件，插件自带的 `cordis.patch.yml` 会自动挂载生效；刷新 Web 页面即可使用。 从 GitHub 直装（源码安装，包内含 `prepare` 构建脚本，pnpm ≥ 10 首次安装需放行构建）： ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add github:john-walks-slow/dsh-sidebar-toggle # 若 pnpm 拦截构建脚本，按提示执行 pnpm approve-builds 或将 dsh-sidebar-toggle # 加入 ~/.dsh/profiles/web/pnpm-workspace.yaml 的 allowBuilds / onlyBuiltDependencies 后重跑 ``` ## 权限与兼容 - **纯客户端插件**：Host 侧 `apply` 为空实现，**零 npm 运行时依赖**；全部交互逻辑在浏览器端（`lib/client.js`）运行。 - **零外部权限**：无外部服务、无网络请求、无本地文件系统读写、不读取任何会话内容。 - **复用宿主原生状态**：通过 Cordis `slots` 服务解析 `sidebar.workspaces` 槽位的 `WorkspaceViewStoreHandle`，直接调用宿主原生的 `getSnapshot().groupBy` 与 `actions.setGroupBy()`，与侧边栏自带的视图切换菜单完全同步。 - **卸载与热重载干净**：通过 `ctx.effect` 与 `window.__dshSidebarToggle.dispose()` 管理生命周期，插件停用或重载时自动移除键盘/点击事件监听与注入的 `

plugins.description: DSH-memory — DeepSeek Harness 长期记忆/技能/待办/记忆同步插件，基于 csyangwen/dsh-memory-evolve（MIT）的 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 兼容分支。Fork of csyangwen/dsh-memory-evolve, adapted for DSH 0.2.0-rc.2.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH-memory 使用场景指南

> **一句话**：让 DSH 里的 AI 拥有跨会话的长期记忆、帮你管理待办与技能、还能拉起一群 AI 会话和外部 AI 代理协同干活——**越用越懂你，换会话不丢上下文**。
>
> 本指南按真实工作流组织，每个场景讲「适合谁、能做什么、怎么用、会得到什么」。
>
> 相关文档：[详细功能说明](README-详细说明.md) · [记忆同步](docs/记忆同步.md) · [更新日志](docs/CHANGELOG.md) · [English](README.en.md)

---

## 来源与许可（Attribution）

**DSH-memory 是 [csyangwen/dsh-memory-evolve](https://github.com/csyangwen/dsh-memory-evolve) 的衍生分支（fork）**，遵循上游的 MIT 许可（原始版权声明保留在 [LICENSE](LICENSE)：`Copyright (c) 2026 dsh-external`）。

| | |
|---|---|
| **上游项目** | [csyangwen/dsh-memory-evolve](https://github.com/csyangwen/dsh-memory-evolve)（作者 [@csyangwen](https://github.com/csyangwen)） |
| **本分支** | [YYfather/DSH-memory](https://github.com/YYfather/DSH-memory)（npm：`@yyfather/dsh-memory`） |
| **本分支做了什么** | **只做 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 的兼容性修复，功能一个没删**。逐条说明见 [更新日志 2026-10-13](docs/CHANGELOG.md)。 |
| **上游致谢** | 分层记忆模型、五轨设计、git 记忆同步与合并算法、自我进化/技能体系、COI 调度等全部原创设计均来自上游；本分支仅修复宿主升级带来的破坏性变更。 |

主要修复（细节与证据见更新日志）：客户端 `<style>` 归属导致整页掉样式（issue #89）、书签轮尾星标不注入（issue #86）、`skill_manage patch` 守卫恒 false（issue #90）、会话 `.events` 移除导致四处功能静默失效、桌面版同源守卫拒绝宿主转发 + 远端检测超时（PR #91）、技能面板只剩 1 个技能（PR #65）、Windows 下构建产物不可复现。

> 本分支与上游**数据完全兼容**：记忆目录仍是 `<DSH_HOME>/memories`，配置键、工具名、HTTP 路由前缀、localStorage 键一律未改——从上游切过来（或切回去）不会丢记忆、不需要重新配置。

---

## 快速开始（安装）

插件包内自带 `cordis.patch.yml`（`dsh.bundle.patch` 声明），`dsh plugin add` 安装后 **host 端自动注册，无需任何手动配置**。以 web profile 为例，两步装好：

```sh
# 1. 安装到 profile（npm 包名；也可用本地目录 link: 或 git 地址）
dsh plugin --profile web add @yyfather/dsh-memory

# 2. 重启 dsh web 即生效
```

> ⚠️ **不要再往 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` 手动 insert 本插件**：bundle patch 已自动注册，重复 insert 同 id 会让加载器报 duplicate loader entry id 无法启动。完整说明见 [详细功能说明](README-详细说明.md)「标准安装」章节。

**修改默认配置**（如开启回合内记忆审查）：在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 用 id 覆盖（顶层写法，非 insert）：

```yaml
- id: dsh-memory
  config:
    reviewEnabled: true      # 开启回合内记忆审查（默认关）
    reviewInterval: 10       # 每 10 个用户回合审查一次
```

**插件异常导致 DSH 无法启动时，临时禁用**（等修复后取消）：同样在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 加一行即可，无需卸载：

```yaml
- id: dsh-memory
  disabled: true
```

**从旧版本升级**：若你此前按旧文档手动 insert 过本插件，请删除 profile patch 里的 insert 行（否则与 bundle 自动注册重复）。

卸载：`dsh plugin --profile web remove @yyfather/dsh-memory`，一切效果随插件卸载自动清理。

## 认识它（30 秒）

装上插件后，打开任意会话，你会多出一排能力标签：**记忆 · 技能 · 待办 · 无限画板 · COI 调度 · 会话广播 · 提示词 · 记忆同步 · 模型设置 · 书签 · 会话评审 · Web UI 设置 · Memory Evolve 设置**。AI 侧则多了一批工具：记忆读写、待办、技能管理、本地文件搜索、会话编排、会话广播、外部 AI 派单、提示词注入、模型查询……

一句话概括这些能力：**让 AI 记住你、替你管、替你做、互相配合做。**

> 小提示：插件里很多能力默认关闭（不占 AI 的工具清单），需要时在「Memory Evolve 设置」里打开即可。下面的场景大多是组合玩法——**把相关功能都打开，才能串成完整的流水线**。

## 场景一：让 AI 真正记住你（长期记忆）

**适合谁**：所有人。这是插件的核心，也是其他一切功能的地基。

AI 的对话是「一次性」的：换项目、隔几天、开新会话，它就忘了你是谁。插件的五轨记忆让 AI 拥有**跨会话的长期工作记忆**：

- **用户档案**：你的偏好、公司、沟通习惯——AI 每回合都能看到；
- **全局事实**：环境、工具、惯例等长期知识；
- **项目关键记忆**：当前项目的约定、决策、架构、踩坑，自动注入上下文，重要结论可标记**只在某个 git 分支生效**；
- **项目日志 / 每日日志**：每回合自动记录进展，按需读取，历史可追溯。

**怎么用**：

1. 正常和 AI 对话即可——每回合结束时它会自动把进展写进项目日志和今日日志；
2. 发现重要事实时对它说「**记一下：这个项目的部署端口是 8080**」，它会写入项目关键记忆，**你确认后**才生效——AI 不会擅自往记忆里写东西；
3. 过几天、换了个会话，直接问「**查一下记忆，上次我们定下的架构决策是什么**」——它能无缝衔接；
4. 记忆多了之后，让 AI「**把 XX 那条记忆归档**」——归档条目不再注入上下文，随时可转回；
5. **情绪反馈记录**：你对工作结果的评价（如「太好了」「怎么还没改对」）会被 AI 记入当日与项目日志（`【反馈】` 行，含情绪、任务分类、你的原话）——积累后随时可以让 AI「**分析一下最近我对哪些方面不满意**」，判断它在哪类任务上做得好/不好。

**会得到什么**：AI 从一个「每次会话都失忆」的对话机器，变成了解你全盘工作的长期伙伴——隔天继续开发，它直接引用昨天的结论，不用你复述。

---

## 场景：多台电脑共享项目记忆（记忆同步）

**适合谁**：办公室和家里两台电脑干活、或有同事协作同一个项目的人——不想在每台电脑上把重要结论重新讲一遍。

**怎么用**（详见 [记忆同步](docs/记忆同步.md)）：

1. 「Memory Evolve 设置 → 配置」打开「**记忆同步**」模块开关（这只是让功能可见）；
2. 在项目会话的「**记忆同步**」Tab 打开「**本项目同步**」——点「开始同步」即可（记忆远端默认用你的代码仓库，自动存进专属分支，不污染代码），再点「同步并推送」完成首次推送；**代码公开（如 GitHub 开源）但记忆想私藏**？填一个**共享记忆仓库**地址——一个仓库装所有项目的记忆（每项目一条专属分支），记忆与代码彻底隔离；
3. 另一台电脑 clone 项目后打开——**自动认亲**（同一仓库地址 = 同一项目），拉下来即可继续用；
4. 平时照常写记忆（实时落盘、零延迟），攒一批点一次「同步」；两台电脑都改了同一条记忆才会出现冲突，Tab 里选「采用本机 / 采用远端 / 两者都要」即可。

**会得到什么**：项目关键记忆、项目日志、归档、项目待办跨设备一致；填了共享记忆仓库后，**全局记忆（用户档案/每日日志/待办）也能跨设备**（四个独立轨开关，开哪个同步哪个）——换电脑不换记忆。**没开同步的项目完全不受影响**（保持纯本地状态）。

---

## 场景二：多项目并行开发，每件事都不丢（待办 + 项目日志 + 本地搜索）

**适合谁**：同时维护多个项目、经常被「之前那个方案是怎么定的」卡住的开发者。

- **四轨待办**：生活 / 工作 / 项目 / 每日。「项目」轨按工作目录隔离，换目录互不干扰。说「**记住，周五前把二级面板部署到手机访问实例**」，自动落成项目待办（带重要/紧急、截止日期）；每天收尾 AI 会提醒你到期的待办；
- **项目日志**：每个项目的进展按目录隔离沉淀，日志自动带 `[git main]` 分支标记，可溯源；
- **本地文件搜索**：对 AI 说「**搜一下本机有没有写过类似的东西**」——按文件名找文档（可扩展到全类型）；也能内容检索：「**哪个文档里提过 XX**」直接返回命中文件和片段。

**怎么用**：

1. 新项目开工直接开聊，项目日志自动建档；
2. 冒出的想法对 AI 说「记住」，它会进待确认队列——到「待办」里**采纳或拒绝**，你说了算；
3. 想不起来就问「之前有个文档提到过 XX」。

**会得到什么**：同时开 3 个项目也不乱——每个项目的记忆、待办、文档线索各归各的目录，问一句就能捡起来。

---

## 场景三：一个人指挥一群 AI 干活（内部团队）

**适合谁**：想把 AI 用成「团队」的人——一个主会话指挥美工、前端、后端、测试多个子会话。

**怎么用**：

1. **拉起团队**：对主会话的 AI 说「**创建 4 个会话：美工负责网站视觉、前端负责页面、后端负责接口、测试负责验收，把它们拉进同一个协作房间**」——它立刻创建 4 个标准会话（出现在左侧列表、随时可接管），自动继承你的模型与工作目录；创建时可指定 **Agent 预设**（如「用代码模式创建前端会话」），决定该会话的工具面与人格；
2. **协作沟通**：房间建好后，**谁改了什么、谁干完了，全员可见**；成员状态（正在生成 / 空闲）变化会自动收到「房间动态」通知；**房间消息可以带图片**——截图直接发群里，接收方 AI 通过 read 拿到图片文件路径，可读图、可转发到 IM 渠道；
3. **派活与催活**：问 AI「**现在谁在干活、谁空闲了**」，它会查看各会话状态；对空闲的会话说「**叫前端把结果发过来**」，AI 自动唤醒它并派活——不会批量自动唤醒，一切由你（或你的主会话）有意识地指挥；
4. **防冲突**：同一项目多个会话并行改代码时，开工前对 AI 说「**声明一下你要改哪些文件**」——其他人（及其 AI）能看到「谁在改什么」；真撞车了，写入方会收到冲突警告，还有「工作区活动」通知（并行开始/结束、成员变化时单独推送）随时告知谁在跑、在干什么；
5. **结果回传**：各成员干完把结果发回房间，你汇总确认。

**持续运转（关键）**：主会话自己一直在运行，所以它能**随时唤醒已经休息（空闲）的会话继续干活**——催活、收结果、派下一轮，哪怕你不在电脑前，队伍也能一路推进到出结果。唯一的前提是**主会话所在的 DSH 进程保持运行**；如果主会话空闲了或 DSH 被关掉，唤醒链就停了——需要你回来发一条消息，队伍重新开动。

**会得到什么**：一个人的开发产出，变成一个小团队的吞吐。任务交接、唤醒、冲突预警全链路自动化，房间消息留痕可查。

---

## 场景四：重活派给外部 AI 代理（外部外援）

**适合谁**：需要把大任务（视觉重设计、代码审查、完整功能开发）交给专用 AI 代理（Kimi / Codex / Grok / Hermes）的用户——不想被阻塞，又不想错过结果。

**怎么用**：

1. 对 AI 说「**把这个任务派给 grok：移动端适配改造**」——后台异步执行，立即返回任务号，**不卡当前会话**，你可以继续聊别的；
2. 期间随时问「**任务进度如何**」，或在「COI 调度」里看实时日志流；
3. 派单时 AI 可自主选择带上你的项目记忆——外部代理也「懂项目约定」；
4. **派单可以带图**：对 AI 说「**把这张截图发给 grok 分析**」——附件支持本地路径/远程 URL/本会话图片（你在输入框贴的图），codex/kimi/hermes 都能真看图（grok 走 prompt 读图，zcode 纯文本会明确拒绝）；
5. 完成后结果摘要**自动写入项目日志与今日日志**——派出去的活自动变成你的记忆资产。

**会得到什么**：AI 派活给 AI，你只负责确认验收。视觉改版、深度代码审查、批量重构这类「重活」都能甩出去，主会话保持轻快。

---

## 场景五：内外协同——一支队伍，两种兵种

**适合谁**：任务大到单靠一边搞不定的人。这是插件协作能力的完全体：**内部会话负责「需要上下文和来回打磨的活」，外部代理负责「一次性重活」，两者通过记忆、房间、提示词串成一条流水线。**

一个完整的真实流程（产品视觉改版）：

1. **分工**：主会话 spawn 前端、测试两个内部会话并拉进房间；同时把「全站视觉重设计」派给外部代理 Kimi；
2. **外部主刀**：Kimi 后台跑重设计（不占任何会话）；期间内部前端会话先做数据层和页面结构，不干等；
3. **接力**：Kimi 完成，摘要自动沉淀进项目记忆——主会话把设计结论发到房间，前端会话**读记忆拿到设计规范**，开始集成；
4. **问题升级**：集成中发现一个诡异样式问题，前端会话卡住——主会话把这个 bug 派给 Grok 深挖，结论回房间，前端会话照结论修复；
5. **验收**：测试会话跑完验收流程，结果发回房间，你最后确认。

协作的四个结合点，可以自由组合：

- **任务接力**：外部代理的产出（摘要/结论）自动进记忆 → 内部会话接力执行——**外部做重活，内部做集成与打磨**；
- **问题升级**：内部会话遇到难啃的问题 → 主会话派给外部代理深挖 → 结论回房间——**内部快节奏迭代，外部慢工出细活**；
- **标准统一**：给外部代理派活时，注入你沉淀的提示词（如「代码审查清单」「PRD 规范」）——**外部代理按你的流程干活，不靠运气**；
- **状态同步**：谁在跑、谁干完了，房间 + 工作区活动 + 通知随时可见——**你不用当人肉调度员**。

**会得到什么**：一条「外部主刀 → 内部集成 → 测试验收 → 你确认」的完整流水线。大任务不再是一个人（或一个 AI）硬扛，而是内外两支队伍分工协作。

---

## 场景六：AI 的自我纪律——提示词注入

**适合谁**：想把「好用的工作方法」沉淀下来、让每个 AI（包括外部代理）都按同一套流程干活的人。

提示词库是**指令范式资产库**：代码审查、调试、PRD、测试策略……把常用的工作方法固化成提示词（可分类、可搜索、可启用/禁用）。

**怎么用**：

1. **AI 自己选、自己注入**：AI 觉得当前任务适用某套流程时，它会自己查看提示词库、选中合适的提示词注入自己——「接下来按代码审查清单执行」；下一轮它自动遵循，**不打断当前回复**；也能「立即注入」，当前回合马上生效；
2. **你一键注入**：在「提示词注入」里选中一条，点「注入一次 / 持续注入 / 立即注入」——持续注入就是「每回合提醒 AI 按此纪律干活」；
3. **临时注入**：不建提示词，直接输入一段要求注入，自动存入库中，下次复用；
4. **派活带纪律**：给子会话、外部代理派活时，让 AI 把对应提示词一起带上——**整个团队用同一套标准**。

**会得到什么**：好方法不再只存在你脑子里或一次对话里——它变成可复用的「团队操作手册」，AI 会主动遵守，你只管维护手册质量。

---

## 场景七：会话太长、太贵、容易糊——书签与分支

**适合谁**：对上下文开销敏感、一个会话动辄上百轮的深度用户。

- **会话书签**：每一轮都可以点星（☆）标记，「书签」列出全部书签（名称/轮次/时间/摘要，可搜索），**点击一键跳回任意一轮**——探索到「这个结论很重要」就打个星；
- **任意轮分支**：官方只支持从最后一轮创建分支；本插件把**中间任意轮的分支入口接管**——书签列表点「分支」（或直接点官方分支按钮，中间轮会弹出确认），走官方分支通道创建新会话，进入官方分支谱系；
- **上下文占用提醒**：输入框圆环实时显示上下文占用——≥30% 变黄、≥40% 变红，提醒你该打书签、该开分支、该开新会话了。

**怎么用**：

1. 探索性会话在关键轮次点 ☆，给书签起个名字（如「方案 A 评审结论」）；
2. 想从中间某个决策点另开一条线，书签列表点「分支」；
3. 看到圆环变红，把当前会话打个书签，开新会话继续。

**会得到什么**：上下文不再是一根只能从头滚到尾的绳子，而是**带锚点、可分支、可跳转的时间线**——每一轮的探索成果都能被精准复用，不会再因为「会话太长了」被迫放弃中间的好结论。

---

## 场景八：离开电脑也能用（手机访问 + 会话筛选 + 通知）

**适合谁**：离开电脑也想继续和 AI 协作、或者同时开很多会话看不过来的人。

# dsh-pwa-ui

中文 | [English](README.en.md)

DeepSeek Harness（`dsh`）Web 插件：让**已安装**的 Web 应用拥有原生观感的窗口标题栏，基于
[Window Controls Overlay](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/progressive-web-apps/how-to/window-controls-overlay)
API。

它不额外画一条标题栏：清单启用 overlay 之后，应用**自身的**界面就是窗口标题栏 —— 侧边栏的 logo 行与会话 header 所在的顶部条带就是拖动窗口的位置，应用自己的控件则自动让开系统窗口按钮。

![已安装应用的窗口：应用自身的 logo 行与会话 header 就是标题栏](assets/screenshot-1.png)

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @liuzw/dsh-pwa-ui
```

重启 `dsh web`（清单路由在启动时接管），然后在 Edge 或 Chrome 里把界面安装成应用：地址栏 → **安装**。应用窗口打开后，它自己的 header 就是标题栏。

不想安装也可以先看效果：Microsoft Edge DevTools → **应用程序 → 窗口控件叠加**（Window Controls Overlay）可模拟 overlay；即使 `navigator.windowControlsOverlay` API 仍不可见，插件也会把模拟出来的 `env()` 几何当成已启用 overlay 处理。

## 做了什么

| 半身 | 文件 | 职责 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 主机 | `index.js` | 接管精确路由 `/manifest.webmanifest`，在自带的 manifest 之上把 `display_override: ["window-controls-overlay"]` 放在首位返回；其余字段（`name`、`short_name`、`start_url`、`scope`、`display`、`icons`）原样透传 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-frontend/dist/manifest.webmanifest`，只有读不到时才用内置副本兜底。`display: "fullscreen"` 仍作为回退模式，因此不支持 overlay 的平台行为不变。 |
| 浏览器 | `client.js` | overlay 可见期间在 `<html>` 上发布 `data-dsh-wco` 标记并注入一份样式表，卸载时全部回收。 |

### 标题栏就是应用自己的界面

shell 本来就声明了哪些行在桌面窗口下是拖拽把手：侧边栏品牌行与会话 header 自带 `data-window-drag`，`ui-web` 的 base.css 把这个标记变成 macOS 的拖拽规则。浏览器半身复用它，而不是另造 chrome：

- `html[data-dsh-wco] [data-window-drag]` 成为 `app-region: drag` 把手，于是 logo 行与会话 header 都能拖动窗口，和桌面版的行为一致。
- 应用自身控件通过同一份 `no-drag` 名单（`button`、`a`、`[role=tab]` 等）加应用自己的 `data-window-drag-recall` 标记保持可点击。
- 侧边栏根容器自带的 `6px` 顶边 / `--dsh-sidebar-inline-padding` 盒子在品牌行上用负外边距抵消、再把同样的内缩作为行内 padding 加回，于是品牌行的边框盒（也就是拖拽区）能贴到窗口左上角，而内容一个像素都不移动。
- `--dsh-wco-controls-start` / `--dsh-wco-controls-end` 量的是浏览器标题栏 chrome 占用的条带（Windows 在右、macOS 在左；Edge 上这条带包含浏览器的全部按钮，不只是最小化/最大化/关闭）。只有真正占据窗口右边缘的那个面才吃这个内缩——展开的右侧栏内缩它自己的 dock 标签条，未展开时改由会话 header 承担。侧边栏品牌行与 dock 的前导内缩取 `controls-start`，因此 macOS 的红绿灯不会压到应用控件。
- 同时发布 `--dsh-frame-leading-clearance` 与 `--dsh-frame-overlay-top`，让 frame 的标题行和弹窗/浮层避开控件；`--dsh-frame-chrome-top` 故意不动——现在标题栏是应用内容，模态遮罩本就该盖住它。

## 要求

- DSH 的 **web** profile（`dsh web`）；桌面/Electron 窗口有各自的 `data-platform="darwin"` / `data-windows-titlebar` chrome，不受影响。
- 支持 Window Controls Overlay 的浏览器并已安装该应用：Windows/macOS 上的 Edge 或 Chrome。必须是安装后的应用——普通浏览器标签页里 `navigator.windowControlsOverlay.visible` 为假且 `env(titlebar-area-height)` 解析为 `0px`，因此不画任何东西、不预留空间、布局完全不变。

## 说明与已知耦合

- 零依赖、无构建步骤：包内就是原生 ES 模块，可从 npm 或直接从仓库安装。
- **标题栏 chrome 的背景**：刷新时浏览器偶尔先把它自己那层背景画在标题栏按钮后面，随后才被应用的重绘覆盖，右上角因此出现一瞬颜色不一致。这正是
  [`::window-controls-overlay`](https://github.com/WICG/window-controls-overlay/issues/67)
  提案要解决的问题；插件已写入 `::window-controls-overlay { background: transparent }`
  （两种写法各为一条独立规则，避免未支持的形式连带作废另一条）——该提案尚未实现，当前浏览器会把它们当未知选择器丢弃，等它落地后即自动生效、无需再改插件。在那之前，能影响这层背景的只有 manifest 的 `theme_color`。
- 插件对准的是自带前端的钩子，前端改版时可能需要跟着更新：`data-window-drag` 标记、右侧栏的 `data-sidebar-right-panel` / `data-sidebar-right-open` / `data-dockkit-float` 属性与 `--dsh-dockkit-strip-inline-start`，以及若干被重述的值（会话 header 的 `28px` 右侧内边距、dock 标签条的 `6px`、品牌行的 `4px` 前导内边距与 `60px` / `36px` 行高、侧边栏根容器的 `6px` 盒子）和 `_logoRow` / `_root` / `_collapsed` / `_headerBlank` / `_headerSessionless` / `_tabStrip` 这几个 CSS-module 后缀。
- 预留条带的宽度是量出来的、不是猜的：Edge 上这条浏览器 chrome 可能有几百像素宽，应用右侧控件就是按这个宽度让位的。
- macOS 分支已实现（通过同一组变量做前导让位），但没有在真实 macOS 窗口上验证。
